6856fe85.title: Global AI Solution Engineer
6856fe85.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A  

**Mission of the Role**

Are you passionate about turning business needs into practical, AI-enabled solutions and excited to be part of a global company transforming industry with cutting-edge technology? ABB is looking for an **AI Solution Engineer** to join our **Automation IS** team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and practical AI-enabled solutions. You will assess whether AI is the right approach and recommend an implementation approach based on the standards, reference architectures and technology guidance defined by the Advanced Analytics Architect and relevant platform architects. You will stay hands-on throughout delivery, working with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, Data Engineers and other specialists to build, validate and hand over working solutions. You will also contribute to project set-up, incremental delivery, solution quality, production readiness and reuse across Automation.

  

**Work model:** #LI Hybrid **Area:** This role contributes to AU IS in AU.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Business understanding and solution fit**

* Work with Data Analysts and business stakeholders to clarify:business needs and expected outcomessuccess measuresAI-specific data and context requirementsrisks and ownership
* Assess whether AI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution best addresses the identified business need.
* Recommend solutions based on approved patterns and guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and the Snowflake, Azure and Fabric platform architects.

  

**Build and development**

* Develop and validate AI components, proofs of concept, prototypes and minimum viable solutions using Python, SQL and approved technologies.
* Build Azure- or Snowflake-based AI applications and services, including orchestration, retrieval, RAG, agent logic, APIs, evaluation and integration components.
* Create implementation assets, including prompts, agent instructions, evaluation datasets, notebooks, application logic, automated workflows, tests and deployment assets.
* Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to develop AI/ML solutions that address business needs and deliver measurable business value. These include predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities to build and validate machine learning and generative AI solutions using enterprise data. These include Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions.

  

**Quality, compliance and operations**

* Evaluate and test solutions for grounding, answer quality, model or agent behaviour, business value, safety, cost and operational reliability.
* Apply the defined Responsible AI, information security, privacy, access-control and IT compliance requirements within the assigned solution scope. Work with architecture, platform, security and operations specialists where required.
* Contribute to CI/CD, production readiness, handover and monitoring design.
* Support incident and problem analysis related to AI solutions within the assigned scope.
* Document AI solutions, including their logic, assumptions, limitations, test results and operational requirements.

  

**Collaboration**

* Work as part of a multidisciplinary delivery team with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers and platform specialists.

  

**Requirements (Mandatory)**

**Experience and education**

* At least 2 years of relevant experience delivering AI, ML or advanced analytics solutions, including at least one solution taken from requirements through implementation.
* 4–6 years of professional experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, BI analytics or a similar data-focused role.
* Master's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level).

  

**Technical skills**

* Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL for data preparation, API integration, testing and solution development.
* Strong practical understanding of generative AI application patterns, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering and evaluation.
* Practical experience with at least one enterprise AI development platform, preferably Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Snowflake Cortex or Snowflake Intelligence. Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI AI capabilities is an advantage.
* General understanding of classical machine learning concepts. Hands-on experience is an advantage where relevant to the use case.
* Working experience with version control and testing, preferably using GitHub or Azure DevOps. Exposure to CI/CD and deployment processes is an advantage.
* Experience documenting AI solutions and understanding data quality concepts, with attention to data accuracy and consistency.

  

**Ways of working**

* Experience working in an Agile or similar delivery setup.
* Ability to take part in stakeholder discussions and clarify technical, data and AI-specific aspects of documented business requirements.
* Ability to explain technical options, limitations and trade-offs, and to work effectively in a multidisciplinary delivery team.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with analysts and customers and convert documented requirements into practical AI solution components.

  

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Relevant professional certifications, particularly:Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103)SnowPro Core or GenAI certificationsFabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)
* Practical experience with Snowflake AI/ML capabilities such as Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst or AI Functions.
* Experience with Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience using SAP and Salesforce enterprise data as inputs to AI/ML solutions.

  

**More About Us**

ABB provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

c5ca6bbd.description:
**Company Description**
CAREERBLOC is a talent-focused organization dedicated to connecting skilled professionals with innovative businesses across technology and consulting domains. The company emphasizes career growth, skills development, and long-term partnership with both clients and professionals. CAREERBLOC works with organizations seeking specialized expertise in areas such as SAP, process optimization, and digital transformation. The team promotes an inclusive, collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives and practical problem-solving. Joining CAREERBLOC offers opportunities to contribute to impactful projects while advancing professional capabilities.
  
**Role Description**
The SAP Signavio Architect / Techno-Functional Consultant is a full-time remote role responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing SAP Signavio-based solutions for business process management and transformation. In this role, the consultant collaborates with business and IT stakeholders to capture requirements, model end-to-end business processes, and align them with SAP solution architecture. Typical day-to-day tasks include configuring SAP Signavio, defining integration approaches with SAP and non-SAP systems, guiding process improvements, and documenting solution designs and standards. The consultant supports project delivery through workshops, demonstrations, and technical guidance, and provides ongoing advisory support on best practices for process governance and optimization. The role also involves working with cross-functional teams, supporting testing and deployment activities, and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with organizational goals.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong expertise in Business Process modeling, analysis, and optimization, with experience using SAP Signavio or similar process management tools.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP Basis and related technical components to support system performance, stability, and secure integrations.
* Consulting skills including stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and preparation of clear documentation and recommendations.
* Solution Architecture experience in designing end-to-end SAP and SAP Signavio solutions, including integration patterns and alignment with enterprise architecture.
* Integration skills covering SAP-to-SAP and SAP-to-non-SAP interfaces, APIs, and data flows to enable seamless business processes.
* Relevant experience in SAP ecosystems (e.g., S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform) and familiarity with business process transformation initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technical and process solutions.
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in remote, cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field; advanced certifications in SAP or process management are a plus.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Job Description**
The Senior Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.
  
  
**Description Of The Area**
Within
**RDT Pharma Technical Operations**
and specifically in the context of
**Manufacturing Technologies**
, this Solution Architect for Process Data ensures the seamless fit of our manufacturing business solutions into the Roche ecosystem. This is crucial for implementing and running stable, robust, and highly performing solutions while maximizing the return on investment (ROI) on our manufacturing data. The Process Data area is part of the digital backbone of our production environment, ensuring that complex scientific processes are translated into reliable, executable, and reportable digital formats.
  
  
Our scope includes:
  
  

* Process Parameter Definition & Tracking: Ensuring the precision and integrity of data that defines our manufacturing steps
* Enterprise Recipe Management: Orchestrating the "blueprints" for our medicines across different sites to ensure consistency and scalability
* Data Historian Solutions: Managing the high-frequency, real-time data streams from the shop floor to enable deep analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous process improvement
* Shop-Floor Data Accessibility: Streamlining the extraction and availability of raw manufacturing data to ensure it is readily accessible for higher-level systems, analytics, and operational decision-making

**Job Responsibilities**

* Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
* Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded and published for multiple solutions or the product. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments
* Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product
* Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
* Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
* Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring

**Qualifications**
**Education / Experience**

* Bachelor or advanced degree
* Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context
* Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes
* Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others
* 2+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry
* 2+ years of experience with pharmaceutical manufacturing IT solutions

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of the product discovery and development lifecycle. Familiarity with GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations (GDPR)
* In-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas
* Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for products
* Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions
* Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for multiple solutions, including conducting vendor assessments
* Experience with Enterprise Recipe Management systems in the pharmaceutical context is a plus

**Additional Qualifications**

* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to communicate difficult concepts and influence stakeholders to adopt different perspectives
* Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value, improve existing solutions, manage technical debt, and lead teams in identifying innovative solutions
* With a global team and the main stakeholders in NALA and EMEA the position requires regular availability for meetings outside of standard business hours
* Availability to travel up to 20% of the time

**Shift:**
CET time zone
  
  
#Hyderabad2026

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

52868e32.description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Cloud Migration Specialist to lead and manage the migration of applications, data and infrastructure from legacy or existing platforms to modern cloud environments. You will assess requirements, plan and execute migrations, and help ensure minimal disruption to business operations. Based in Pune, this role requires practical experience with cloud migration methodologies, infrastructure administration, security hardening, automation and advanced technical troubleshooting.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Assess, plan and execute migrations of applications, data and infrastructure to modern cloud platforms
* Perform migrations of virtual machines, databases, applications and data to Microsoft Azure using Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Database Migration Service
* Collaborate with developers, database administrators, system administrators and other cross-functional stakeholders
* Monitor migrated environments to maintain performance, security, reliability and operational stability
* Troubleshoot migration-related issues, complete root-cause analysis and implement effective resolutions
* Deliver Level 3 infrastructure administration, including installation, configuration, monitoring and maintenance
* Identify, assess and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities to support security compliance and reduce risk exposure
* Apply operating-system security-hardening practices in accordance with organisational and industry standards
* Use Bash, Python or similar scripting technologies to automate routine activities and support enterprise system automation
* Produce technical documentation and conduct knowledge-transfer sessions to enable ongoing maintenance and support

**Who You Are**

* You have hands-on experience migrating platforms to cloud services or managed-instance environments
* You understand cloud migration methodologies and tools, particularly within Microsoft Azure
* You have experience with infrastructure technologies such as Linux, VMware and vCenter
* You hold a cloud certification relating to Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform
* You possess broad IT knowledge, including service delivery, operations and emerging technologies
* You understand ITIL frameworks and their practical application within IT service management
* You are familiar with relevant compliance and governance requirements, including GDPR
* You apply strong analytical, problem-solving and advanced troubleshooting skills
* You communicate clearly in writing and conversation, build trusted stakeholder relationships and work collaboratively across teams
* You follow through reliably on agreed actions and focus on achieving timely outcomes

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* The opportunity to contribute to end-to-end cloud transformation and modernisation initiatives
* Practical exposure to business-critical migrations involving virtual machines, databases, applications and data
* Collaboration with multidisciplinary technology teams across development, database, systems and infrastructure functions
* Experience supporting secure, reliable and well-governed cloud environments
* Opportunities to apply automation, troubleshooting and infrastructure expertise to complex technical challenges

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced planning and execution techniques for large-scale cloud migrations
* Practical use of Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Database Migration Service
* Cloud and infrastructure security, including vulnerability remediation and operating-system hardening
* Enterprise automation using scripting technologies such as Bash and Python
* Cross-functional stakeholder collaboration, technical documentation and knowledge transfer
* Operational monitoring and optimisation of migrated cloud environments

b8c691b0.title: Cloud Security Consultant - Information Compliance Security : CNAPP, CSPM & Multi-Cloud Exp -8 - 12 Yrs | Job Location : Gurgaon, Mumbai
b8c691b0.description:
**Company Description**
WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**End-to-End Cloud Security Solution Review & Design Assurance**

* Conduct comprehensive design and architecture reviews of end-to-end cloud technology solutions, including cloud platforms (M365, Azure, AWS) and SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS implementations, ensuring security by design.
* Perform in-depth technical assessments of implemented technology solutions (on-premises and cloud) to identify misconfigurations, deviations from best practices, and potential attack vectors.
* Evaluate cloud security solutions against threat models, risk assessments, and industry-recognized frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks).
* Provide expert security recommendations and architectural guidance to Risk, InfoSec, and Enterprise IT leadership, as well as to client-facing processes.

**Cloud Security Posture Management & Compliance Assurance**

* Lead and execute Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) reviews using CNAPP (Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform) tools to assess cloud security posture, cloud identity protection (CIEM), workload protection, and container security.
* Run regular compliance scans of cloud resources against standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS, and SOC 2, and drive continuous improvement of compliance posture.
* Review and provide feedback on cloud security policies, procedures, and hardening documents, ensuring alignment with CIS benchmarks and organizational InfoSec policies.
* Conduct cloud risk assessments to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and misconfigurations that could impact IT operations and sensitive data.

**Secure Cloud Development & Operations Practices**

* Collaborate with Enterprise IT and DevOps teams to embed security throughout the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines.
* Review Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates and automation scripts for security flaws, guiding teams on secure IaC best practices.
* Participate in cloud attack path analysis to understand adversary techniques and design preventative and detective controls.
* Ensure CIS and other security best practices are rigorously applied across new and existing applications, products, and cloud infrastructure.

**Security Governance & Remediation Oversight**

* Partner with cross-functional teams to track and drive remediation of identified security vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of cloud security governance frameworks and processes.
* Act as a subject matter expert for incident response and forensic readiness related to cloud security incidents.
* Collaborate on cloud attack path analysis across teams.

**Qualifications**
**Experience**

* 8–12+ years of progressive experience in Information Security, with at least 5–7 years focused specifically on cloud security architecture, engineering, and review.
* Extensive hands-on experience with security services and features across major cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Demonstrable experience performing security assessments, penetration testing, or vulnerability management within cloud environments.
* Proven experience designing and reviewing secure cloud architectures for complex enterprise solutions.

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of cloud computing principles (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and the Shared Responsibility Model.
* Expertise in cloud security frameworks and standards: NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, OWASP Cloud Top 10.
* Hands-on proficiency with leading CNAPP platforms (e.g., Prisma Cloud, Wiz, Tenable, Lacework, Microsoft, CrowdStrike Cloud Security) for CSPM, CIEM, cloud workload protection, and container security.
* Strong grasp of Identity and Access Management (IAM) in the cloud: Azure AD, AWS IAM, GCP IAM, conditional access policies, MFA, SSO, PIM/PAM.
* Advanced knowledge of network security in the cloud: VPC/VNet design, network segmentation, firewalls (WAF, NGFW), security groups/NSGs, VPNs, and private links.
* Expertise in data security and encryption, including securing data at rest and in transit using native cloud encryption services (KMS, Key Vault, Cloud KMS).
* Understanding of application security in the cloud, including secure coding practices, API security, serverless function security, and DevSecOps integration.
* Ability to review and secure Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates, Bicep) and policy-as-code implementations.
* Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and associated security best practices and tools.

**Compliance & Governance**

* In-depth knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and their application in cloud environments.
* Experience with GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) tools and processes for cloud.

**Analytical & Communication Skills**

* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Strong ability to articulate complex security concepts and risks to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for documentation, reports, and presentations.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a distributed team, managing multiple priorities effectively.

**Certifications (Highly Preferred)**
*Cloud Security Certifications:*

* (ISC)² Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)
* Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK)

*General Security Certifications:*

* (ISC)² CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

b764ff98.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
b764ff98.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Technical Program ManagerOverview  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible.  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead complex cross-functional programs spanning multiple engineering teams, platforms, and stakeholder organizations.
  
  
You will drive delivery from concept to production while managing dependencies, risks, schedules, operational readiness, and executive communications.  
  
This role requires strong technical depth, exceptional program leadership, and the ability to influence across engineering, architecture, product, operations, and executive leadership teams.  
  
All About You  
Required Qualifications  
  
5-9 years of overall career experience leading large-scale technical programs and has played a TPM role.  
  
Proven experience delivering complex cross-functional initiatives across multiple engineering teams.  
  
Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and event-driven platforms.  
  
Experience managing large migration and modernization programs.  
  
Strong program planning, dependency management, and risk management skills.  
  
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across organizations.  
  
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management capabilities.  
  
Experience leading production readiness, release governance, and operational execution activities.  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  
  
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and platform engineering.  
  
Experience with Kafka, MQ, event-driven architectures, and high-volume transaction processing systems.  
  
Knowledge of observability platforms, operational controls, and resiliency patterns.  
  
Experience within financial services, payments, or highly regulated industries.  
  
PMP, SAFe, Scrum, or equivalent certification is a plus.  
Role  
  
Drive end-to-end execution of large, complex technology programs.  
  
Establish clear program plans, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.  
  
Lead planning, execution, release readiness, and production deployment activities.  
  
Manage cross-functional delivery involving Engineering, Product, Architecture,
  
  
Security, Infrastructure, and Operations teams.  
  
Ensure predictable delivery outcomes through proactive risk management and
  
execution discipline.  
  
Develop a strong understanding of platform architecture, technical dependencies, and operational requirements.  
  
Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies.  
  
Drive technical readiness reviews, architecture reviews, migration programs, and operational preparedness activities.  
  
Coordinate large-scale platform initiatives including cloud migration, resilience improvements, infrastructure modernization, and product launches.  
  
Serve as the single point of accountability for program status, risks, decisions, and escalations.  
  
Build alignment across senior engineering leaders, architects, TPMs, product managers, and business stakeholders.  
  
Drive timely decisions and resolve competing priorities across multiple teams.  
  
Provide concise executive-level status reporting and decision support.  
  
Proactively identify and manage program risks, dependencies, and blockers.  
  
Ensure operational readiness including monitoring, observability, deployment, rollback, and support procedures.  
  
Lead war-room activities during critical incidents and drive post-incident learnings.  
  
Establish governance frameworks and reporting mechanisms to improve delivery predictability.  
  
Mentor TPMs and project leads across the organization.  
  
Promote program management best practices and execution rigor.  
  
Drive a culture of accountability, ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

e7581042.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

* + Experience managing, mentoring, and coaching people.
* + Understand the detail behind the implemented solution and having the ability to communicate the high-level vision with the client.
* + The ability to think past the products and create solutions to meet the business/IT needs.

a770429e.title: Program Manager, Agentic Deployments
a770429e.description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

This role owns how our agentic product lands in customer environments. You'll run customer deployments from kickoff through initial agent deployment, and often into the next set of agents for the same customer, keeping each engagement on scope, on schedule, and on track to the outcome the customer signed up for. You work in close partnership with our Agentic Solutions and engineering teams, and you own the deployment programs themselves along with the internal and external reporting on them.

The job is equal parts internal coordination and customer-facing leadership. On one side, you line up the internal teams that build and ship the work and keep them moving in sync. On the other, you set expectations with the customer, keep their sponsor engaged, and make sure everyone can see where things stand. You're comfortable in the technical detail and communicate clearly with all stakeholders, from engineers to customer executives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own customer deployments end to end. Drive each engagement from kickoff and discovery through build, testing, and initial agent deployment, keeping it on scope, on schedule, and on track to the outcome the customer signed up for.
* Run the stage-gate process. Manage the go/no-go gates between phases, confirm entry and exit criteria are met, and keep the work moving without skipping the steps that matter.
* Be the customer's primary program contact. Set expectations, keep the executive sponsor engaged, run the cadence, and keep the relationship grounded in clear, trustworthy delivery.
* Coordinate the teams that deliver. Partner closely with the Agentic Solutions and engineering teams, manage dependencies across them, and clear blockers before they slip the timeline.
* Own the deployment artifacts and deliverables. Produce and standardize the engagement charters, delivery plans, status reports, runbooks, and customer-facing deliverables each deployment depends on, so quality stays consistent across engagements.
* Establish repeatable processes and practices. Turn how we deploy into a documented, reusable playbook, covering intake, kickoff, stage gates, and handoffs, that scales as we add customers instead of reinventing each engagement.
* Own internal and external reporting. Give the customer and internal leadership a clear, straight view of where each engagement stands: status, risks, dependencies, and decisions.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 3 to 5+ years in program or project management, ideally delivering software or technology implementations to external customers.
* A track record of owning complex, cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders and external dependencies.
* Strong customer-facing skills: you set expectations, manage stakeholders, and keep executive sponsors engaged.
* Comfortable with technical concepts and technical teams.
* Excellent organization and communication. You produce clear documentation, plans, and reporting, bring structure to ambiguity, and can run several workstreams at once.
* Comfortable in a startup or fast-changing environment where priorities shift and you help build the process, not just follow it.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience delivering enterprise software or SaaS implementations to large organizations.
* Experience building or standardizing delivery playbooks, artifacts, or processes.
* Familiarity with AI/ML, automation, and data products.
* Experience running a stage-gate or other structured delivery methodology.
* Insurance or financial services experience.
* Comfortable coordinating across distributed teams and time zones.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in a technical or business field, such as Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Operations, or Business, or equivalent practical experience.

  

*Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate.*

*We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.*

a53e27e3.title: Program Manager 4
a53e27e3.description:
**Job Description**
This role will lead complex technical programs, establishes scope and milestones, improves cross-team processes, automates reporting, and acts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**
**Program Ownership**

* Lead one or more major GPU Cluster Health domains such as strategic customer availability, partner repair execution, RMA/spares governance, data/reporting framework, repair workflow improvement, or engineering platform tooling.
* Translate availability gaps into structured programs with scope, owners, milestones, KPIs, risks, dependencies, and executive-ready status.
* Drive weekly operating rhythm for assigned domains, including KPI review, blockers, escalations, decisions, and follow-through.

**Customer and Horizontal Leadership**

* Support the vertical/horizontal TPM model by owning either a customer vertical or a horizontal functional area.
* For vertical ownership, lead availability and repair strategy for assigned strategic customers and customer clusters.
* For horizontal ownership, lead cross-cutting programs such as NVIDIA/AMD partner tracking, SDE/SRE tooling, RMA/spares feedback loop, SOP tracking, or metrics/reporting framework.

**KPI Definition and Governance**

* Define KPI measurement methods for repair health, including cluster availability, unavailable-host backlog, repair cycle time, repair success rate, reopen rate, spare availability, RMA loop performance, partner responsiveness, and SLA/SLO adherence.
* Drive consistent reporting standards across TPMs and support teams.
* Identify trends across multiple workstreams and convert them into prioritized corrective actions.

**Cross-Functional Execution**

* Partner with India, Morocco, and Mexico SDE/SRE teams to identify tooling and first-level support needs.
* Prioritize tooling requirements that reduce manual repair coordination, improve triage, automate reporting, or accelerate repair handoffs.
* Work with GSL, CHS, CPV, TRS, Warminator , and data center operations to remove repair blockers.
* Support incident-style escalation for clusters at availability risk.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead post-program retrospectives and drive process updates.
* Standardize repeatable playbooks, intake processes, escalation paths, and repair governance artifacts.
* Identify automation opportunities and advocate for prioritization.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Major repair programs have clear objectives, metrics, owners, and measurable improvement .
* Leadership has reliable visibility into customer cluster health and repair risk.
* Repair blockers are resolved through structured governance instead of ad hoc escalation.
* Tooling and reporting requirements are translated into actionable SDE/SRE work.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

6d1fc757.title: Sr Advisory Solution Consultant - TMT
6d1fc757.description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you get to do in this role:**

* Support product sales as a technical, solution, and industry domain expert within a client-facing sales team pursuing strategic enterprise customers and prospects.
* Bring industry-specific expertise across Manufacturing, Retail, IT/ITES, and/or Telecommunications, with the ability to understand industry operating models, customer journeys, service operations, business processes, technology landscapes, and transformation priorities.
* Translate industry challenges into compelling solution narratives by connecting business outcomes, customer experience, workflow transformation, automation, data, and AI with ServiceNow capabilities.
* Lead executive and technical discovery workshops to uncover customer priorities, operational challenges, transformation opportunities, and desired business outcomes.
* Develop and deliver compelling product demonstrations and solution experiences that reflect real industry scenarios and end-to-end business processes, rather than feature-led demonstrations.
* Engage credibly with senior business stakeholders, CIO/CTO/CBO organizations, enterprise architects, operations leaders, and transformation teams.
* Develop strong client and partner relationships and establish yourself as a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle.
* Develop solution architectures that demonstrate how ServiceNow integrates with a customer's broader enterprise technology ecosystem, including CRM, ERP, contact center, data, integration, and AI platforms.
* Articulate the role of AI, Agentic AI, automation, workflow orchestration, and data in transforming industry-specific processes and customer experiences.
* Stay current on competitive positioning, industry trends, emerging technology, AI developments, and market differentiation.
* Represent ServiceNow at executive briefings, customer workshops, conferences, industry forums, user groups, partner events, and trade shows.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 10+ years of experience in pre-sales Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Technology Consulting, or a comparable customer-facing technology role.
* Strong domain expertise in at least one, preferably more, of the following industries: Manufacturing, Retail, IT/ITES, or Telecommunications.
* Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate industry business processes, customer journeys, operational challenges, transformation priorities, and technology landscapes.
* Experience converting complex business requirements into solution architectures, demonstrations, transformation roadmaps, and compelling executive narratives.
* Experience engaging both business and technical stakeholders, ranging from operational teams to senior executives and enterprise architects.
* Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with enterprise cloud software platforms and architectures.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integrations and the role of platforms such as CRM, ERP, contact center, data platforms, APIs, integration technologies, and AI services within an enterprise architecture.
* Experience working collaboratively with Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Partners, Professional Services, and customer technology teams.
* Strong discovery, storytelling, presentation, demonstration, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to operate strategically within complex enterprise accounts while remaining hands-on with solution development and demonstrations.
* Ability and willingness to travel as necessary.

Additional Information
  
  
**Work Personas**
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
  
  
**Accommodations**
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
  
  
**Export Control Regulations**
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

3a2b3bc4.title: Principal Solutions Engineer
3a2b3bc4.description:
**Position Overview**
Solution Engineers (SEs) at SingleStore are solving some of the most cutting-edge technical challenges in today’s data-driven world. When customers evaluate SingleStore, SEs are their trusted technical experts who evaluate, identify, and demonstrate how SingleStore can solve their mission-critical business needs. As key contributors to our sales organization, Solution Engineers add tremendous value to the customer journey and directly impact company growth and revenue.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for identifying the technical requirements necessary to deliver business value for our Fortune 1,000 customers. Working in partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will help to acquire new customers and expand existing accounts. You will do this by leveraging your technical skill set and business acumen to understand complex solutions and create high-quality demos that resonate with our customers.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Partner with Prospects and Customers to understand their industries and strategies, and educate them on SingleStores strategy, technologies and vision.
* Partner with Account Executives to close new business (logos) and expand existing accounts
* Partner with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing etc.) to share feedback on customer needs and requests
* Design, develop, and deploy Proofs of Concept (POCs) with prospective customers
* Drive the technical evaluation stage of the sales cycle, acting as the technical lead/subject matter expert (query tuning, load testing, etc.)
* Work to develop Channels and Partners for co-selling in the region.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Fluency in English and regional languages
* Experience with Gen AI, ML and Advanced Analytics
* Experience successfully selling enterprise database technologies, distributed systems, and similar products
* Deep understanding of distributed database technologies, including both analytic and transactional processing
* Expertise executing POCs, with experience designing and deploying complex technologies into existing customer environments
* In-Depth understanding of data platforms, including various competitive products (Oracle, SQL Server, Postgres, MongoDB, Snowflake, Databricks, etc.)
* Experienced in cloud and containerized environments, deployment and orchestration (including Linux and Kubernetes environments)
* Proficient programming skills in Python, Java, or other programming languages
* Ability to travel within the region and internationally
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a relevant technical field

SingleStore is a global database company that empowers the world’s leading organizations to build and scale cutting-edge AI applications on a unified data platform that supports real-time transactions, analytics, and search. Our platform handles streaming data ingestion, vector search, full-text search, and multi-model data types - all with high performance, petabyte-scale capacity, high user concurrency, and low latency.
  
  
As a leader recognized by both Gartner and Forrester Wave, SingleStore serves the world ‘s leading data innovators including the top Fortune 500 enterprises. Our 95%+ gross retention rate reflects the strong satisfaction and trusts our customers place in the platform. SingleStore is owned by private equity firm Vector Capital and is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices worldwide, including Hyderabad.
  
  
*To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.*

d3d4173b.title: Senior Consultant | D365 F&O - PMO | Mumbai | Emerging ERP Solutions
d3d4173b.description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

As a Senior Consultant within Deloitte's Enterprise Technology & Performance practice, you will lead PMO governance, integrated planning, executive reporting, and project controls activities across Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP transformation programs and D365 application support engagements.

You will partner with Program Directors, Program Managers, Client Leadership, Delivery Leads, Implementation Partners, and Support Managers to drive governance excellence, delivery transparency, executive decision-making, service performance management, and program controls across complex ERP transformation initiatives.

The role requires strong consulting skills, governance leadership capability, stakeholder management expertise, and experience operating within large-scale enterprise transformation and application managed services environments.

  
  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  
  

Program Governance Leadership

* Lead establishment and execution of PMO governance frameworks, standards, controls, reporting processes, and operating models.

* Drive governance compliance across all program workstreams and delivery teams.

* Own governance calendars, executive review forums, steering committees, stage-gate reviews, and leadership reporting cycles.

* Ensure delivery teams adhere to agreed governance, reporting, escalation, and quality management requirements.

* Act as the primary PMO governance lead supporting Program Management, Delivery Leadership, and client executives.

* Drive governance consistency across implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support engagements.

  
  

Integrated Planning & Delivery Oversight

* Govern integrated program schedules, milestone plans, critical path activities, and dependency networks.

* Drive planning and coordination across business, functional, technical, testing, data migration, integration, deployment, support, and change management workstreams.

* Monitor overall program health, delivery performance, resource utilization, and milestone achievement.

* Identify emerging delivery risks and drive appropriate escalation and corrective action.

* Review schedule variances and challenge delivery teams on recovery and mitigation plans where required.

* Establish and monitor program KPIs and KRIs to provide visibility into delivery performance.

  
  

D365 ERP Program Governance

* Lead PMO governance across D365 ERP implementation workstreams including Finance, Supply Chain Management, Project Operations, Data Migration, Integrations, Security, Testing, Technical Architecture, and Organizational Change Management.

* Govern design, build, testing, deployment, cutover, go-live, hypercare, and transition activities.

* Monitor environment readiness, release readiness, testing readiness, and deployment schedules.

* Lead cutover readiness governance and support go-live decision-making processes.

* Govern data migration readiness, integration testing milestones, and associated dependencies.

* Track program-level dependencies and readiness indicators across all implementation phases.

* Ensure appropriate governance and reporting throughout hypercare and transition-to-support activities.

  
  

D365 ERP Support, AMS & Operate Governance

* Lead PMO governance activities across D365 ERP support, enhancement, application management, managed services, and operate engagements.

* Establish governance frameworks, reporting mechanisms, KPIs, and service management controls for support programs.

* Govern SLA performance, service delivery metrics, backlog management, ticket resolution performance, and operational risks.

* Drive governance reviews for incidents, service requests, enhancement pipelines, release schedules, and service improvement initiatives.

* Monitor support team capacity, resource utilization, demand forecasting, and operational delivery performance.

* Provide leadership visibility into service performance, recurring issues, escalation trends, support risks, and enhancement delivery status.

* Govern service transition activities from implementation programs into steady-state support operations.

* Coordinate with client leadership, support managers, vendors, and delivery teams to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.

  
  

Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Management

* Own production of executive dashboards, steering committee packs, governance reports, operational reviews, and leadership presentations.

* Provide program performance insights and recommendations to Program Managers, Delivery Leaders, and client executives.

* Facilitate executive governance forums and drive timely closure of key decisions and actions.

* Build strong client relationships and serve as a trusted advisor on program governance matters.

* Present project and operational performance reporting to senior stakeholders.

* Ensure alignment across client stakeholders, implementation teams, support teams, vendors, and leadership groups.

  
  

Risk, Issue, Dependency & Decision Governance

* Establish and drive RAID governance processes across programs and support engagements.

* Govern program-level risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions, and decisions.

* Facilitate risk reviews, escalation forums, and leadership reviews.

* Monitor effectiveness of mitigation plans and ensure closure of critical actions.

* Provide leadership visibility into key delivery risks, service risks, and program constraints.

* Govern decision logs and ensure timely resolution of pending decisions.

* Escalate critical risks and issues through established governance structures.

  
  

Financial & Resource Governance

* Govern program financial reporting, budget tracking, forecasting, and variance management.

* Monitor resource demand, utilization, workforce planning, capacity management, and staffing risks.

* Support commercial and delivery leadership through financial and resource analytics.

* Oversee governance of implementation partners, managed service providers, and vendor delivery commitments.

* Monitor program and support engagement performance against agreed contractual and commercial objectives.

* Drive visibility into financial, resourcing, and operational risks.

  
  

PMO Capability Development

* Drive PMO process standardization, governance enhancement, and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Lead enhancement of project controls, reporting frameworks, governance templates, dashboards, and PMO methodologies.

* Support PMO audits, assessments, quality reviews, and compliance activities.

* Coach and mentor consultants and junior PMO resources.

* Contribute to the growth and maturity of Deloitte's ERP PMO and Transformation Management Office capabilities.

* Promote adoption of PMO best practices across projects and managed services engagements.

  
  
  
  

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

* 6-9 years of PMO, Program Management Office, Transformation Office, Project Controls, or Governance experience.

* Experience across at least two end-to-end ERP implementation programs.

* Experience supporting ERP implementation programs and/or application management, managed services, support, enhancement, or operate engagements.

* Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP implementation experience strongly preferred.

* Experience supporting large-scale business transformation, shared services transformation, or multi-country ERP deployment programs.

* Demonstrated experience interacting with senior client stakeholders, executive leadership, and steering committees.

  
  

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Program governance and PMO leadership.

* Executive reporting and steering committee management.

* Integrated planning and dependency management.

* Financial governance and resource management.

* RAID and decision governance.

* Stakeholder management and executive communications.

* Ability to influence delivery teams and challenge delivery performance where required.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and consulting skills.

* Understanding of IT service management concepts including SLA management, incident management, service request management, release management, enhancement governance, and service performance reporting.

  
  

**TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES**

* Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.

* Azure DevOps, Jira, Microsoft Project, or equivalent project management tools.

* Power BI and executive dashboarding solutions.

* Collaboration and documentation management platforms.

  
  

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

* PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-PBA, PMI-ACP, SAFe Agilist, or equivalent certifications.

  
  

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Science, Commerce, CA, or related discipline.

* MBA preferred.

  
  

**SUCCESS Metrics**

* Effective governance across ERP transformation programs and managed services engagements.

* High-quality executive reporting, steering committee management, and governance leadership.

* Reliable visibility into program health, risks, dependencies, financial performance, and resource utilization.

* Successful governance of testing, cutover, go-live, hypercare, and transition-to-support activities.

* Effective governance of support operations, enhancement delivery, ticket backlog management, and SLA compliance.
