65634824.title: M365 End User Computing Architect
65634824.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**
-----------------

The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and evolution of the organization's end user technology ecosystem. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for the Microsoft 365 platform and related productivity, collaboration, and security services — driving adoption, standardization, and innovation across the enterprise.

The EUC Architect partners closely with business stakeholders, IT operations teams, security, and enterprise architecture to ensure the end user environment is modern, resilient, and aligned with organizational objectives. This individual operates at both the strategic and hands-on technical level, owning architectural decisions from concept through implementation.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own the end-to-end architectural vision and roadmap for the Microsoft 365 tenant, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, and the broader M365 suite
* Define and enforce tenant configuration standards, governance policies, and design patterns across all M365 workloads
* Lead architectural decisions for Microsoft Copilot adoption, including readiness assessments, data governance prerequisites, and rollout strategy
* Design and maintain identity and access architecture in partnership with the IAM team, including Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access, SSPR, MFA, and hybrid identity models
* Architect Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager solutions for device management, compliance policies, application delivery, and Autopilot provisioning
* Establish architecture for Microsoft Purview (Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, eDiscovery, Compliance Manager) and advise on data governance posture
* Drive the strategy for Microsoft Viva, Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI), and low-code/no-code citizen development governance

**End User Computing Strategy**
-------------------------------

* Define the long-term EUC strategy spanning physical endpoints (Windows, macOS), virtual desktop infrastructure (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365), and mobile platforms (iOS, Android) via Microsoft Intune
* Lead endpoint lifecycle architecture including OS imaging, patching strategy, hardware standards, and Windows 11 migration planning
* Architect solutions for remote and hybrid work scenarios, ensuring performance, security, and user experience parity regardless of location
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and communicate business value and architectural impact to leadership

**Governance & Standards**
--------------------------

* Develop and maintain EUC architecture standards, reference architectures, and design documentation
* Establish M365 governance frameworks including tenant policies, external sharing controls, Teams provisioning governance, and data residency requirements
* Define and socialize naming conventions, RBAC models, licensing optimization strategies, and change management processes
* Conduct architecture reviews for EUC-impacting projects and provide design authority sign-off

**Security & Compliance**
-------------------------

* Partner with the Information Security team to integrate Zero Trust principles throughout the EUC environment
* Architect solutions leveraging Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, and the broader Microsoft Defender XDR suite
* Ensure EUC architecture aligns with regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, FINRA, GDPR) as applicable to the business

**Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership**
---------------------------------------

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on EUC and M365 capabilities, roadmap, and investment priorities
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, networking, and application teams to ensure integrated, cohesive solutions
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to EUC engineers and administrators
* Represent EUC architecture in governance forums, architecture review boards, and vendor engagements
* Partner with Microsoft account teams and FastTrack resources to leverage available programs and stay ahead of platform changes

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in an architecture or senior engineering role focused on end user computing or Microsoft 365.
* Deep, hands-on expertise across the core Microsoft 365 workloads:

  + **Collaboration & Productivity:** Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Viva
  + **Identity & Access:** Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access, MFA, Privileged Identity Management
  + **Device Management:** Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Windows Autopilot
  + **Security:** Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365
  + **Compliance:** Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, DLP, eDiscovery
  + **Automation & Platform:** Power Platform, Microsoft Graph API
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing M365 tenant architecture in large, complex enterprise environments
* Strong understanding of hybrid identity models, Azure AD Connect, and cloud-only identity scenarios
* Experience with virtual desktop technologies (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms and their integration with M365 tooling (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Strong documentation skills with ability to produce architecture diagrams, reference designs, and decision records

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* **Technical Depth:** Expert-level command of M365 platform capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns
* **Strategic Vision:** Ability to translate business requirements into a coherent, future-state EUC architecture
* **Communication:** Clear and compelling communicator to both technical and executive audiences
* **Problem Solving:** Structured thinker who can diagnose complex, cross-domain issues and drive resolution
* **Collaboration:** Builds trust across teams; effective in cross-functional and matrixed environments
* **Governance Mindset:** Proactively establishes guardrails and standards without creating unnecessary friction

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Microsoft certifications, including one or more of:

  + Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert
  + Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
  + Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate
  + Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate
  + Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot for M365 deployment planning and AI-readiness assessments
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and their application in enterprise EUC environments
* Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.)
* Background in enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman)

We are a small, fast-moving team working with Technology leader, CX Transformation and operations leaders and growing businesses. Joining us means owning outcomes end to end, from the first customer conversation to a live deployment.

We are hiring a Program Manager with 4-8 years of experience to run the commercial and delivery engine of our AI products. You will drive pre-sales and sales enablement, open new business, and then own the delivery and coordination of the projects you help win.  
This is a start-up role with real breadth: one week you are shaping a proposal and demo for a contact-centre prospect, the next you are running a go-live with engineering and the customer's operations team. You will be the connective tissue between founders, sales, engineering, data science and customers.

Program Manager  
   
Experience  
4-8 years

Founder   
   
Location  
Remote

Full-time

Preferred qualifications

3d62562c.title: Engineering Manager, AI & Cloud Solutions
3d62562c.description:
**About Vanguard** Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.

**Vanguard India**

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.

**Role Summary**

The Engineering Manager is responsible for leading and developing a team of engineers delivering cloud-native and AI-enabled solutions. This role combines people leadership with technical oversight and hands-on implementation, providing guidance, coaching, and support to engineering teams while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The manager partners closely with stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of technology solutions, supports technical decision-making, and helps teams navigate complex and evolving business challenges. **Responsibilities**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, mentoring, and career development support for engineers and technical team members.
* Partner with engineering teams to guide technical decisions, remove delivery obstacles, and ensure alignment with established engineering standards and best practices.
* Support the successful delivery of cloud-native applications, AI-enabled solutions, APIs, and technology platforms.
* Contribute to implementation as needed, including writing and reviewing code, building prototypes and proofs of concept, and resolving complex technical issues alongside the team.
* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to understand priorities, align resources, and drive execution against strategic goals.
* Foster a culture of innovation, knowledge sharing, accountability, and continuous learning across the team.
* Help teams manage competing priorities and make timely, effective decisions in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
* Monitor team health, delivery progress, operational performance, and key outcomes, identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Support workforce planning, resource allocation, hiring, onboarding, and succession planning activities.
* Ensure adherence to security, risk management, compliance, and technology governance standards.
* Encourage adoption of modern engineering practices, automation, cloud technologies, and AI-driven solutions where appropriate.
* Build strong partnerships across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups and effectively communicate team priorities, progress, and outcomes.
* Participate in strategic initiatives and other leadership responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Proven experience leading and developing engineering teams in a technology-driven environment.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, cloud-native application development, and technology delivery.
* Working knowledge of AWS cloud technologies, AI/LLM-powered solutions, APIs, and modern application architectures.
* Hands-on proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, GitHub, deployment pipelines, and Agile development practices.
* Experience supporting technical decision-making, solution delivery, and engineering execution across multiple initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop engineers while fostering a positive and inclusive team culture.
* Experience operating in ambiguous environments and helping teams navigate change, uncertainty, and evolving priorities.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Technical leader with a strong engineering foundation and a passion for developing people.
* Comfortable guiding teams through complex technical and business challenges and contributing directly to implementation when needed.
* Demonstrates intellectual curiosity, learning agility, and a growth mindset.
* Encourages innovation and experimentation while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
* Thrives in fast-paced environments and brings a proactive, ownership-driven approach to leadership.
* Builds trust, develops talent, and creates an environment where teams can perform at their best.

**Location**

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

**Our mission**

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

**Our commitment to you**

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success-at work and in life-with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:

**Financial wellness**  We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.

**Physical wellness** We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.

**Personal wellness**  We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

**How we work**

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

bd455675.title: Security Architect
bd455675.description:
**Project Role :**Security Architect  
 **Project Role Description :**Define the cloud security framework and architecture, ensuring it meets the business requirements and performance goals. Document the implementation of the cloud security controls and transition to cloud security-managed operations.   
**Must have skills :**Industry X Security  
 **Good to have skills :**NA  
Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  
 **Educational Qualification :**15 years full time education  
  
**Summary**:  
  
As an Application Security Consultant, your typical day involves performing security assessments, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing across web applications, mobile applications, APIs, cloud environments, and network infrastructures. You will be responsible for identifying security vulnerabilities, recommending remediation strategies, and implementing robust security controls to protect critical business assets. You will leverage your expertise in application security, threat modeling, security testing methodologies, DevSecOps practices, and security frameworks to enhance the organization''s security posture while supporting clients in managing evolving cyber threats.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:  
  
Expected to perform independently and become an SME.  
Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.  
Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.  
Perform security assessments, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing across web applications, mobile applications, APIs, cloud platforms, and network environments.  
Conduct security research and vulnerability analysis to identify emerging threats and security risks.  
Architect, strategize, recommend, and implement application security solutions to address business and technical security requirements.  
Perform threat modeling, secure code reviews, vulnerability assessments, reverse engineering, and security testing activities.  
Lead solution engineering activities and oversee project delivery for security engagements.  
Collaborate with business development and solution engineering teams to translate business opportunities into security solutions and technical requirements.  
Support the development of new cybersecurity capabilities, services, frameworks, and offerings.  
Assist in presales activities, proposal development, and marketing initiatives related to Application Security, Cloud Security, and Industrial Security services.  
Provide guidance and recommendations on secure development lifecycle practices and security best practices.  
Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate security throughout the software development and deployment lifecycle.  
Mentor team members and contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives across the organization.  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:  
  
Must To Have Skills:  
Application Security, Web Application Security, Mobile Application Security (Android & iOS), API Security, Cloud Security, Network Security, Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT).  
Good To Have Skills:Container Security, Embedded Security, IoT/IIoT Security, DevSecOps.  
Minimum 6 years of experience in Security Research, Security Consulting, Security Assessments, and Penetration Testing engagements.  
Strong expertise in architecting, strategizing, recommending, and implementing security solutions.  
Extensive experience with security threats, vulnerability research, and secure software development lifecycle best practices.  
Hands-on experience in threat modeling, security code reviews, vulnerability assessments, reverse engineering, exploitation techniques, mitigation development, fuzzing, and penetration testing.  
Experience with Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and Threat Modeling methodologies.  
Hands-on experience with industry-standard security testing tools including Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nessus, Fortify SCA, WebInspect, Black Duck, IBM AppScan, Acunetix, Netsparker, Wireshark, Nmap, Drozer, and Kali Linux.  
Strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems from a security testing perspective.  
Experience in programming and scripting languages such as Java, Python, Perl, and Ruby.  
Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.  
Good exposure to cybersecurity standards and frameworks including PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST, OWASP, WASC, HIPAA, SOX, and MITRE ATT&CK Framework.  
Ability to lead solution engineering engagements and manage end-to-end security project delivery.  
Strong understanding of risk management, security architecture, and secure application development practices.  
Mandatory possession of one or more industry-recognized security certifications such as CEH, CHFI, ECSA, OSCP, CISSP, CISO, CISM, CompTIA Security+, or GSEC.  
  
Additional Information:  
  
The candidate should have a minimum of 6 years of experience in Application Security, Security Consulting, and Penetration Testing.  
Experience supporting security presales activities, capability development, and cybersecurity service creation will be an added advantage.  
Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential.  
Demonstrated ability to deliver results while working effectively in cross-functional teams.  
Experience in secure software development lifecycle practices and DevSecOps implementation is preferred.  
This position is based at multiple locations.  
A 15 years full time education is required.   
  
**Qualification**  
15 years full time education

0b6d9dbb.title: Solution Architect, ISV, AGS-APJ-India-ISV-SA
0b6d9dbb.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
In this role, your technical depth, business aptitude, and ability to steer technology discussions at all levels will enable you to shape the customer journey. Your thought leadership, ability to look beyond the technology, and more holistically at the value technology creates for our customers, is crucial to your success.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers, AWS and partners, and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. You will go beyond the technical solution architecture, work with partners, sellers and specialists to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.
  
  
**About The Team**
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India, working with the customers to help drive AWS services adoption.
  
  
**About AWS**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

1d75910d.title: Consulting Architect - Search

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

**Consulting Architect**
to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.

Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. 5c2a55fa.title: Solution Architect, ISV, AGS-APJ-India-ISV-SA
5c2a55fa.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
In this role, your technical depth, business aptitude, and ability to steer technology discussions at all levels will enable you to shape the customer journey. Your thought leadership, ability to look beyond the technology, and more holistically at the value technology creates for our customers, is crucial to your success.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers, AWS and partners, and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. You will go beyond the technical solution architecture, work with partners, sellers and specialists to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.
  
  
**About The Team**
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India, working with the customers to help drive AWS services adoption.
  
  
**About AWS**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. This role requires proven experience leading teams, shaping solution strategy, and responding to complex RFPs in enterprise environments.

* Create sales collateral such as whitepapers, PoV decks, and solution blueprints tailored to industry needs.
* Engage with C-suite executives and business leaders to evangelize AI/GenAI solutions and shape client roadmaps.

Solution Architecture & Delivery
  
  

* Define end-to-end AI/GenAI architectures, including model selection, training pipelines, RAG, multi-agent systems, governance, and observability.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and compliant AI solutions.
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure successful design-to-delivery handoff.
* Establish frameworks for AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices.

Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Manage and mentor a team of solution architects, data scientists, and engineers.
* Drive knowledge sharing across practices through playbooks, reusable accelerators, and best practices.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (cloud, data, security, domain SMEs) to build integrated solutions.

**Key Skills:**

* 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, AI/ML, or data platforms, with at least 3–5 years in AI/GenAI initiatives.
* Demonstrated pre-sales experience: RFP responses, PoVs, workshops, and deal support. is a must
* Strong portfolio of sales/marketing assets (whitepapers, solution blueprints, reference architectures).
* Hands-on expertise with AI/GenAI stacks (e.g., LangChain /LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks).
* Understanding of AI governance and compliance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, Microsoft RAI Maturity Model).
* Proven team leadership experience, including mentoring and managing architects/engineers.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and client-facing skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience in consulting, pre-sales, or solutioning for Fortune 500 clients.
* Exposure to industry verticals (finance, healthcare, retail, insurance, etc.).
* Familiarity with multi-agent architectures, advanced RAG, and LLMOps pipelines.
* Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or AI/ML specializations.

Orion is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Package Consultant specializing in Oracle Finance Cloud, you will streamline clients' financial operations through the implementation of Oracle Finance Cloud solutions. You will design and configure Oracle finance applications to improve data accuracy, reporting, and operational efficiency across the organization.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Design Oracle Finance Solutions: Design and configure Oracle finance applications to meet client requirements, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and regulatory standards.

* Ensure Compliance: Ensure Oracle Finance Cloud solutions comply with regulatory standards and industry best practices, maintaining data accuracy and operational efficiency.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to Oracle Finance Cloud: Experience working with Oracle Finance Cloud solutions, including designing and configuring finance applications to improve data accuracy, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Understanding of Industry Best Practices: Familiarity with industry best practices for financial operations, including data accuracy, reporting, and regulatory standards.
* Knowledge of Oracle Modules: Exposure to Oracle Finance Cloud modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, Expenses, Collections, Tax, and Oracle Cloud Reporting.
* Implementation Experience: Experience implementing cloud-based financial solutions, aligning with clients' business goals and regulatory standards.
* Configuration Skills: Ability to configure Oracle finance applications to meet client requirements, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and regulatory standards.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Oracle Finance Cloud Expertise: Exposure to Oracle Finance Cloud solutions, including designing and configuring finance applications to improve data accuracy, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Industry Best Practices Knowledge: Familiarity with industry best practices for financial operations, including data accuracy, reporting, and regulatory standards.
* Cloud-Based Financial Solutions: Experience implementing cloud-based financial solutions, aligning with clients' business goals and regulatory standards.

559edfa4.title: Data Engineer / Cloud Engineer (AWS)
559edfa4.description:
**Job Description Data Engineer / Cloud Engineer (AWS)**

**Position:** Data Engineer / Cloud Engineer  
 **Experience:** 6-8 Years  
 **Location:** Pune  
 **Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled **Data Engineer / Cloud Engineer** with strong expertise in AWS cloud services, modern data engineering practices, and scalable data platform development. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing and building cloud-native data solutions, developing large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines, and implementing DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code practices. Exposure to **Microsoft Copilot, Generative AI, and AI/ML technologies** is highly desirable.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and cloud-native data solutions on AWS.
* Build and optimize ETL/ELT processes for structured and unstructured data.
* Develop and manage data lakes and data warehouse architectures.
* Work with large-scale distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and automate cloud deployments.
* Design and manage containerized workloads using Kubernetes.
* Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support efficient software delivery.
* Collaborate with data scientists, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions.
* Explore and leverage AI/ML and Generative AI capabilities to enhance business outcomes.
* Ensure data quality, reliability, security, and governance across cloud environments.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues and drive continuous platform improvements.
* A hands-on AWS Data Engineer with strong cloud engineering capabilities, experience in building scalable data platforms, and exposure to Copilot/GenAI technologies, capable of driving end-to-end data modernization initiatives.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Cloud & Data Engineering**

* AWS Services: **S3, RDS, Glue, EMR, Lambda**
* Data Lake and Data Warehouse Architecture
* ETL/ELT Pipeline Development
* Data Modeling and Performance Optimization

**Programming & Big Data**

* Python
* Scala
* Apache Spark

**Databases**

* SQL Databases: MySQL, Redshift
* NoSQL Databases: MongoDB
* Strong SQL and data querying skills

**DevOps & Infrastructure**

* Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Kubernetes and Containerized Applications
* CI/CD Pipeline Development
* DevOps Best Practices

**AI & Emerging Technologies**

* AI/ML Fundamentals
* Generative AI Fundamentals
* Experience with **Microsoft Copilot** or other Agentic AI tools

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise-scale cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
* Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance best practices.
* Exposure to MLOps and AI-driven automation frameworks.
* AWS Certification(s) preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting mindset.
* Passion for learning and adopting new technologies.

c7dbac94.title: Lead Architect – Snowflake
c7dbac94.description:
Position Description  
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.  
  
Job Title: Lead Architect  
Position: Lead Architect  
Experience: 15+  
Category: Infrastructure
  
Shift: Timing/rotation etc. details  
Main location: Bangalore  
Position ID: J1026-2284  
Employment Type: Full Time  
  
Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 3 years of relevant experience.  
  
Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of Snowflake based data solutions. The role will guide technical teams and stakeholders through solution design, establish delivery standards, and ensure that the data platform is secure, scalable, well governed, and cost effective.

. Review solution designs and code, resolve complex technical issues, and support implementation and production readiness.  
. Lead technical discussions with business stakeholders, client teams, and delivery partners; translate requirements into practical solutions.  
. Mentor developers and consultants and promote consistent engineering practices.  
. Contribute to estimates, technical proposals, roadmaps, and delivery plans.  
  
Required skills and experience  
  
. Strong experience architecting, designing, and implementing Snowflake solutions.  
. Deep knowledge of Snowflake architecture, SQL, data modeling, data integration, and performance tuning.  
. Experience designing enterprise scale data platforms and migration or modernization solutions.  
. Strong understanding of data security, access management, governance, and operational controls.  
. Experience leading technical teams and engaging with senior business and technology stakeholders.  
. Ability to explain architectural decisions clearly and balance business needs with technical considerations.  
  
Preferred  
  
. Experience in banking, financial services, or the credit union sector.  
. Knowledge of financial data domains such as deposits, lending, cards, payments, customer data, risk, or regulatory reporting.  
. Familiarity with banking security, privacy, audit, and data retention requirements.  
. Experience with cloud platforms and common data integration, orchestration, and analytics tools.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  
  
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

89ef926a.title: Lead Dynamics 365 Solution Architect & Squad Lead
89ef926a.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role:**

  

As a Lead Dynamics 365 Solution Architect & Squad Lead, you will own the end-to-end architecture, technical design, delivery governance, and operational success of enterprise Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Power Platform solutions. You will lead multidisciplinary delivery squads, define scalable and secure architecture standards, provide technical leadership across development and integration teams, and ensure successful delivery across implementation, enhancement, modernization, and application management engagements.

  

**What Will You Do:**

  

* Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Power Platform, Dataverse, Azure, and enterprise integration solutions.
* Translate business, functional, data, integration, security, and operational requirements into scalable, secure, and supportable technical solutions.
* Design solutions leveraging Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Customer Insights, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Dataverse, and related Microsoft technologies.
* Lead multidisciplinary Agile squads comprising architects, developers, functional consultants, integration specialists, testers, and support teams.
* Define architecture standards, reusable patterns, security frameworks, ALM practices, development governance, and quality assurance processes.
* Architect and govern enterprise integrations using Dynamics 365 APIs, Dataverse APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, and REST services.
* Oversee data architecture, migration, modernization, release management, DevOps, environment strategy, and production support governance.
Act as the primary technical authority for stakeholders, driving architecture decisions, risk management, technical reviews, modernization initiatives, and continuous improvement programs.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
At Kyndryl, we understand the importance of investing in our employees' professional growth and development. In Network Services, you can expect to receive a lot of support for training programs to keep your skills and knowledge up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects and contribute to the development of innovative solutions for our customers – including new wireless and 5G technologies – not yet adopted by most companies.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* 10–15 years of experience, including significant experience delivering Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM/Customer Engagement solutions in Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Technical Lead, or Squad Lead capacities.
* Deep expertise in Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power Platform architecture.
* Strong hands-on development experience with C#, .NET, Plugins, Custom APIs, JavaScript, TypeScript, Web Resources, and Dynamics 365 extensibility frameworks.
* Proven experience designing enterprise integrations using Dynamics 365 Web API, Dataverse APIs, REST APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, and Azure integration technologies.
* Strong expertise in Dynamics 365 security architecture, including Business Units, Security Roles, Teams, Hierarchy Security, Record Sharing, and Field-Level Security.
* Experience leading enterprise-scale data migration, transformation, cleansing, deduplication, reconciliation, and data modernization initiatives.
* Strong experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD, Power Platform Pipelines, Managed Solutions, Environment Management, Release Management, and Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).
Proven leadership experience managing Agile delivery squads, conducting architecture reviews, mentoring technical teams, driving technical governance, and engaging with senior business and technology stakeholders.  

  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

  

* Experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Insights, Field Service, Omnichannel for Customer Service, Customer Service Workspace, or Contact Center solutions.
* Experience developing Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) controls, Power Pages solutions, and Microsoft Copilot Studio implementations.
* Strong knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure Monitor, Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience with enterprise migration and administration tools such as SSIS, KingswaySoft, XrmToolBox, Plugin Registration Tool, Ribbon Workbench, and Configuration Migration Tool.
Relevant Microsoft certifications in Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure Solutions Architecture, or Power Platform Solution Architect Expert are highly desirable.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

2f43ce58.title: TechOps1-DE-CloudOpsAMS-SAP AMS SDM-Manager
2f43ce58.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SAP Team Manager - TechOps - Application Management - Consultant**
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an SAP Team Manager to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS – TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for SAP across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize design to meet business requirements.
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
* 8-10 Years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP functional areas preferably with Global client
* Deep understanding of ITIL and ITSM processes and methodology and how it interacts with the application lifecycle management principles
* Ability to manage cross functional and technical team, give them directions and drive functional and technical discussions with various stake holders
* Proven track record of successfully driving solutions in a complex, multi-platform environment
* Extensive in client management working with various regions in a global setting
* Depth of experience in setting up, growing, transforming, and delivering application management teams
* Strong leadership and team building skills with the ability to inspire and motivate teams to achieve excellence
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels in the organization
* Strong client management, analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to think strategically and make data driven decisions
* Responsible for providing support within the SAP domain expert module for incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
* Support incident solving by analyzing incidents raised by users and provides solutions.
* Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed-up and addressed timely.
* Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.
* Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.
* Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onshore model.
* Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
* Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* Experience with both S/4HANA and ECC
* Strong knowledge of SAP integration points with other SAP cross modules like FICO, MM, SD, HR, PP and PM.
* SAP Certification in any functional domain
* Experience in good Team management skills, People skills, communication, soft skills etc
* Expertise in working with Onshore teams with good co-ordination and collaboration

**What you will do:**

* Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
* Lead and mentor the cross functional team fostering culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement
* Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP solutions and designs.
* Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.
* Mentor and train junior SAP functional and technical Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.
* Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
* Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client (AUSTRALIA, ASIA, Europe and AMERICAS hours)

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of hundreds of professionals.
* Opportunities to work with EY SAP application maintenance, practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

**What working at EY offers:**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

0b64c660.title: Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2)
0b64c660.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) is a developing engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational.
  
  
Through the proactive monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving of technical incidents and problems, the Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) is able to restore service to clients.
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to proactively review client requests or tickets and apply technical/process knowledge to resolve them without breaching service level agreement (SLA).
  
  
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) focuses on second-line support for incidents and requests with a medium level of complexity and focusses across two or more technology domains - Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications and / or Collaboration etc.
  
  
This role may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Proactively monitors the work queues.
* Performs operational tasks to resolve all incidents/requests in a timely manner and within the agreed SLA.
* Updates tickets with resolution tasks performed.
* Identifies, investigates, analyses issues and errors prior to or when they occur, and logs all such incidents in a timely manner.
* Captures all required and relevant information for immediate resolution.
* Provides second level support to all incidents, requests and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Communicates with other teams and clients for extending support.
* Executes changes with clear identification of risks and mitigation plans to be captured into the change record.
* Follows the shift handover process highlighting any key tickets to be focussed on along with a handover of upcoming critical tasks to be carried out in the next shift.
* Escalates all tickets to seek the right focus from CoE and other teams, if needed continue the escalations to management.
* Works with automation teams for effort optimization and automating routine tasks.
* Ability to work across various other resolver group (internal and external) like Service Provider, TAC, etc.
* Identifies problems and errors before they impact a client’s service.
* Provides Assistance to L1 Security Engineers for better initial triage or troubleshooting.
* Leads and manages all initial client escalation for operational issues.
* Contributes to the change management process by logging all change requests with complete details for standard and non-standard including patching and any other changes to Configuration Items.
* Ensures all changes are carried out with proper change approvals.
* Plans and executes approved maintenance activities.
* Audits and analyses incident and request tickets for quality and recommends improvements with updates to knowledge articles.
* Produces trend analysis reports for identifying tasks for automation, leading to a reduction in tickets and optimization of effort.
* May also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**Knowledge and Attributes:**

* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role).
* Relevant certifications include (but not limited to) -

+ CCNP or equivalent certification
+ CCNA certification in must, CCNP in Security or PCNSE certification is good to have
+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
+ AWS Certified: Solutions Architect Associate
+ Veeam Certified Engineer
+ VMware certified Professional: Data Centre Virtualization
+ Zerto, pure, vxrail
+ Google Cloud Platform (gcp)
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (oci)
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate - OS DB Migration for SAP NetWeaver 7.4
+ SAP Technology Consultant
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate - SAP HANA 2.0
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
+ IBM Certified System Administrator - WebSphere Application Server Network

**Required Experience:**

* Moderate level years of relevant managed services experience handling cross technology infrastructure.
* Moderate level knowledge in ticketing tools preferably Service Now.
* Moderate level working knowledge of ITIL processes.
* Moderate level experience working with vendors and/or 3rd parties.

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

89959f26.title: Delivery Manager - Data and Analytics 4D
89959f26.description:
Delivery Manager - Data and Analytics

**Ready to turn bold ideas into real-world impact?**  
At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.  
  
If you thrive in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment.  
  
Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  
Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Architecture & Strategy**

* Define and maintain the enterprise Workfront roadmap aligned with business and operational objectives.
* Design scalable Workfront architectures that support project management, resource management, intake, demand management, and portfolio governance.
* Establish platform standards, best practices, naming conventions, and governance frameworks.
* Evaluate and recommend new Workfront capabilities, features, and platform enhancements.
* Develop long-term strategies for workflow automation, integration, and digital transformation.

**Workfront Administration & Configuration**

* Serve as the senior platform expert for Adobe Workfront administration.
* Configure and maintain: Request queuesCustom formsProject templatesPortfolios and programsDashboards and reportsResource management settingsUser permissions and access models
* Ensure platform performance, scalability, security, and compliance requirements are met.
* Lead platform upgrades, releases, testing, and deployment activities.

**Workfront Fusion Automation**

* Design, build, and maintain Workfront Fusion scenarios and integrations.
* Automate workflows across Adobe and third-party platforms.
* Develop sophisticated automation solutions to reduce manual effort and improve data quality.
* Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and exception-handling processes for automation scenarios.
* Optimize existing Fusion solutions to improve performance and reliability.
* Create reusable automation frameworks and templates.

**Integration Architecture**

* Lead integration strategy between Workfront and enterprise platforms including: CRM systems (Salesforce, Dynamics)Marketing automation platformsDAM platforms (Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore)ERP and finance systemsCollaboration tools (Microsoft Teams, SharePoint)Data and analytics platforms
* Define API requirements and integration patterns.
* Collaborate with IT teams and developers to implement secure, scalable integrations.
* Ensure data integrity and consistency across connected systems.

**Business Process Optimization**

* Assess current-state processes and identify opportunities for automation and simplification.

47be95ff.description:
**About the job**

We are looking for a Program Manager to lead our K-12 Makerspace and Innovation programs from concept to classroom. You will guide a cross-functional team of developers, designers, and curriculum specialists to build engaging, hands-on learning experiences. You will also work directly with schools and educators to make sure the programs deliver real learning outcomes.

**Program & Team Leadership**

* Plan, manage, and deliver Makerspace and Innovation programs across multiple schools or client accounts.
* Lead and coordinate the development team, setting sprint goals, timelines, and priorities.
* Manage program budgets, resources, risks, and delivery milestones.
* Run regular reviews and report progress to leadership and stakeholders.
* Plan, manage, and deliver Makerspace and Innovation programs across multiple schools or client accounts.
* Lead and coordinate the engineering team of Full Stack, Frontend (FE), and Backend (BE) developers, setting sprint goals, timelines, and priorities.
* Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and keep FE, BE, and design work in sync.
* Manage releases, code review cycles, and QA handoffs with the engineering team.
* Manage program budgets, resources, risks, and delivery milestones.
* Report progress to leadership and stakeholders.

**Curriculum Design (K-12)**

* Design and oversee age-appropriate, project-based curriculum for Grades K-12 in areas such as robotics, electronics, coding, 3D printing, design thinking, and STEAM.

* Create lesson plans, project kits, assessment rubrics, and teacher guides.
* Review and update content regularly using classroom feedback and learning outcomes.
* **Lead the design function:** define design roles (UI/UX, learning material, and Makerspace/kit designers), set design standards, and manage design reviews and timelines.
* Work with designers to turn wireframes and prototypes into working features, keeping design and engineering aligned through handoffs in Figma and GitHub.
* Translate educational goals into clear user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria for Full Stack, FE, and BE developers.
* Oversee the development of learning platforms, dashboards, and digital tools, from prototype to launch.
* Own the product backlog and roadmap, balancing technical constraints, timelines, and classroom needs.

Customer Training & Enablement

* **Design the customer training framework** for schools, teachers, administrators, and students, including onboarding, certification, and ongoing professional development.
* Create training materials such as workshop decks, teacher guides, video tutorials, hands-on kit guides, quick-start manuals, and FAQs.
* Plan and deliver training in multiple formats: in-person workshops, virtual sessions, and self-paced modules.
* **Build and manage a trainer team** (internal trainers, master trainers, or partners), including training-the-trainer programs and quality standards.
* Schedule and coordinate training across schools, managing logistics, timelines, and resources.
* Track training effectiveness through attendance, feedback scores, teacher confidence, adoption rates, and student outcomes.
* Continuously improve training content using classroom observations and customer feedback.
* Set up support channels (helpdesk, community, office hours) to keep customers successful after training.

**Product & Design Collaboration**

* Work with designers on learning materials, digital platforms, and Makerspace layouts.
* Translate educational goals into clear requirements for the development team.
* Oversee the development of learning tools, platforms, or kits, from prototype to launch.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the main contact for schools, administrators, and educators.
* Conduct product demos, pilot programs, and workshops.
* Gather feedback from teachers and students and turn it into program improvements.
* Support Makerspace setup, teacher onboarding, and ongoing training.

Program & Team Leadership

* Plan, manage, and deliver Makerspace and Innovation programs across multiple schools or client accounts.

* Lead and coordinate the engineering team, setting sprint goals, timelines, and priorities.
* Run agile ceremonies and keep FE, BE, and design work in sync.
* Set team goals and KPIs, conduct regular performance check-ins, and mentor team members.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Manage program budgets, resources, risks, and delivery milestones.

* **Master's degree** (M.Tech, MBA, or equivalent) with a **B.Tech / B.E.** in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **12+ years of experience** in program or project management, ideally in EdTech, STEM education, or innovation programs, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Proven experience leading and scaling cross-functional teams of Full Stack, Frontend, and Backend developers and designers.
* Experience building and managing teams, including hiring, onboarding, and performance management.
