6f9e5518.title: Technical Program Manager - Engineering
6f9e5518.description:
What You'll Do
  
  
Avalara is building the future of tax compliance infrastructure, operating at a massive scale that processes billions of transactions for hundreds of thousands of customers globally. As a Technical Program Manager in Engineering, you will bring disciplined, data-informed, and AI-enabled program leadership to our most critical initiatives.
  
  
You’ll act as a force multiplier for engineering velocity, connecting strategy to execution across our global teams spanning Product, Architecture, Platform Engineering, Security, and Cloud Operations. This role is essential to our ability to ship at scale with predictability and visibility, as you will build the analytical infrastructure that makes delivery reliable and communicate complex technical realities with the clarity needed for confident leadership decisions.
  
  
You will join the Engineering Operations team, reporting to the
**Sr Director, Technical Program Management**
. This role is
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Drive end-to-end planning, execution, dependency mapping, and delivery of mission-critical, multi-team engineering programs.
* Proactively surface hidden technical assumptions, resolve complex inter-service dependencies, and evaluate architectural trade-offs to sustain delivery predictability and unblock teams before risks become incidents.
* Own milestone governance and escalation frameworks that keep programs aligned across global time zones and competing priorities.
* Design and optimize Jira ecosystems (filters, JQL, Advanced Roadmaps, boards) to enforce rigorous SDLC hygiene and provide clear operational visibility.
* Prototype and build custom, interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Python, Streamlit, or low-code platforms, leveraging AI-assisted development to accelerate the creation of reporting infrastructure.
* Synthesize multi-layered technical complexity into crisp, executive-ready narratives and roadmaps for VP and C-level audiences.
* Champion the adoption of cutting-edge AI developer tools, intelligent agents, and LLM-assisted workflows to structurally improve planning, analysis, and execution velocity.
* Raise the bar for execution quality by identifying meaningful AI opportunities tied to delivery efficiency, and ensuring AI is applied responsibly, securely, and ethically.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 8 to 12+ years of Technical Program Management experience in fast-paced, product-based cloud or SaaS environments.
* Demonstrated track record of managing multi-team organizational initiatives across global time zones, with strong experience aligning US and India stakeholders.
* Deep fluency with Jira and Agile/Flow metrics, including expert-level ability to design JQL queries, CFD/Kanban workflows, and delivery KPIs.
* Hands-on experience prototyping and building dashboards, scripts, and data tools using Python, Streamlit, JavaScript, or low-code frameworks.
* Familiarity with modern AI coding assistants (such as Cursor, Claude Code, or GitLab Copilot) for personal productivity, automated workflow generation, and applied AI problem-solving.
* Exceptional executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence senior leadership through clear, structured, and visually compelling communication.
* Strong technical acumen with the ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, understand API design, and reason about scaling constraints in distributed SaaS systems.
* High standards of quality, ownership, and accountability, with a demonstrated ability to simplify complexity, drive measurable outcomes, and elevate the performance and AI capability of the teams around you.

Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

460cd46c.title: Tech Infrastructure Program Manager, AWS Data Center Planning & Delivery
460cd46c.description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
  
  
Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity?
  
  
If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.
  
  
You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering with strong urge to learn will be essential.
  
  
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in India. They manage 10+ projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity.
  
  
The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
  
  
A successful TPM must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences:
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
**Work/Life Balance**
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Inclusive Team Culture**
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
**Mentorship And Career Growth**
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
* Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

- ADSIPL - Maharashtra

**Technical Program Manager**
to lead technology initiatives spanning product integration and an AWS-to-GCP cloud migration. * Prepare and distribute weekly program/status reports and present progress, risks, decisions, and actions to relevant stakeholders and senior management.
* Work with engineering and business stakeholders to continuously refine the roadmap and detailed backlog as integration and migration work progresses.
* Drive effective collaboration across geographically distributed teams, particularly India and New York.
* Maintain a strong understanding of
  **AWS and GCP**
  and the mapping of AWS services and capabilities to GCP equivalents.

* Practical understanding of cloud platforms, particularly
  **AWS and GCP**

  **GCP**

6a60ac7f.title: Technical Program Manager
6a60ac7f.description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an Technical Program Manager with a strong technical or product delivery background to join our newly established Implementation Management team.
  
  
In this role, you will independently lead cross-domain initiatives—ranging from high-volume platform migrations to regional product launches, remediation projects, and platform onboardings. You will sit within the Servicing organisation, but will align directly with partner product segments outside Servicing, leading cross-functional execution across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance.
  
  
This role demands strong stakeholder management, hands-on systems curiosity, program management rigour, pattern recognition, and a passion for process
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead Cross-Domain Initiatives: Take single-threaded ownership of high-impact, cross-squad projects—including core platform migrations, control rollouts, product launches, and partner integrations.
* Consult Partners on Platform Integration: Understand the capabilities, integration flows, and limitations of Wise’s Servicing platforms. Guide partner teams through onboarding requirements and help translate business/compliance needs into clear user stories for Implementation Engineers where necessary.
* Drive Pragmatic, Hands-On Delivery: Work comfortably at the intersection of product delivery and technical systems. You don't need to review deep technical specifications, but you are comfortable reading architecture diagrams, asking challenging technical questions, running API requests in Postman for testing, and creating dashboards or tables in Looker to track metrics.
* Manage Operational Transformation & Launch Readiness: Work with Business Operations to ensure product launches are fully supported with operational workflows, queue structures, and agent guidance.
* Drive Program Management Lifecycle: Hold the pen on end-to-end program governance—authoring clear program briefs, setting SMART objectives, managing risk logs, tracking delivery milestones, and conducting post-implementation reviews.
* Leave the Place Better Than You Found It: Assume every process executed today will be repeated tomorrow. Document workflows, automate manual steps, and establish telemetry to scale future execution.

**Qualifications**
**What You’ll Bring**

* 5+ Years of Relevant Experience: Proven track record of delivering cross-functional technical or operational projects as an Implementation Manager, Technical Program Manager (TPM), Technical Consultant, Product manager or Fintech Delivery Lead.
* Systems Literacy & Practical Technical Curiosity: Ability to interpret system architecture diagrams, ask sharp and challenging questions about technical designs, run Postman calls for testing/validation, and build basic tables/dashboards in Looker or SQL.
* Program Management Excellence: Strong foundation in project/program delivery best practices—from scoping and brief writing to designing governance structures, stakeholder reporting, and post-implementation audits.
* Exceptional Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication. Ability to adjust messaging seamlessly whether facilitating alignment with product managers, clarifying requirements with engineers, or updating business leaders.
* Pattern Recognition & Structured Thinking: Ability to absorb unstructured information across disparate domains, spot commonalities, and design standardized, repeatable frameworks.

**What You’ll Benefit From**

* Payments / FinCrime / Platform Exposure: Exposure to Fintech, Payments, Financial Crime (AML, Fraud, KYC), or platform integration projects.

Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

cdaa965c.title: Senior Program Manager - Product Portfolio & Digital Transformation
cdaa965c.description:
**Job Purpose:**

This role is responsible to lead portfolio-wide execution and governance across strategic product and technology programs. The role provides a single senior orchestration point across Business, Product, Engineering, QA, Production Support, Cloud / Infrastructure, InfoSec, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance and partners. The incumbent must combine strong subject command with executive presence, structured problem solving and the authority to challenge commitments, resolve cross-functional conflicts and drive timely decisions.

  

**Key Responsiblities:**

  

**a) Portfolio strategy translation:** Convert approved business and product priorities into an integrated execution plan, with outcomes, milestones, dependencies, decision points, investment needs and accountable owners.

  

**b) Executive stakeholder management:** Build trusted relationships with senior Business and Technology leaders. Frame issues clearly, align divergent viewpoints, secure decisions and maintain confidence through fact-based, proactive communication and tracking with proper timelines and RCAs as applicable.

  

**c) Integrated planning and prioritization:** Lead, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly and rolling planning across product pillars. Reconcile capacity, regulatory commitments, business-critical dates, technical dependencies and vendor plans; expose trade-offs for leadership decision.

  

**d) Governance and decision architecture:** Design and chair reviews, SteerCos and escalation forums. Ensure each forum has a clear purpose, accurate inputs, decision rights, actions, owners and closure discipline.

  

**e) Delivery assurance:** Independently assess programme health beyond reported RAG status. Validate critical path, milestones, resource assumptions, quality gates, readiness and benefits dependencies.

  

**f) Cross-programme dependency management:** Identify shared services, platform, data, API, security, infrastructure and partner dependencies; assign ownership and resolve sequencing conflicts before they affect delivery.

  

**g) Risk, issue and escalation management:** Maintain an executive RAID view, drive mitigation and trigger escalation at the right point. Distinguish decisions, risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies; prevent silent slippage.

  

**h) Commercial and vendor governance:** Govern delivery obligations, milestones, resource commitments, change requests, SLA performance, commercials and escalations for implementation and managed-service partners.

  

**i) Financial governance:** Track approved business cases, programme budgets, forecasts, purchase dependencies, change costs and benefit assumptions in partnership with Finance and procurement owners.

  

**j) Release and operational governance:** Ensure major releases have business, QA, Engineering, security, infrastructure, support and rollback readiness. Review recurring incidents, RCA closure and stability actions without taking over functional ownership.

  

**k) Regulatory and audit readiness:** Ensure traceability of mandatory commitments, approvals, evidence, controls, risks and closure for regulatory, compliance and audit programmes.

  

**l) Capability and standards:** Establish consistent planning, status reporting, RAID, dependency, release-readiness and decision-log standards. Coach Program Managers to become outcome-led leaders rather than coordinators.

  

**Requirements:**

  

* Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Finance or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is desirable.
* Programme / project certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum or equivalent is desirable, but demonstrated delivery leadership is more important than certification alone.
* Proven leadership of multiple, concurrent, high-complexity programmes involving business, product, engineering, operations and external partners.
* Strong understanding of lending journeys and lifecycle, including acquisition, underwriting, disbursement, servicing, collections, customer channels and partner integrations.
* Working command of agile, hybrid and milestone-based delivery; ability to challenge plans, dependencies, solution assumptions and release readiness.
* Experience with executive governance, programme financials, vendor contracts, implementation partners, risk management and organisational change.
* Ability to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, environments, security, cloud / infrastructure and production support sufficiently to ask the right questions and drive accountable closure.
* Experience in regulated financial services is strongly preferred.

You will be a valued member of the Cloud, Infrastructure and Security (CIS) Services Solution Group team and work collaboratively with onsite sales, solutions and delivery teams, and clients.

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Strong techno-commercial capability with proven customer interaction and solution presentation skills.
* Solid IT infrastructure understanding across Compute (on-prem and cloud), Network, Security, End User and Service Management, including Managed Services and Digital Transformation.
* Knowledge of pricing models, IT spend analysis, business case development, and TCO and ROI analysis.
* Familiarity with service assurance and automation tools and ITIL/ITSM processes.
* Proven track record of delivering complex solutions in a fast-paced environment with strong problem-solving skills.

**These will help you succeed**

* Awareness of industry IT trends and analyst/TPA reports such as Gartner, Everest, Forrester, ISG, BCG, HfS and IDC.
* Experience in cross-cultural and leading global outsourcing organisations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* A flexible, self-motivated, can-do approach with the ability to work well under pressure.
* Flexibility to accommodate short domestic and international business travel.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

00762fcc.title: Solutions Engineer
00762fcc.description:
**Meet the Team**
You will be in Global Enterprise Segment (GES) where we lead Cisco's top 500 strategic accounts. Our responsibility to Cisco’s business is phenomenal, and our responsibility to each other and our culture is greater. We have a dedicated focus on our customers' success, we are Cisco's growth engine and shape the company’s future. Our values customer focused Always, Show Up to Win Every Day, and Harness the Power of Cisco is how we get the job done, and our Win As One mentality embodies the spirit of the journey and how we will show up with each other, partners, and customers.
  
  
**Your Impact**
We are looking for a Solutions Engineer (SE) with Enterprise Networking, Data Center, Collaboration, Security, Automation, and Cloud background. The SE role is a customer focused technical sales professional who ensures that technical information and guidance is provided to the customer, delivering meaningful outcomes based on Cisco’s product and services portfolio. You will partner with your Account Managers in a pre-sales technical function, showcasing Cisco solutions, providing customer presentations, performing technical demonstrations, creating BoM’s, and running proof of concept activities. SE’s partner, consult, influence and design solutions to allow the customer to meet their desired outcomes. In addition to technology proficiency and the ability to learn quickly and stay ahead of; the ideal candidate's interpersonal, presentation and troubleshooting skills should evoke passion and confidence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Technology solution consultant to the customer and the Cisco account team.
* Leverage an array of Cisco technology, services, and support specialists.
* Collaborate closely with Account Manager on account planning activities.
* Educate the customer on Cisco differentiation, creating demand.
* Set brand preference to Cisco.
* Align Cisco’s product and services capabilities to customers business drivers.
* You are determined and have a long history in the Networking field.
* You will also have a strong background in large enterprises and/or large service provider IT accounts and understand how to engage new lines of business to drive understanding and preference to Cisco's Routing & Switching, Data Center, Security, and Internet of Things solutions.
* Strong business acumen and customer presence.
* Experience and comfort conversing with network and telecommunications managers as well as customer lines of business on Data Center, Security, and Retail solutions.
* As a Solutions Engineer, you'll be responsible for driving customer activities and discussions that lead to preference of Cisco's Routing & Switching, Data Center, Security, and Automation solutions.
* The focus of this position is to uncover business benefits for a customer by consulting on Cisco solutions and applications to solve business problems, working with multi-functional teams to design and present appropriate technical solution, and building joint plan of record for multiple engineering systems using Cisco products.
* You'll plan sales strategy, develop proposals, deliver customer presentations and demonstrations to close business and generate revenue.
* While customer facing engagements will be the primary role, other duties will include training colleagues on Data Center, Virtualization and MOCA topics and practices. Developing best practices in sales approaches and technical execution.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering or the broader computing/IT industry, with a strong focus on Cisco Enterprise Routing & Switching, Data Center, and Security solutions.
* In-depth knowledge of large IT environments and applications.
* Deep understanding and operational experience with a routed and switched data/voice network.
* Cisco product experience or relevant experience in key competitor offerings in technology area of emphasis required.
* Minimum CCNP or similar vendor certification required.
* Knowledge of Cisco's Solutions, networking fundamentals required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Pre-Sales experience preferred.
* Typically requires BS/BA (EE/CS) or equivalent.
* Customer intimacy skills

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

52856717.title: Solution Sales - Technical Advisor, AI & Apps, Global Black Belt
52856717.description:
**Overview**
MCAPS-Core accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable competitive advantage, driving growth that outpaces the market.
  
  
The Asia AI Apps GBB team drives Microsoft Foundry adoption across ASEAN, India and ANZ, taking lighthouse customers from AI experimentation to production agentic platforms. The team partners with Product and Engineering to shape roadmap from field signal, and with field, STU and partner teams to land and scale Foundry in the region's highest-potential accounts, including the worldwide Foundry 100 programme.
  
  
Your role as a Solution Sales Advisor, Global Black Belt in the CSA Org requires:
  
  
Influences Go-To-Market (GTM) and regional teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize high-value opportunities against targeted sales motions. Establishes and fosters relationships with key internal and external stakeholders. Leads the validation of solution capabilities and business case with targeted customers to activate field-led and partner-led motions and aligns sales processes and methods with capabilities, customer priorities, and objectives. Creates and shares content to drive sales motions and demonstrate business value. Partners with sales leaders and product teams to ensure transitioned solutions include clear Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, monetization models, and competitive positioning guidance. Influences readiness plans and proactively identifies gaps and new learning opportunities.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Sales & Opportunity Leadership**
Influences Go-To-Market (GTM) and regional teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize high-value opportunities against targeted sales motions. Conducts whitespace analysis and leverages AI-driven market intelligence tools to assess trends, gaps, and revenue potential for new and/or mainstream products or solutions, sharing insights across teams to execute on deals. Translates and shares insights on the business value of a solution, influencing regional GTM content and strategy. Contributes to pipeline acceleration and revenue realization by incubating opportunities, unblocking deals, developing business cases, demonstrating business value, and partnering with others (e.g., Deal Desk) to identify commercial pathways. Influences the holistic sales strategy for emerging workloads and opportunities, ensuring Microsoft solutions are positioned for maximum business value and are differentiated from competitors. Engages with key technical and business decision makers and customers to accelerate opportunity progression, clarify business impact, and influence strategic direction. Leads speaking engagements with key technical and business decision makers at scale. Provides sales and technical guidance to field teams to ensure consistent messaging, competitive positioning, and value articulation. Collaborates with internal executives to ensure pipeline accuracy and forecasting precision.
  
  
**Technical Leadership & Solution Incubation**
Leads the validation of solution capabilities and business case with targeted customers to activate field-led and partner-led motions and aligns sales processes and methods with capabilities, customer priorities, and objectives. Drives regional resource alignment to support landing solutions with customers. Actively provides feedback to shape future roadmaps/capabilities and aligns proposed solutions and products with those in the market regionally. Connects technical incubation decisions directly to business outcomes, return on investment (ROI), and expected value realization to strengthen customer commitment. Builds, demonstrates, and oversees demonstrations (e.g., architectural design sessions, and proof of concept [POC] sessions, pilots, hackathons) of new and/or mainstream solutions. Demonstrates and ensures clear business justification and commercial impact of early prototypes, solution patterns, and POCs at a regional level. Removes technical barriers, guides customers through adoption challenges, suggests viable alternatives to overcome challenges, and delivers early functional experiences. Analyzes and utilizes partner and competitor ecosystem knowledge to build comprehensive solutions for regional impact. Identifies gaps to connect product ecosystem and services with Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy and provides recommendations to bridge gaps.
  
  
**Senior Stakeholder Engagement**
Establishes and fosters relationships with key internal and external stakeholders. Leverages technical, domain, and industry knowledge to serve as a trusted advisor and lead conversations with strategic customers. Translates innovation concepts into commercially relevant narratives for key decision makers. Leverages predictive analytics and insights to anticipate market shifts and drive strategic discussions with key stakeholders, decision makers, and customers that influence transformation agendas.
  
  
**Intellectual Property Creation & Scaling**
Creates and shares content (e.g., blogs, whitepapers, marketing, proposals, solution patterns) to drive sales motions and demonstrate business value. Codifies competitive insights, monetization pathways, and solution patterns into scalable guidance for field roles and partners. Creates, shares, and influences use of reusable assets (e.g., sales guidance, return on investment [ROI] frameworks, business-value storytelling, commercial positioning) to accelerate field execution and gathers and incorporates feedback to scale assets. Articulates return on investment (ROI) and long-term value for emerging opportunities. Creates and positions the business case justification with customers. Builds and presents content at internal and external events (e.g., road shows, conferences, innovation hub).
  
  
**Product Feedback & Field Insight**
Partners with sales leaders and product teams to ensure transitioned solutions include clear Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, monetization models, and competitive positioning guidance. Provides structured, field-validated insights that influence product roadmaps and improve readiness for scale. Ensures graduation of mature solutions to field teams, enabling mainstream adoption and broad replication. Acts as the voice of the customer and translates insights across field teams, sales leaders, and product teams. Partners with others on strategy based on trends and patterns to help with positioning, marketing, and product definition.
  
  
**Field Enablement**
Influences readiness plans and proactively identifies gaps and new learning opportunities. Acts as a technical thought leader by sharing best practices (e.g., architectures, materials). Influences regional strategies to increase solutions/portfolio understanding, inclusive of potential delivery.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required/minimum qualifications
  
  
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Information Security, or related field AND 8+ years experience in technical solution architecture and enterprise sales, business development, strategic consulting, technical consulting, or relevant/prioritized industry (e.g., Finance, Healthcare, Retail) OR equivalent experience.
  
  
**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Information Security, or related field AND 12+ years experience in technical solution architecture and enterprise sales, business development, strategic consulting, technical consulting, or relevant/prioritized industry (e.g., Finance, Healthcare, Retail) OR equivalent experience.
  
  
Relevant technical certification(s) in cloud technologies, solution architecture, or related domain (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert) or equivalent industry certification.
  
  
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. **requesting accommodations.**

7d0368de.title: Solution Consultant
7d0368de.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
  
  
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
**Solution Consultant**
**Mumbai**
You will support sales at main customer pursuits by providing specific solution expertise in a defined geographical area. The Solution Consultant is the solution expert for the sales organization by assisting with delivering outcome-based messaging to customers at executive and management levels. The Solution Consultant has a broad understanding of all related products and delivery offerings from Rockwell, partners and competitors in the designated solution area.
  
  
You will report to the Industry & Consulting Leader and work onsite in Mumbai, India.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* You will be the focal point in the defined geography for the solution(s), of which you have been designated as an expert.
* You will participate in account planning and sales strategy focusing on new customer acquisition and existing customer expansion.
* You will facilitate and provide training to the sales team on the values and outcomes of specific solution(s).
* You will co-operate with the sales team in promoting the solution to all customers with presentations and demonstrations. Advise Technology Consultants and sales on proposal generation and validation.
* Assist sales at proposal presentations for executive level customers Define and articulate differentiators and values versus competition for the solution.
* Analyse products, have knowledge of competitor's strategy, further define competitive differentiators.
* Translate competitive solutions into a Rockwell automation solution that meets customer's expectations.
* Seek out and participate in training opportunities to develop technical skills.
* Provide product gap and development feedback for the solution to appropriate organisations.
* Share insights with peers. Focus on opportunities that support Rockwell Automation's strategy.
* Understand business models, organisation, and go-to-market strategy. Knowledge of industry strategies, familiarity with outcome-based selling.
* Share industry knowledge of customers based on their important causes at the appropriate role level with all customers. Keep sales and customer relationship management data up to date in local agreed upon tools, such as SFA, and improve by using these tools.

**The Essentials - You Will Have**

* Bachelor's degree in an engineering/technical related field or equivalent experience.
* Value of larger Rockwell Automation application value, without the need to demonstrate individual products with hands-on demonstrations Solution and application expertise, and related demonstrated sales experience. Fluency in native language and command of English (written and spoken).
* Work with and gain confidence of senior level personnel (internal and external) in a collaborative, matrixed organisation.
* Align and influence critical partners.
* Support customer centricity.
* Understand the importance of demonstrating concern for satisfying customers.
* Passionate about developing goals to improve our customer experience.
* Set, be accountable for and achieve challenging targets. empower, coach and motivate others. Communication style and messaging to different audiences.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have**

* 10+ Years of experience in consulting of Industrial automation products, proficiency in hands-on engineering.
* High level of expertise in Continuous and Batch Process Control which shall include knowledge of multiple ISA standards, practical experience designing and deploying control and electrical systems and solutions, High level of Application Knowledge.
* Practical knowledge of process unit operations and typical automation requirements of such process units Experience of the Process industry goals.
* Intermediate level of expertise in MES/Information Solutions, Networks and Services and Solutions, with a basic understanding of automation and electrical devices. Intermediate level of Industry Knowledge and Selling Skills.

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes …
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development ... and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

c2cdddf3.title: Network & Cloud Security Engineer
c2cdddf3.description:
Network & Cloud Security Engineer

**Company:** Cyber Guard Solutions Team (CGST)

**Location:** Remote – India

**Employment Type:** Contractual / Project-Based

**Experience Required:** 3–6 Years

**Open Positions:** 1

About Cyber Guard Solutions Team (CGST)

Cyber Guard Solutions Team (CGST) is an India-based cybersecurity services business focused on helping organizations identify security vulnerabilities, assess cyber risks, and strengthen their cybersecurity posture.

Our areas of focus include Network Security, Cloud Security Assessments, Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), Infrastructure Security, Security Hardening, Cybersecurity Consulting, and remediation guidance.

We emphasize responsible security practices, professional project delivery, client confidentiality, and evidence-based security recommendations.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Network & Cloud Security Engineer to support the technical execution of client cybersecurity engagements.

The selected professional will collaborate with CGST's Project Manager, Technical Lead, and other cybersecurity specialists to assess network and cloud infrastructure security, identify vulnerabilities, recommend appropriate security controls, and support remediation activities.

The role requires strong practical knowledge of enterprise networking, cloud platforms, infrastructure security, and security assessment methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct authorized network and cloud infrastructure security assessments.
* Assess network configurations, firewalls, VPNs, routers, switches, and access controls.
* Review AWS and Microsoft Azure environments for security misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.
* Perform vulnerability assessments across servers, network devices, and cloud infrastructure.
* Evaluate Identity and Access Management (IAM), privileged access, and security permissions.
* Review cloud storage security, network segmentation, and infrastructure configurations.
* Conduct Windows and Linux server security configuration reviews.
* Identify risks relating to exposed services, insecure configurations, and outdated software.
* Recommend security hardening measures aligned with CIS Benchmarks and relevant industry standards.
* Analyze assessment results and validate identified vulnerabilities.
* Prepare technical security reports, risk assessments, and remediation recommendations.
* Support authorized vulnerability remediation verification and retesting.
* Collaborate with the Technical Lead and Project Manager to coordinate technical deliverables and project milestones.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation and assessment evidence.
* Ensure all security assessments follow approved project scopes, written authorizations, and confidentiality requirements.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in network, infrastructure, or cloud security.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, and network segmentation.
* Practical experience with enterprise network security controls, including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and access control mechanisms.
* Hands-on experience securing or assessing AWS, Microsoft Azure, or comparable cloud infrastructure.
* Knowledge of cloud IAM, security groups, virtual networks, and cloud security configurations.
* Experience with vulnerability assessment tools such as Nessus, OpenVAS, Nmap, or equivalent solutions.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux security.
* Understanding of CIS Benchmarks, security hardening, and vulnerability management.
* Ability to prepare professional technical reports and remediation guidance.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with remote technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in cloud security posture management.
* Familiarity with AWS Security Hub, Amazon GuardDuty, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and Microsoft Sentinel.
* Experience with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID security.
* Understanding of Zero Trust Architecture and network security monitoring.
* Knowledge of infrastructure automation and security scripting using Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Experience supporting enterprise security assessments and infrastructure security projects.
* Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, and relevant security frameworks.
* Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Security, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate, or equivalent practical expertise.

Work Arrangement

* Remote contractual engagement within India.

7aa25bf0.title: IT Solution - Architect
7aa25bf0.description:
Position: Architect, IT Solutions – Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms

City: Pune

State: Maharashtra (
**Onsite)**

**Job Description**

Innovation starts from the heart. At client, we're dedicated to developing ground-breaking technologies with a genuine impact on patients' lives. At the core of this commitment is our investment in cutting-edge information technology. This supports our innovation and collaboration on a global scale, enabling our diverse teams to optimize both efficiency and success. As part of our IT team, your expertise and commitment will help facilitate our patient-focused mission by developing and enhancing technological solutions.

As Edwards accelerates its AI-driven transformation, we are seeking an Architect, IT Solutions to serve as the enterprise technical authority for our two most strategic agentic AI platforms — Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks. This is a multi-faceted architecture role that spans platform leadership, integration design, and end-to-end solution architecture. You will define how these platforms are built, extended, integrated, and governed across the enterprise.

This role works alongside our existing Azure infrastructure architect and complements cloud expertise with deep, platform-specific technical authority. If you thrive at the intersection of enterprise architecture, applied AI, and business-facing delivery — and want to shape how a global healthcare company adopts agentic AI at scale — this is the role for you.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

**Platform Architecture Leadership — Copilot & Moveworks**

· Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks — serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices.

· Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms.

· Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks.

**Integration Architecture**

· Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB.

· Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms.

· Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards.

**Lead Solution Architecture**

· Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms.

· Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.

· Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies.

**Governance, Mentorship & Innovation**

· Develop, institute, and maintain platform-specific design methodologies, development standards, security patterns, and operational best practices.

· Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture.

· Survey emerging developments in agentic AI — including multi-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, and tool-using agents — and recommend approaches that extend platform value.

· Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations.

**What You'll Need (Required)**

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.

· 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture.

· 3+ years in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.

· Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation).

· Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e.g., Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate).

· Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms.

· Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale.

· Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e.g., Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification).

· Expert-level documentation and communication skills — ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.

· Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams.

**What Else We Look For (Preferred)**

· Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio — building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration.

· Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform — configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics.

· Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models.

· Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB.

· Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer.

· Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices.

· Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

· Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks.

· Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice.

**Why This Role Is Different**

This is not a generic enterprise architect role. You will be the single technical authority for two of the most strategic AI platforms at client — platforms that are actively transforming how 12,000+ employees work, decide, and collaborate. You will shape the architecture, set the standards, and mentor the next generation of Forward-Deployed AI Engineers who build on these platforms every day.

You will operate at the intersection of platform strategy, hands-on architecture, and business impact — with direct visibility to senior IT leadership and the opportunity to influence how a global healthcare company scales agentic AI responsibly

*Integrated delivery owner for 24x7 L1.5 and L2 infrastructure operations across all Infra towers.*

**Role level**

Delivery Lead

**Domain**

Infrastructure Operations (Infra)

**Scope**

Hosting, Connectivity(Network & Telephony), DBA, Data Tribe & Infra Command Center (L1.5)

Own delivery of the client's infrastructure operations end to end. Manage SLAs, escalations, MIM, invoicing, resourcing and contractual reviews across Hosting, Connectivity, DBA, Data Tribe and the Infra Command Center.

**Process**

**Service Delivery Ownership**

* Own end-to-end delivery of L1.5 and L2 infrastructure operations.
* Lead the Infra Command Center (L1.5) and the Hosting, Connectivity, DBA and Data Tribe pods.
* Act as single point of contact for the client infrastructure leadership.
* Run daily stand-ups and weekly service reviews with tower leads.
* Drive service improvement plans to closure.

**SLA, Reporting and Governance**

* Track response and resolution SLAs across all infra towers.
* Publish weekly and monthly SLA, KPI and backlog reports.
* Present service performance at monthly and quarterly governance reviews.
* Review monthly capacity, utilisation and performance reports for servers and databases.
* Maintain the RAID log for infrastructure services.
* Enforce ServiceNow ticket hygiene, CMDB accuracy and closure quality.

**Incident, Escalation and MIM**

* Attend MIM bridge calls for P1/P2 infrastructure and data platform incidents.
* Own client and internal escalations through to closure.
* Drive RCA, problem management and defect elimination plans.
* Coordinate with SecOps towers, OEM and hardware vendors, telecom carriers and client L3 teams.
* Drive repeat-incident reduction and alert tuning with the Command Center.

**Change, Patching and Availability**

* Govern change requests and maintenance windows across all infra towers.
* Track monthly OS, VMware, database and zero-day patch compliance.
* Oversee backup success, restore tests and DR / BCP drills.
* Oversee server, database and network builds and decommissions.
* Track platform software licences and expiry dates.

**Commercials and Contract**

* Own monthly invoicing inputs and reconciliation for infrastructure services.
* Track deliverables against SOW scope and contractual obligations.
* Raise and manage change requests for scope changes.
* Lead contractual reviews, including service credits and penalties.

**Resourcing and People**

* Plan capacity, shift rosters and 24x7 on-call coverage.
* Hire, onboard and retain engineers; manage backfills and leave cover.
* Maintain the skill matrix and cross-skilling plan across pods.
* Run performance reviews, coaching and career plans for the team.

**Compliance and Continual Improvement**

* Ensure adherence to client infrastructure standards and security policies.
* Track OS hardening, system agent and audit-log compliance.
* Support internal and external audits with evidence.
* Drive automation of routine tasks, patching and deployments.
* Keep SOPs, runbooks and knowledge-base articles current.
* Lead onboarding and transition of new infrastructure services.

**Tools/Technology - knowhow**

* AWS (EC2, S3, ELB, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, IAM)
* Microsoft Azure
* Windows Server and Linux / Unix
* Cisco routers, switches and WLAN controllers
* Firewalls & load balancers
* Cisco Call Manager / PBX
* Databases (Oracle, MS SQL, Cloud databases)
* Datadog
* PagerDuty
* ServiceNow (ITSM, CMDB, reporting and dashboards)
* Tableau, Power BI / Excel for service reporting (good to have)

* Disaster recovery and business continuity
* Automation and scripting: PowerShell, Bash, Python (good to have)
* Infrastructure as code: Terraform (good to have)

* 5+ years as delivery lead in a managed services setup
* Led 24x7 multi-tower infrastructure operations for a global enterprise
* Managed onshore and offshore teams of 20+ engineers

ASP is seeking a
**Senior Project Manager**
based on-site at the Bangalore India Development Center (IDC) to lead software releases and medical device product development from planning through commercial release and lifecycle management. This role coordinates global, cross-functional teams and ensures products and releases meet business, customer, quality, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Software and medical device releases are planned and delivered predictably, with clear scope, ownership, readiness criteria, and decision points.
* Products are developed and released in compliance with applicable design controls, quality system procedures, risk management processes, and regulatory requirements.
* Risks, dependencies, defects, and resource constraints are identified early and actively managed.

* Use Data and FBS Tools: Use Jira, Confluence, dashboards, KPIs, Visual Project Management, risk management, and Kaizen or comparable tools to improve transparency and performance.

021d1770.title: Senior Technical Architect – PriceFX & Integrations
021d1770.description:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

  

The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

  
The Senior Technical Architect – PriceFX & Integrations (Level P3) serves as the lead technical authority responsible for the design, end-to-end architecture, and operational optimization of GE Appliances’ PriceFX pricing ecosystem and its critical integrations with Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) and other commercial platforms.  
Operating autonomously as a seasoned individual contributor, this role translates complex commercial pricing strategies, quoting workflows, and margin guardrails into robust, scalable technical solutions. The architect will drive data integrity, system performance, and seamless bidirectional synchronization between PriceFX calculation engines, Oracle EBS master data/order execution, and upstream CRM systems. This position partners closely with Commercial Sales, Pricing Operations, Supply Chain, and enterprise DT teams to deliver high-quality technical capabilities that align with business growth and Hoshin goals.

**Position**
------------

Senior Technical Architect – PriceFX & Integrations

**Location**
------------

IND, Bangalore, KAHyderabad (SAL) IN

**How You'll Create Possibilities**
-----------------------------------

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. PriceFX Architecture & Solution Design**
---------------------------------------------

* **Architect Enterprise Pricing Models:** Lead the technical design, configuration, and maintenance of PriceFX modules (Price Setting, Quoting, Rebates, and Analytics), ensuring high scalability, data cleanliness, and system responsiveness.
* **Calculation Engine & Logic Development:** Design and optimize PriceFX calculation logic, pricelists, lookups, and workflows using Groovy scripting and PriceFX best practices.
* **Pricing Guardrails & Rules Engine:** Architect automated pricing rules, discount approval matrices, and margin guardrails to enforce commercial pricing policy consistency across sales channels.
* **Performance Tuning:** Monitor calculation execution times, partition health, API throughput, and system latency to ensure peak performance during heavy quote extraction and pricing cycles.

**2. Enterprise Integrations & Oracle EBS Synchronization**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **EBS Integration Architecture:** Design, implement, and govern bidirectional integration pipelines connecting PriceFX with Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) modules, including Order Management (OM), Advanced Pricing (QP), Inventory/Item Master (INV), and General Ledger/AR.
* **Data Flow & Master Data Governance:** Ensure real-time and scheduled batch synchronization of customer hierarchies, pricing agreements, product master data, costs, and transactional history between Oracle EBS, enterprise data warehouses, and PriceFX.
* **API & Middleware Standards:** Define and manage RESTful APIs, web services, event-driven interfaces, and middleware connectors (e.g., Oracle MuleSoft / OIC / ETL tools) to maintain reliable data exchange with minimal manual intervention.
* **Quote-to-Order Hand-offs:** Ensure seamless transition of negotiated quotes, contracts, and special price agreements from PriceFX into Oracle EBS for downstream order entry and billing execution.

**3. Technical Governance & Project Delivery**
----------------------------------------------

* **Autonomous Technical Ownership:** Act as the primary technical owner for pricing digitalization projects, independently managing architectural work streams, release schedules, and solution delivery.
* **Root Cause & Complex Problem Solving:** Diagnose and resolve complex integration failures, data mismatches, and logic defects between PriceFX and Oracle CEMLI customizations.
* **Agile Collaboration:** Serve as a core technical leader in an Agile development environment, refining user stories, designing technical specifications, and supporting sprint commitments.
* **Change Management & Deployment:** Oversee deployment governance, environment partition synchronization (Dev, QA, Stage, Production), version control, use appropriate CI/CD pipeline tools, and regression testing protocols.

**4. Cross-Functional Leadership & Mentorship**
-----------------------------------------------

* **Influence & Business Alignment:** Partner with Commercial Operations, Finance, and DT leadership to assess capability gaps and recommend modern architectural enhancements.
* **Mentorship:** Provide technical guidance, architecture review, and code-level coaching to developers, systems analysts, and vendor integration partners.

**Documentation & Standards:** Establish and maintain enterprise architecture blueprints, integration interface data dictionaries, and operational runbooks.al

**What You'll Bring to Our Team**
---------------------------------

**Minimum / Basic Qualifications**
----------------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Experience:** Minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience in enterprise software architecture, pricing solutions, and systems integration.
* **PriceFX Expertise:** 3+ years of hands-on technical architecture and development experience with the PriceFX platform, including Pricefx Studio, Groovy scripting, partition management, and calculation logic.
* **Oracle EBS Knowledge:** Strong functional and technical familiarity with Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS R12), including data models and table structures across Order Management, Advanced Pricing, and Item Master.
* **Integration Skills:** Proven expertise designing and building integrations using REST/JSON, SOAP/XML, SQL, stored procedures, ETL pipelines, and enterprise middleware.
* **Problem Solving:** Demonstrated ability to dissect complex architectural dependencies, isolate root causes across distributed systems, and implement permanent systemic solutions.
* **Communication:** Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs to non-technical business leaders and influence decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Advanced Degree:** Master's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or an MBA.
* **Certifications:** PriceFX Configuration Engineer or Solution Architect Certification.
* **CRM / CPQ Ecosystem:** Experience integrating PriceFX with Salesforce (Sales Cloud / CPQ / Service Cloud) or B2B portals.
* **Middleware Frameworks:** Hands-on experience with enterprise integration platforms such as Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), MuleSoft, or AWS integration services.
* **Agile & DevOps:** Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery, JIRA, Git, CI/CD deployment pipelines, and automated test frameworks.

**Working Conditions**
======================

* **Environment:** Normal hybrid office environment with collaboration across global cross-functional teams.
* **Travel:** Up to 10%–15% travel may be required for on-site workshops, system releases, or stakeholder sessions at Appliance Park or business locations.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities.  
  
This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices.  
  
By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy.

GE Appliances is a trust-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization.

GE Appliances is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Appliances participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S

509e8d15.title: Senior Lead - Architecture Governance
509e8d15.description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**  
Lead the Architecture Strategy and Governance Office and provide product ownership for the Architecture Governance Platform across Global Supply Chain (GSC). Establish and operate consistent governance that enables timely, transparent and well-informed architecture decisions while maintaining standards, decision records, exceptions and compliance visibility. Connect architects, product teams, programmes and senior stakeholders through effective review forums, workflows, reporting and communications. Continuously improve governance processes and tools, drive adoption across GSC, and provide the insight and traceability needed to manage architecture risk and align technology delivery with GSC strategy.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Serve as Product Owner for the Architecture Governance Platform, including its vision, roadmap, priorities and adoption.
* Coordinate and facilitate the GSC Architecture Review Board and related governance activities, while managing architecture intake, review, approval, decision-making, and exception processes to ensure effective architectural oversight and governance.
* Maintain architecture decision logs, Architecture Decision Records and governance repositories.
* Define, document and continuously improve architecture governance processes, standards and working practices.
* Track compliance with architecture principles, standards, approved decisions and agreed exceptions.
* Develop governance metrics, dashboards and reporting that provide visibility of demand, decisions, risks and process effectiveness.
* Train architects, product teams and stakeholders on governance processes, accountabilities and tools.
* Drive adoption and effective use of architecture governance capabilities across GSC.
* Lead architecture communications, knowledge management and stakeholder engagement for the governance office.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology (IT), Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in architecture governance, enterprise architecture, technology governance, process management, or product ownership.
* Experience in coordinating architecture review boards or comparable governance forums.
* Experience in managing workflow platforms, decision records, standards, compliance reporting, or governance repositories.
* Experience in designing and improving processes, measures, dashboards, and stakeholder communications.
* Experience in facilitating senior stakeholders and supporting the adoption of new governance practices across a large, multi-stakeholder organisation.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Master’s degree in enterprise architecture, Technology Management, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF) or an equivalent architecture certification.
* Agile Product Owner or Scrum certification.
* Experience in governance workflows, portfolio management tools, or enterprise architecture management tools.
* Experience in process design, continuous improvement, and analytical analysis.
* Experience in developing metrics, dashboards, training materials, and stakeholder communications.
* Experience in facilitation, stakeholder engagement, written communication, and delivering presentations.
* Experience in managing governance operations while maintaining alignment with strategic outcomes.

**Skills**

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
