cffa84b6.description:
**We want to shape the future with vision and innovation. Be part of it and develop your full potential!**
As part of the global NTT DATA Group, one of the most successful IT service providers in the world, we specialize in value-added SAP solutions as NTT DATA Business Solutions. With over 12,000 employees in more than 30 countries, we design, implement, and develop custom-fit SAP solutions for our global customers.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior / Lead Consultant – GTM [Go To Market]**
**Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
**Job Location: Mumbai – Hybrid Mode**
**Job Summary**
Pre Sales Engineer – SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud is responsible for driving customer engagements, shaping solution positioning, and supporting the sales cycle with deep product expertise. The role requires hands-on SAP S/4HANA Cloud (Public Edition) knowledge, strong customer-facing communication skills, and the ability to translate product capabilities into compelling business value for prospects. This role partners closely with the Sales, Delivery and SAP Teams to accelerate cloud adoption and improve win rates.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
  

* Pre Sales Solutioning & Customer Engagement

+ Lead discovery sessions, requirement analysis, and solution mapping for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.
+ Deliver high-impact demos in one or more areas namely Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Sales, and Project Services.
+ Prepare solution presentations, value propositions, and customer-specific walkthroughs.
+ Support RFIs/RFPs, proposals, and technical clarifications throughout the deal cycle.

* GTM Activities (Aligned with Global Practice)

+ Create and refine pre-sales assets, pitch decks, value stories, and industry use cases.
+ Localize global GTM assets for NDBS India context (industry, customer maturity, regional references).
+ Conduct internal enablement sessions for sales, consulting, and delivery teams.
+ Ensure alignment with SAP roadmap, product changes, and release updates.

* Hands-On SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Expertise

+ Perform configuration walkthroughs and demonstrate fit-to-standard processes.
+ Showcase capabilities using CBC (Central Business Configuration), Fiori apps, SAP Best Practices, and released scope items.
+ Explain SAP Public Cloud extensibility, integrations (BTP, Integration Suite), and analytics options.
+ Articulate cloud implementation approaches, project phases, and CALM/ALM usage.

* Innovation, AI & Cloud Readiness

+ Present emerging Public Cloud capabilities including automation, embedded ML/AI, and agentic AI (Joule).
+ Evangelize SAP’s cloud operating model, upgrades, data migration methods, and extensibility guardrails.
+ Work with CoE teams to position AI-enabled use cases relevant to customer sector challenges.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of SAP experience, including 3+ years in SAP S/4HANA Cloud – Public Edition.

+ Strong functional expertise in at least one core module (Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing).
+ Hands-on experience with CBC, fit-to-standard workshops, data migration, and release management.
+ Prior experience in Pre Sales, Solutioning, or GTM roles would be an added advantage.
+ Excellent communication, presentation, and demonstration skills.
+ Ability to simplify complex SAP concepts for business and technical stakeholders.
+ Preferred Qualifications

  
  

+ SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition certification.
+ Familiarity with SAP BTP, SAC, integrations, workflow, and extensibility.
+ Exposure to industry-specific S/4HANA Cloud scope items and scenarios.
+ Experience running PoVs, PoCs, or demo environments.

**Why This Role Matters in NDBS India**
This GTM role shapes customer perception, influences deal outcomes, and showcases NDBS India’s SAP Cloud leadership. You play a central role in customer-facing conversations, differentiating our offering, and accelerating SAP Public Cloud adoption for strategic accounts.
  
  

* Are you the person we're looking for? If yes, we look forward to receiving your application for this vacancy. Write to satyendra.tvnr@bs.nttdata.com

263b7614.title: Pre-Sales Solution Architect
263b7614.description:
**Function**
Presales
  
  
**Our Company**
We’re Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world’s innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers – from banks to theme parks ­– can focus on achieving the incredible with data.
  
  
If you’ve seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you’ve seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate – and wow their customers. Right now, we’re laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We’re looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team – and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.
  
  
**Job Description**
The primary role of a Pre Sales Solutions Consultant is to work collaboratively with the direct sales team as well as partners to provide support for all presales solution aspects of the sales cycle. Job requirements include but are not limited to the following activities; RFI/RFP preparation, opportunity & account planning, technical liaison (representing Sales) to Professional Services / Partners and APAC TEs / Product Management teams, demonstrations, joint partner solutions etc. Solution Consultant plays a vital role in establishing and supporting the technical sales relationship with prospects & clients. In concert with the sales representative, the Solution Consultant maps product capabilities to client needs and sets mutually understood and accepted expectations related to our solutions to ensure the success of post-sale implementations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical sales support to the sales team and partners leading the engagements
* Strong Focus on Customer engagements in ongoing opportunities
* Leverage technical relationship and trusted advisor role to create new opportunities with consultative selling
* RFI/RFP support (both proactive and reactive)
* Technical engagements with key partners (SI, ISV etc.) for joint Solution development and / or joint bidding
* Lead initial solution demonstrations to customers/partners
* Assist in pre-sales to post-sale transition to ensure smooth implementation and maximum customer satisfaction

**Required Capabilities**

* Strong ability to identify, document and articulate the business and technical requirements of a prospective customer during the full sales cycle – qualification, proposal, post-sale transition
* Strong ability to communicate our software ability to address prospect’s requirements through compelling presentation (written, oral and product demonstrations) of the applications
* Excellent customer facing and presentation skills
* Excellent collaboration and Team work not only with in HV teams but also partner teams
* Proactive in approach to lead customer/partner/consultant engagements and strengthen HV’s presence in accounts
* Excellent writing and quantitative skills, specifically related to proposals, RFI/RFP response and MS PowerPoint presentations
* High level of energy, enthusiasm, persistence, discipline, and a strong desire to succeed
* Willingness to do whatever is necessary to win (Team work, ability to resolve issues etc.)
* Ability to travel

**Technical Skills**

* Good technical experience in Data Center level infrastructure with strong focus on Storage
* Good understanding of Object Storage technologies
* Minimum 8 years of experience with 5 years being in presales role
* Experience with Database, Application integration etc. desirable
* Experience in conducting demos
* Experience to lead consultative workshops to demonstrate business value

**About Us**
We’re a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can a make positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
  
  
**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
  
  
We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
  
  
**How We Look After You**
We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We’re also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We’re always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you’ll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
  
  
We’re proud to say we’re an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

1409f582.title: Lead - Presales
1409f582.description:
**About Leadsquared**
LeadSquared is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in the CRM space — trusted by 2,000+ customers and 2.5 lakh+ users globally. We help organizations automate sales and marketing to run high-velocity revenue operations at scale. With a strong presence across the US, Middle East, ASEAN, ANZ, and South Africa, LeadSquared is expanding its US vertical teams to drive growth in Education and Healthcare — two of our strongest market segments.
  
  
**About The Role**
LeadSquared is expanding its US Education vertical and is looking for a senior PreSales Consultant with deep expertise in the Education sector to drive enterprise deal pursuits across Higher Education institutions, K-12 districts, EdTech platforms, and Workforce Training organizations. You will serve as the technical and solutions authority in the sales process — owning discovery, demo design, RFP responses, and proof-of-concept development — while acting as a trusted advisor to prospects and a strategic partner to the US Sales team.
  
  
***🎓 This is not a generic SE role. We need someone who speaks Education — who understands enrollment funnels, student lifecycle management, and how institutions buy technology.***
**Solution Engineering**
**Product Demonstrations**
**RFP/RFI Response**
**CRM**
**EdTech**
**Higher Education**
**POC Development**

* Lead tailored product demonstrations of LeadSquared’s CRM and Student Lifecycle Management platform for Higher Education, K-12, and EdTech prospects.
* Design and deliver discovery-led demos that address specific institutional pain points — enrollment management, student engagement, retention, and alumni relations.
* Develop and present end-to-end solution blueprints aligned to each prospect’s administrative, enrollment, and technology workflows.
* Build and deliver proof-of-concepts (POCs) for complex or competitive enterprise evaluations.
* Showcase integration capabilities with SIS platforms (Banner, Ellucian, PowerSchool), LMS tools, and other education ecosystem technologies.

**RFP Leadership & Proposal Excellence**

* Own RFI/RFP responses for US Education prospects, including functional requirements, solution architecture, and integration approach.
* Create compelling solution documents, executive summaries, and business case narratives tailored to CIO, VP Enrollment, and Provost-level audiences.
* Develop effort estimation, implementation roadmap, and TCO analysis for enterprise Education deployments.
* Maintain and improve a library of standard RFP responses, demo scripts, and proposal templates for the US Education team.

**Education Domain Authority**

* Serve as LeadSquared’s internal subject-matter expert on US Education: enrollment management, student success, financial aid workflows, and alumni engagement.
* Maintain competitive intelligence across EdTech CRM platforms (Salesforce Education Cloud, Slate, Ellucian CRM, Element451) and develop battle cards.
* Stay current on FERPA compliance, Title IV regulations, and accreditation-related technology requirements.
* Represent LeadSquared at US Education conferences, events, and industry forums to build brand presence and generate pipeline.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Engage VP Enrollment Management, CIOs, Registrars, Student Success Directors, and Provosts as a trusted advisor, not just a vendor.
* Partner with the US Sales team, Marketing, and Customer Success to build winning deal strategies and seamless customer handoffs.
* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on US Education market requirements and competitive gaps.
* Mentor and support junior PreSales resources as the Education vertical scales.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Experience & Education**

* 5-10 years of experience in PreSales, Solution Engineering, or Sales Consulting, with significant tenure supporting US Education accounts.
* Deep understanding of US Higher Education and/or K-12 institutional buying processes, IT governance, and technology procurement.
* Prior hands-on experience with EdTech CRM, SIS, or Student Lifecycle Management platforms is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or prior experience working inside a US educational institution is a strong plus.
* Excellent English communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — with proven ability to engage C-suite and VP-level academic leaders.

**Technical & Domain Skills**

* Strong understanding of enrollment management, student lifecycle, financial aid, and alumni engagement workflows.
* Familiarity with US Education technology ecosystem: SIS platforms (Banner, Ellucian, PowerSchool, Infinite Campus), LMS (Canvas, Blackboard, D2L), and communication tools.
* Knowledge of FERPA, data privacy standards, and compliance requirements for US Education technology.
* Proficiency in solution architecture, integration design, and API-based connectivity for enterprise Education environments.
* Experience with competitive platforms: Salesforce Education Cloud, Slate, Element451, Ellucian CRM, or similar.

**Good to Have**

* Experience presenting at EDUCAUSE, NACAC, or similar US Education conferences.
* Familiarity with Title IV, accreditation body requirements, and financial aid system integrations.
* Experience with data analytics and reporting for student outcome tracking.

59553650.title: Presales Manager
59553650.description:
**Job Description: Presales & Technical Resource – Microsoft Technologies**
*Location: Bangalore / Gurugram (NCR) | Function: Presales / Technical Sales | Industry: IT Software / Microsoft Ecosystem*
**About The Role**
We are looking for a techno-commercial Presales and Technical Resource with deep expertise across Microsoft Technologies to support enterprise sales cycles. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth (Level 300) with the ability to translate customer business needs into compelling technical and commercial narratives — leading discovery, solutioning, demonstrations, and proposal development. This role sits at the intersection of technology and sales, requiring both credibility with technical stakeholders and fluency in commercial/business conversations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with the sales team through the full presales cycle — from lead qualification to solution design, proposal, and deal closure.
* Lead structured customer discovery sessions to uncover business outcomes, technology landscape, constraints, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures spanning Microsoft Copilot, Data Modernization, Fabric, Azure Infrastructure, and Security.
* Build and deliver technical presentations, live demonstrations, proofs of concept (PoCs), and proposals tailored to customer priorities.
* Respond to RFPs/RFIs with technically sound and commercially competitive solutions and business cases.
* Articulate business and technical differentiation of Microsoft solution areas relative to competitive alternatives.
* Drive deal progression by removing presales blockers, aligning stakeholders, and maintaining momentum on agreed action items.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to both customers and the internal sales team, balancing technical accuracy with commercial pragmatism.
* Stay current on Microsoft's evolving technology roadmap, licensing models, and competitive landscape.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**Technical Expertise (Level 300)**

* Microsoft Copilot — architecture, licensing, use-case design, and adoption scenarios.
* Data Modernization — modern data platforms, migration strategies, and data estate transformation.
* Microsoft Fabric — end-to-end analytics, data engineering, and integration capabilities.
* Azure Infrastructure — hybrid cloud, virtualization, App Modernization, and cloud migration patterns.
* Security — Microsoft security stack (identity, data protection, threat management) and secure solution design.

**Experience & Attributes**

* Prior experience in a presales, solution consulting, or technical sales role within IT software or the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Demonstrated techno-commercial capability — equally comfortable in technical deep-dives and commercial/business discussions.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills across technical and business audiences.
* Microsoft Technology certifications at associate/expert level (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Data Engineer, Security Engineer, or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience building business cases, ROI/TCO models, and RFP responses.
* Self-driven and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, competitive, quota-influenced environment.

b7d0080c.title: Solutions Consultant — Enterprise AI & Presales
b7d0080c.description:
**Solutions Consultant — Enterprise AI & Presales**

**Company: Assistents.ai**

Assistents.ai helps enterprises use AI agents to connect business systems, automate workflows, and support business decisions.

We are looking for a senior, client-facing professional who can lead discussions with business leaders, discover use cases, and deliver compelling product demonstrations.

You should be able to understand how a business works, identify where AI can help, and explain how Assistents.ai can address the need. We will provide product training. You will bring strong business judgment, clear communication, and the ability to earn trust with senior leaders.

**The role**

Our lead generation partner arranges prospective client meetings. You will lead these conversations and help turn initial interest into a clear solution opportunity.

A typical meeting may start with a broad question: “How can AI help our business?” Your role is to ask the right questions, understand the underlying problem, and connect it to a practical solution using Assistents.ai.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery meetings and product demonstrations with CEOs, CXOs, business heads, and technology leaders.
* Research each prospect’s business, industry, and likely priorities before the meeting.
* Understand current processes, systems, manual work, bottlenecks, and business goals.
* Identify use cases across functions such as sales, customer service, finance, operations, HR, and supply chain.
* Develop initial solution approaches during live discussions. Explain the proposed workflow, system connections, expected benefits, and areas that need further validation.
* Tailor demonstrations to the client’s priorities and adapt when new requirements emerge.
* Explain technical concepts in clear business terms. Handle detailed questions with confidence and sound judgment.
* Qualify opportunities by clarifying business impact, urgency, decision-makers, budget, and readiness.
* Prepare concise meeting summaries, use-case briefs, solution outlines, and follow-up presentations.
* Work with the founder, product team, and engineering team to define proposals and proofs of concept.
* Agree on clear next steps with the client and maintain progress after each meeting.

**What you bring**

* Proven experience in enterprise presales, solutions consulting, business consulting, or technology consulting.
* A strong record of leading discovery sessions and demonstrations for senior decision-makers.
* A professional presence, excellent spoken and written English, and strong listening skills.
* The ability to connect business problems, process changes, technology capabilities, and measurable outcomes.
* The ability to think clearly during live discussions and respond to questions beyond a prepared presentation.
* Working knowledge of enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, analytics platforms, and workflow tools.
* Enough technical understanding to discuss AI agents, integrations, APIs, and data requirements with technical teams.
* Sound judgment about what can be demonstrated, what can be proposed, and what needs technical validation.
* Strong preparation, documentation, and follow-through.

**Experience that would help**

* Selling or consulting on enterprise SaaS, AI, automation, analytics, or digital transformation.
* Working with clients across multiple industries.
* Designing business workflows or helping clients improve operational processes.
* Developing business cases, proposals, and proofs of concept.

**What success looks like**

Clients leave your meetings with a clear understanding of the problem, the proposed use case, and how Assistents.ai could help. Demonstrations address their actual needs. Follow-up documents give our delivery team enough detail to assess the solution. Qualified opportunities move towards an agreed workshop, proof of concept, or proposal.

**What we provide**

* Structured training on the Assistents.ai platform and its capabilities.
* Access to the founder, product specialists, and engineering team.
* The opportunity to shape enterprise AI solutions across industries.
* Ownership of discovery and demonstration conversations with senior business leaders.

**How to apply**

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile with a brief example of a client discussion you led. Explain the business problem, how you developed the solution approach, and the outcome.

* As part of the selection process, shortlisted candidates will lead a simulated executive discovery meeting and deliver a short demonstration after a product briefing.

CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion, and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more about us at cgi.com.  
  
Job Title: Solution Architect – Composable Experience & Orchestration  
Experience: 10+ yrs.  
Job Location: Bangalore / Chennai  
Position ID: J1026-1164  
Work Type: Hybrid  
Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  
Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  
Practice / Domain: Digital Experience, API Integration & Retail/Lubricants Ecosystem  
  
Role Summary & Context  
  
We are seeking a visionary Solution Architect to lead the architectural design and global rollout of a next generation Unified Experience and Orchestration Platform for Lubricants Ecosystem program global indirect channel initiative partnering with independent auto workshops, distributors, and internal teams. Currently, regional markets operate across fragmented backend systems (SAP ERP, Salesforce CRM, ServiceNow, and legacy dealer platforms), resulting in inconsistent workflows and disjointed user journeys.  
  
Key Responsibilities  
  
1. Architectural Vision & MACH Design  
  
. Headless Experience Architecture: Design a decoupled, composable frontend architecture (React / Next.js SPA) utilizing a unified Design System (WCAG 2.0 compliant) that eliminates i frames and system switching for Distributors, Workshops, and Internal client users.  
. Backend for Frontend (BFF) & API Strategy: Architect a robust BFF and API Gateway layer (Azure API Management / Kong) that abstracts regional backend schema variations ("API drift") into a globally standardized contract for the UI.  
. Hybrid Process Orchestration: Design the orchestration strategy balancing synchronous, low latency API orchestration with asynchronous event driven choreography using Camunda / Temporal and Apache Kafka / Azure Event Grid.  
  
2. Enterprise Integration & Guardrail Governance  
  
. Stateless & Transient Enforcement: Strictly enforce architectural guardrails ensuring no new System of Record (SoR) is created, and no business logic is duplicated in the experience layer. Design short term caching strategies (e.g., Redis) for slow legacy ERP reads while ensuring real time write backs to authoritative sources.  
. Heterogeneous System Connectivity: Define integration patterns across MuleSoft, Boomi, TIBCO, or SAP Integration Suite to seamlessly connect SAP ERP, Salesforce CRM, ServiceNow, Client Lubricants DB, and regional third party distributor systems.  
. End to End Observability & Security: Implement enterprise security using Microsoft Entra ID (SSO, OAuth 2.0, RBAC) and establish end to end auditability via standardized correlation IDs across distributed transactions.  
  
Required Experience & Skills  
  
Architecture Patterns: Proven expertise in MACH Architecture (Microservices, API first, Cloud native, Headless), BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns, Event Driven Architecture (EDA), and Domain Driven Design (DDD).  
Frontend & UI Layer: Strong architectural understanding of React, Next.js, or Vue.js, Micro frontends, Single Page Applications (SPAs), enterprise Design Systems, and WCAG 2.0 accessibility standards.  
Orchestration & BPM: Hands on experience architecting stateful/stateless workflows using Camunda (8/Zeebe), Temporal, or equivalent lightweight microservices orchestration engines.  
Integration & Messaging: Deep expertise in API Gateways (Azure APIM, Kong), iPaaS/ESB platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, TIBCO, SAP Integration Suite), and event brokers (Apache Kafka, Azure Event Grid).  
Backend & Caching: Proficiency in Java Spring Boot microservices, REST/GraphQL APIs, and transient in memory caching (Redis) to mitigate legacy ERP latency.  
Cloud, DevOps & IAM: Production experience with Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) or OpenShift on Azure or AWS, CI/CD pipelines, APM observability tools, and Microsoft Entra ID (OAuth2/OIDC/SSO).  
  
Overall Experience: 10+ years in Enterprise IT, with 5+ years as a Solution Architect designing large scale, multi market digital platforms and integration layers.

7dbeb2ea.title: AI Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
7dbeb2ea.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing role.
* Experience in architecting solutions that integrate AI models using agents with enterprise data sources using patterns like RAG, Text-to-SQL, and semantic search.
* Experience with coding in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Java, to demo, prototype, or workshop integration patterns with customers.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in developing agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or the Google AI Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Experience with cloud technologies including SaaS applications, iPaaS, business automation solutions, Cloud infrastructure, Agentic AI, and cloud networking.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) Gateways.
* Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As an AI Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of complex, specialized workloads. You will leverage your deep expertise in strategic product areas in partnership with Platform CEs, writing code, developing prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and demos to promote new specialized solutions to customers. You will solve AI-centered customer issues and provide a critical feedback loop to influence product development.
  
  
It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the technical solution for complex workloads within AI product areas to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp.
* Combine business strategies and direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts.
* Provide deep technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building lasting customer relationships. Leverage learnings from customer engagements to contribute to reusable solutions and assets with the Go-To-Market team.
* Work within Product and Engineering management systems to document, prioritize, and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.
* Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required, acting as a public advocate for Google Cloud.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

f932de36.title: Solutions Engineer
f932de36.description:
**The role sits between sales and engineering, and is accountable to both**

  

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India team through Flexiple. Deals are increasingly won or lost on whether a prospect's technical evaluator believes the product will work in their environment, and right now the founders are personally doing that call. It does not scale past about here. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

  

**What the week contains**

  

Technical discovery with prospects, which mostly means finding out what they actually have rather than what the RFP says. Building demonstrations against a customer's real constraints. Running proofs of concept and being straight about what did not work. Writing up integration requirements clearly enough that engineering can act on them without a second meeting.

  

**The uncomfortable part**

  

Telling a sales lead the deal will not work as scoped. That happens, and the people who last in this role are the ones who do it early rather than letting a proof of concept quietly fail three weeks later.

  

**Looking for**

  

* 4 to 8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering or a customer-facing technical role
* Enough hands-on ability to build a working integration, not only describe one
* APIs, authentication models and the usual enterprise objections around data residency
* Composure in front of a sceptical technical audience

  

Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Chennai, or remote within India, with some travel to customer sites. A screening call, a technical conversation, a live scenario, then time with the founding team.

  

*Applying once also puts you forward for later customer-facing engineering roles here.*

* Work closely with sales teams and customers to design PV solar & ESS solutions tailored to project requirements.
* Ensure solutions comply with local technical standards, safety requirements, and regulatory guidelines.

* Act as a trusted technical advisor for customers, installers, EPCs, and distributors.

* Monitor solution adoption and performance in the market, identifying gaps and improvement opportunities.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Renewable Energy, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.

* Proven experience in technical consulting, solution selling, and customer/partner enablement.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills; ability to influence stakeholders and build trusted relationships.
* Proficiency in relevant software tools (e.g., PVsyst, AutoCAD, MS Office).

**Why Join Sigenergy India**

* Build a **best-in-class service organization** from day one
* Work with **global, safety-first, AI-driven Solar & BESS technology**

* Long-term opportunity in India’s fast-growing energy storage market

de23fc2b.title: AI Solution Architect
de23fc2b.description:
As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled AI Solution Architect to join our innovative and dynamic team.

**AI Solution Architect - About You**

As an AI Solution Architect, you are responsible for designing and shaping intelligent, scalable, and secure AI-driven solutions that align with business objectives and long-term technology strategy. You bring deep expertise in AI/ML architectures, data platforms, and cloud-native technologies, combined with strong consulting, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills. You serve as a trusted technical advisor, translating complex AI capabilities into clear, actionable business outcomes for clients and internal teams. As a strategic thinker, you balance innovation with practicality, ensuring solutions are robust, governable, and future-proof. You thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments, guiding cross-functional teams while setting architectural standards and best practices that enable successful AI adoption at scale.

**AI Solution Architect - Day-to-Day**

* Lead the end-to-end design of AI and data solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements, technical standards, and enterprise architecture.
* Act as the primary technical authority for AI initiatives, guiding solution decisions, managing architectural risks, and ensuring design integrity across delivery teams.
* Define and evolve AI architectures, including data pipelines, ML platforms, model deployment patterns, and integration with enterprise systems.
* Partner with clients and stakeholders to identify AI use cases, assess feasibility, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Establish architectural governance, best practices, and design patterns to ensure security, compliance, performance, and maintainability.
* Provide hands-on technical guidance and mentorship to engineering teams during implementation, reviews, and production readiness.

**AI Solution Architect - Skills Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, technical consulting, or engineering roles focused on data, analytics, and AI-enabled systems.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing AI/ML solutions using modern cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) and AI services.
* Strong expertise in data architectures, including data lakes, lakehouses, data warehouses, and real-time or event-driven data platforms.
* Proven experience with AI/ML frameworks, model lifecycle management (MLOps), and scalable deployment patterns.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical design discussions, influence architectural decisions, and communicate complex concepts to technical and non technical audiences.
* Experience collaborating with delivery, product, and business teams to ensure solutions are feasible, secure, and aligned with strategic goals.
* Preferred certifications: Cloud Architect certifications (Azure, AWS, GCP), AI/ML certifications, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture credentials.

**Job Description**
The Solution Architect is responsible for the design, integrity and quality of the SAP solution and of associated IS services delivered to Business, Support Functions and IS Technology domains as the case may be. Responsible that the SAP solution/service provides the required functionality and meets the requirement of business. Collaborates with and contributes to project set-up and delivery as well as to service operations optimization.
  
  
The Solution Architect is accountable for managing workstream interdependencies mainly but not restricted to the specific End-to-End Stream.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Defines the technical SAP solution/ E- Invoicing and ensures alignment with other modules and surrounding IS applications through cooperation and collaboration across solution architects.
* Supports validation and prioritization of incoming business demand in collaboration with Project owners, business function and unit as well with the relevant IS Business Analyst, IS Service Manager, IS Application Manager and/or Global IS Domain Architect.
* Be responsible for translating the functional design into functional and technical specifications, review and sign off the functional and technical use case specifications.
* Communicate the technical specifications to the developers. Joining unit testing and support on UAT testing and defect resolution. Managing the transport request and it's status update until release to Production system.
* Formulate rules, principles and guidelines to guide the development of the technical solutions. Determine non-functional requirements and ensure service/ solution operation standards are considered accordingly. Keeps knowledge up to date regarding new and emerging IS technology and IS industry practices, bringing learning into HE; all within in the scope of the relevant IS solutions.
* Collaborates with users in projects and problem management to maintain, develop and deploy the best feasible and most- cost efficient IS solutions/services for the business. Ensures solution documentation and training material are well maintained and created.
* Consults, gives advice and supports the installation of new E - Invoicing solutions/services, or the changing of existing solutions/services. Consults the users to identify and learn about current procedures and to clarify further requirements.
* Supports the installation, management, maintenance, and optimization of all E- Invoicing processes related to the area of responsibility. Provides guidance to IS project management and IS delivery unit team in how to utilize IS application/solution standards (e.g. SAP) effectively.
* Commits and contributes to common result oriented collaboration with the various business processes IS architectural domains as well as the various enterprise technology IS architecture domains. For assigned tasks, executes all actions in IS processes according to agreed RACIS specification.
* In concert with the Global IS Domain Architect ensures that IS solution/service-related standards are considered accordingly. Provides support to temporary work teams, guiding and monitoring task completion, sharing expert knowledge and advice with/without carrying line responsibility.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background**

* Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s degree in Engineering in Computer science (preferred) or related discipline.
* 5+ years of experience within Information Technology industry with solution architecture experience across various IT areas with focus in the areas of S/4 HANA system with E - Invoicing
* Practical implementation experience with integration software/tools: BizTalk and/or MuleSoft.
* International work experience in different countries/ cultures.
* Proven experience implementing SAP best practices, especially for smooth transition for carving out a business division from current SAP landscape to a different one.
* Highly adept at bridging, translating and integrating business with IT, and converting business requirements into IT solutions. Ability to provide leadership to ensure effective solutions that drive business value are created and implemented, in an environment of virtual teams.
* Awareness of latest technology, developments and offerings from SAP and their future direction. Able to sort through complex issues and make timely decisions. Ability to generate new ideas, challenge status quo, take risks, support change and foster innovation.
* Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem-solving, decision-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes

50de8eca.description:
Greetings!!!

  

Please find below Job Description:

  

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a seasoned Generative AI Architect with a strong foundation in enterprise and system architecture, combined with significant depth and breadth in Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI application development. This is a senior cross-cutting role responsible for architecting, designing, and guiding the implementation of Industry AI Solutions (IAIS) across multiple teams.

The Generative AI Architect will serve as the technical authority for AI architecture decisions within their assigned teams, working alongside embedded GenAI Developers (who report to this architect for technical direction), traditional software engineers, and business stakeholders. The architect bridges the worlds of robust enterprise system design and cutting-edge AI capabilities translating business goals into scalable, secure, production-ready GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

**Cross-team Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Architect and own the end-to-end Solution Design, working alongside a System Architect or alone for an Industry AI Solution Team, ensuring architectural consistency, pattern reuse, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Serve as the primary technical authority for GenAI and Agentic AI architecture decisions within assigned teams, providing direction to embedded GenAI Developers and guiding their implementation work.
* Define and enforce architecture standards, design patterns, reference architectures, and guardrails for GenAI and Agentic AI development across teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, proof-of-concept evaluations, and technical design discussions for AI features and components.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Solution Design**

* Design scalable, production-grade GenAI application architectures including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Agentic Workflows, LLM integration layers, prompt management systems, and response evaluation frameworks.
* Architect multi-agent systems and Agentic AI workflows: agent orchestration patterns, tool use, memory management, long-horizon task execution, and human-in-the-loop designs.
* Select and evaluate appropriate LLMs, embedding models, and AI frameworks (commercial and open-source) based on performance, cost, latency, and compliance requirements.
* Define LLM fine-tuning and adaptation strategies (RLHF, PEFT, LoRA, prompt tuning) where required, overseeing implementation by the developer team.
* Design LLMOps and AI observability pipelines including evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, and feedback loops for deployed AI systems.

**Enterprise System Architecture**

* Apply deep system architecture expertise to ensure GenAI solutions integrate seamlessly into existing enterprise platforms including CRM, ERP, workflow automation tools, and analytics systems.
* Design robust, secure API layers, microservices, and event-driven integration patterns that connect AI components with enterprise backends.
* Ensure AI architectures meet enterprise non-functional requirements: scalability, availability, latency, security, and disaster recovery.
* Collaborate with infrastructure and cloud teams to architect AI workloads on cloud platforms (Azure preferred: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML) with appropriate cost and performance optimisation.

**Data Engineering & AI Data Architecture**

* Design and govern data pipelines supporting AI model inference and (where applicable) fine-tuning: ingestion, transformation, quality validation, and versioning.
* Define data architecture for AI: vector databases, knowledge graphs, embedding stores, and structured/unstructured data integration patterns.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data pipelines meet quality, freshness, and compliance requirements for AI use cases.

**Responsible AI, Governance & Security**

* Embed AI fairness, transparency, explainability, and accountability principles into solution designs from inception.
* Define and enforce AI security architecture: prompt injection protection, data leakage prevention, model access controls, and audit logging.
* Ensure compliance with applicable AI governance frameworks, data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR), and enterprise AI policies.
* Conduct AI risk assessments for new solutions and advise teams on responsible deployment practices.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication**

* Collaborate closely with executive stakeholders, product managers, business analysts, and engineering leads to align AI architecture with business strategy and product roadmaps.
* Present complex AI architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences; produce architecture documentation, decision records, and design artefacts.
* Actively contribute to the broader IAIS architecture community sharing learnings, patterns, and innovations across teams and programs.

Mandatory Qualifications & Skills

**Architecture & Engineering Foundation**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Solution Architect or Enterprise Architect (5+ years), with a track record of designing large-scale, production enterprise systems.
* Strong command of system design principles: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, API design, cloud-native patterns.
* Experience architecting across cloud platforms, with strong preference for Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure API Management).

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Expertise**

* Deep hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI application development — including RAG architecture, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and chain-of-thought design.
* Proven experience architecting Agentic AI systems and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, and LLMOps practices — including tracing tools, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring.
* Experience with vector databases and embedding stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, FAISS, Chroma, or similar).
* Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning approaches (RLHF, PEFT, LoRA) and when to apply them versus prompt-based adaptation.

**Programming & Technical Skills**

* Strong Python proficiency — able to prototype, review, and guide implementation of GenAI components.
* Working knowledge of software engineering best practices: Git, CI/CD, automated testing, API design, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).

**Responsible AI & Governance**

* Sound knowledge of Safe AI principles, AI security patterns, AI governance frameworks, and data privacy compliance.
* Ability to conduct AI risk assessments and embed governance into architecture decisions.

**Communication & Leadership**

* Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions and drive consensus across multi-disciplinary teams.
* Effective at communicating architecture decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to both technical and executive audiences.
* Experience mentoring developers and guiding teams through complex AI implementation challenges.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience leading AI architecture across multiple concurrent teams.
* Familiarity with MLOps tooling and platforms (MLflow, Azure ML Pipelines, Weights & Biases).
* Exposure to multimodal AI models (vision-language, speech-to-text, document AI).
* Experience with enterprise AI governance and compliance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, or equivalent).
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows and coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or custom coding agents).
* Prior experience in a product architecture role delivering Industry AI Solutions at enterprise scale.

90db5bf3.title: Hiring Salesforce Data Cloud Technical Architect
90db5bf3.description:
Job Title: Salesforce Data Cloud Technical Architect

**Experience:** 8+ Years

Budget: 2 LPM  
**Location:** Remote – Pan India  
**Working Hours:** 2:00 PM–10:00 PM IST

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Data Cloud Technical Architect to lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise-scale customer data platforms using Salesforce Data Cloud.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in Salesforce Data Cloud, Customer 360, identity resolution, data modeling, data ingestion, real-time integrations, and audience activation. The candidate should be capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing data architecture solutions.

This role involves working closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, Salesforce development teams, integration teams, and data engineering teams to deliver unified customer profiles, advanced segmentation, personalized customer experiences, and AI-driven business capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

**Architecture and Solution Design**

* Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and implementation of Salesforce Data Cloud solutions.
* Design scalable customer data platforms that consolidate customer information from multiple enterprise systems.
* Define Customer 360 architecture integrating Salesforce Data Cloud with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, and Agentforce.
* Establish architectural standards for data ingestion, transformation, harmonization, identity resolution, segmentation, and activation.
* Design batch, near-real-time, and streaming integration patterns based on business requirements.

**Data Modeling and Customer Identity**

* Design and implement Data Cloud data structures, including Data Lake Objects (DLOs), Data Model Objects (DMOs), and relevant calculated insight structures.
* Develop unified customer profiles by mapping and harmonizing data from multiple sources.
* Configure identity resolution rules, matching criteria, and reconciliation strategies.
* Implement data quality, governance, stewardship, consent management, and privacy controls.
* Optimize data models and processing strategies for performance, scalability, and data accuracy.

**Integration and Data Connectivity**

* Architect integrations between Salesforce Data Cloud and Salesforce CRM applications, Marketing Cloud Engagement, MuleSoft, Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, and other enterprise platforms.
* Design API-based, event-driven, batch, and streaming integration solutions.
* Define data ingestion strategies using supported connectors, APIs, and external data sources.
* Collaborate with integration and data engineering teams to troubleshoot data mapping, ingestion, synchronization, and connectivity issues.
* Establish integration standards for reliability, monitoring, security, and scalability.

**AI, Analytics, and Customer Engagement**

* Enable AI-powered customer engagement and analytics use cases using Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Design data architectures that support Einstein AI, Agentforce, predictive analytics, and Next Best Action scenarios.
* Enable customer segmentation and audience activation across supported Salesforce and external destinations.
* Support personalization, customer insights, and data-driven decision-making initiatives.
* Ensure relevant, governed customer data is available to downstream AI and engagement applications.

**Technical Leadership and Governance**

* Lead architecture reviews, technical assessments, and design discussions.
* Translate business requirements into technical architecture documents, integration designs, and implementation roadmaps.
* Mentor Salesforce developers, technical leads, and solution architects.
* Define reusable architectural patterns, implementation standards, and technical best practices.
* Participate in client workshops, requirement discovery, solution estimation, and pre-sales discussions where required.

**Security and Compliance**

* Define secure data access, sharing, and governance models.
* Implement appropriate role-based access, permissions, consent, and data protection controls.
* Align architecture with applicable privacy and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA where relevant.
* Ensure sensitive customer data is handled according to organizational security and compliance policies.

Required Qualifications

* 8+ years of relevant experience in Salesforce, enterprise data architecture, integration architecture, or related technical domains.
* Strong hands-on implementation experience with Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Experience designing Customer 360 solutions and unified customer profiles.
* Strong understanding of Data Streams, DLOs, DMOs, identity resolution, calculated insights, segmentation, and activation.
* Experience with data modeling, SQL, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, and data quality concepts.
* Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs, data integration patterns, and event-driven architectures.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise data platforms and external systems.
* Familiarity with MuleSoft, Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, or comparable enterprise technologies.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, manage stakeholders, and make architecture decisions.
* Strong communication, analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant.
* Salesforce Certified System Architect or Application Architect.
* Salesforce Certified Integration Architect.
* Salesforce Certified AI Associate or Agentforce Specialist.
* MuleSoft Architect certification.
* TOGAF certification or equivalent enterprise architecture experience.

Work Location: Remote

Job Title: Lead - SAP S/4HANA EWM MM Architect  
Experience: 10+ years of experience  
Job Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad / Pune / Mumbai  
Position ID: J1026-2269  
Work Type: Hybrid  
Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  
Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  
  
The SAP S/4HANA Design Expert will act as ARS's internal design authority for Materials Management, Procurement and Extended Warehouse Management within the S/4HANA transformation programme.  
  
The role will guide business stakeholders through S/4HANA process and design decisions, ensure alignment with fit to standard and clean core principles, and independently review and challenge the System Integrator's recommendations.  
  
This is a senior, hands on role requiring strong SAP MM and EWM consulting expertise, good knowledge of manufacturing operations, and the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders across Procurement, Manufacturing, Warehousing and Finance.  
  
1. Business Engagement and Guidance:
  
. Engage with BPOs, Domain Coordinators, process owners and key users to understand business objectives, operational constraints and improvement opportunities.  
. Guide the business through S/4HANA process changes and explain the operational impact in clear, non technical language.  
. Facilitate design discussions and help stakeholders make informed decisions.  
. Challenge requests that replicate legacy processes without sufficient business justification.  
. Distinguish between mandatory requirements, business preferences and unnecessary customisation.  
. Manage difficult discussions constructively and build alignment across stakeholders with different priorities.  
. Support the Business Process Expert in resolving cross domain dependencies and design conflicts.  
  
2. S/4HANA Design Authority
  
. Act as ARS's internal design authority for SAP MM, Procurement, Inventory Management and EWM.  
. Review and validate end to end designs proposed by the SI.  
. Ensure designs follow fit to standard, clean core, process harmonisation and architectural principles.  
. Challenge SI assumptions, estimates, customisation proposals and solution recommendations.  
. Evaluate solution options and clearly communicate their benefits, limitations, risks and business impacts.  
. Verify that approved requirements are correctly translated into functional designs and configuration.  
. Review process flows, functional specifications, configuration documents and WRICEF requirements.  
. Assess deviations from the global template and recommend approval, redesign or escalation.  
. Ensure traceability between business requirements, design decisions, build and testing.  
  
3. Functional Scope  
  
The role requires strong hands on expertise across:
  
. Procure to pay processes  
. Direct and indirect procurement  
. Purchase requisitions, purchase orders and approvals  
. Contracts, scheduling agreements and source determination  
. Inventory management and physical inventory  
. Goods receipt, goods issue and stock transfers  
. Subcontracting, external processing and consignment  
. Invoice verification and Finance integration  
. Material valuation and automatic account determination  
. Material master and organisational structures  
. Batch, serial number and traceability requirements  
. Embedded and decentralised EWM scenarios  
. Inbound, outbound and internal warehouse processes  
. Put away, picking, packing, staging and replenishment  
. Handling unit, warehouse task and warehouse order management  
. Production supply and receipt from production  
. RF and mobile warehouse operations  
. EWM integration with MM, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance  
. Assessment of basic and advanced EWM capabilities  
  
4. Cross Domain Integration and Delivery Assurance
  
. Evaluate the impact of MM and EWM decisions on Finance, Manufacturing, Quality and other connected functions.  
. Work closely with the Finance, Procurement and Manufacturing Domain Coordinators.  
. Identify cross domain dependencies before designs are approved.  
. Participate in fit to standard workshops, design reviews and solution playback sessions.  
. Review SI deliverables for completeness, quality and compliance with the agreed scope.  
. Support prioritization of process gaps, developments and improvements.  
. Review end to end test scenarios and support business teams during testing.  
. Assist in determining whether defects originate from design, configuration, data or business processes.  
. Support cutover, deployment and post go live stabilisation when required.  
. Ensure key design decisions, risks, assumptions and exceptions are properly documented.  
  
  
Required Experience and Competencies:
  
. Significant SAP consulting experience, including large scale transformation programmes.  
. Strong hands on expertise in SAP S/4HANA MM, Procurement, Inventory Management and EWM.  
. Experience in at least two full cycle S/4HANA implementations, preferably within complex manufacturing organisations.  
. Strong understanding of integration across Procurement, Warehousing, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance.  
. Knowledge of S/4HANA simplifications, Fiori, fit to standard delivery and clean core principles.  
. Ability to review configuration, functional specifications, integration designs and enhancement requirements.  
. Proven experience reviewing and challenging System Integrator deliverables.  
. Understanding of master data, migration, testing, cutover and deployment.  
. Experience with selective data transition or Bluefield programmes would be advantageous.  
. Knowledge of Ariba and other procurement or warehouse integrations would be beneficial.  
. Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation and conflict resolution skills.  
. Ability to translate technical topics into clear business language.  
. Confidence to constructively challenge both business stakeholders and the SI.  
. Pragmatic, independent and solution oriented approach.  
. Need to liaise and collaborate with both Internal MM team and S4 Program. Advisory from Arabelle IT MM Team.

* Maintain detailed SOPs, configuration documents, architecture diagrams, and knowledge base content.

* Proficiency in automation tools such as Ansible, and scripting languages like Bash; familiarity with REST APIs.

* Excellent troubleshooting and performance tuning skills across compute, networking, and storage layers. Experience

  

**Key skills required:**

  

* Education-BE or Btech or MTech or ME

* 8+ years of experience in virtualization and Linux infrastructure administration.
* Solid hands-on experience managing OVM and OLVM environments in production.
* Experience in enterprise environments with multi-cluster and large-scale deployments. Good to have
* Certifications such as Oracle Linux Certification, RHCE, or equivalent.
* Prior experience in managed services, large-scale data centers, or multi-vendor environments. • Exposure to VMware, Hyper-V, or cloud-based virtualization platforms is a plus.
  

Good to have

* VCP/VCAP Certifications
* Oracle Linux / OLVM Certifications
* Veritas InfoScale Certification
* PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL
* Exposure to Azure, AWS or OCI

* Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP FICO solutions and designs.
* Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.

* A team of people with commercial acumen, experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 250+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Data practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
* Preferred Skills – S/4 Finance and Group Reporting (GR),SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP BW/4HANA, Central Finance, SAP BPC, Fiori.

**What working at EY offers:**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

* Demonstrated ability to build project charters and drive programs from ambiguity to delivery with minimal direction
* Proficiency with program management tooling and artifacts: roadmaps, Gantt charts, risk registries, and milestone tracking (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent)
* Strong command of agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and familiarity with waterfall delivery where applicable
* Solid understanding of SDLC and how software moves from concept to production

**Technical Fluency**

* Working knowledge of engineering fundamentals — infrastructure, architecture, and system design — sufficient to engage credibly with technical teams
* Familiarity with design principles, APIs, and cloud platforms
* Comfort with AI tools and a creative, curious approach to using them — especially for reporting, documentation, and program communication

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Strong cross-functional coordination skills — comfortable managing relationships across engineering, product, design, and business stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate technical complexity for executive audiences without losing the detail that matters
* High ownership mindset — you treat program outcomes as your own, not someone else’s responsibility
* Genuine team player who builds trust within your immediate team and across stakeholder groups alike

**Nice to Have**

* Direct work experience in capital markets, fintech, or front office environments (order management, portfolio management, or trading systems)
* Experience scaling a TPM function or standing up program management practices in a growing organization
* Familiarity with DevOps practices — useful for infrastructure or platform-adjacent programs
* Experience with budgeting and resource management at the program level
* Familiarity with OKR/KPI frameworks and how to connect program execution to business outcomes
* Technical background — prior development, platform, or systems experience, or active personal coding projects

**Who You Are**

You thrive in ambiguity and build the structure others need. You ask the hard questions early, escalate with context (not just problems), and know the difference between coordinating work and owning it.

You lead with integrity. You show up for your team and your stakeholders with honesty, consistency, and a genuine desire to help them succeed — not just to check a box. You understand that trust is built through follow-through, and you take that seriously.

You are a team player in the truest sense — collaborative within your TPM team and a reliable partner to every stakeholder you work with. You bring people along rather than steamrolling, and you know that the best program outcomes happen when everyone feels heard and aligned.

You’ve operated in fast-moving environments where the org chart doesn’t tell the whole story — and you’ve figured out how to get things done anyway.

What we Offer:
