**Experience:**
10–13 years
  
  
**Role Overview:**
The Manager will play a pivotal role in building and scaling EY GDS's AI Strategy & Transformation practice. This leadership role combines hands-on cloud and AI platform architect expertise with consulting excellence, driving end-to-end AI platform implementation, infrastructure modernization and enterprise deployment programs while managing senior client relationships and CxO engagements. The position demands deep technical implementation skills in AI platform and infrastructure engineering, multi-cloud architecture, automation and deployment engineering, MLOps enablement and operationalization of AI workloads alongside proven program leadership across industries like BFSI, manufacturing and regulated sectors.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering and Architecture Leadership

+ Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
+ Architect scalable cloud-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.
+ Build secure and resilient infrastructure for AI model development, training, deployment and runtime operations including compute, GPU environments, storage, networking, secrets management and access control.
+ Design reusable platform services for model hosting, inference endpoints, vector databases, prompt orchestration, agent runtime support and enterprise API integration.
+ Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.
+ Enable secure AI platform controls with policy enforcement, access governance, auditability and support for Responsible AI, compliance and risk requirements.
+ Drive standardization of AI platform architecture through reusable patterns, landing zones, environment templates and enterprise engineering best practices.

* Client & Stakeholder Management

+ Serve as primary technical advisor to CxOs, account leadership teams and enterprise engineering stakeholders on AI platform strategy, cloud modernization and deployment architecture.
+ Conduct technical workshops demonstrating platform blueprints, deployment models, MLOps capabilities, observability approaches and AI operational readiness.
+ Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.
+ Build trusted relationships through hands-on PoC delivery, architecture discussions and strategic guidance on AI platform adoption

* Cloud, Automation & Deployment Engineering Leadership

+ Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.
+ Design and implement CI/CD and CT pipelines for AI platforms, model deployment services, APIs, microservices and environment lifecycle management.
+ Drive containerization and orchestration patterns using Docker and Kubernetes including workload isolation, autoscaling, high availability and release automation.
+ Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
+ Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
+ Implement release engineering practices including blue-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
+ Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.

* MLOps, Data Pipelines & Operationalization Leadership

+ Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
+ Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
+ Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud-native data services.
+ Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
+ Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service-level performance.
+ Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise-grade deployments.
+ Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk-sensitive environments.

* Asset and Accelerator Development

+ Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
+ Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
+ Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.

* Business Development & GTM Initiatives

These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. Youll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.

**Position Summary**

**Level: Associate Architect**

As an Associate Architect at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

As a Cloud Strategy practitioner, you will be responsible for working collaboratively within integrated cross functional teams to deliver comprehensive strategies that enable Cloud and Infrastructure Transformations.

Prepare technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and resolve ambiguities. Develop solutions in line with established technical designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Create and enforce technical design and development guides, templates, and standards. Facilitate daily scrum meetings, manage deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Conduct detailed deliverable reviews and provide technical guidance to team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross-functional teams. Design templates or scripts to automate routine development or operational tasks.

* Expertise in J2EE and Spring Boot:
* Strong proficiency in Java/J2EE frameworks, with a focus on Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Cloud.
* Extensive experience in developing scalable, high-performance enterprise applications using J2EE.
* Cloud Computing (AWS/Azure):
* Deep understanding and hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, ECS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFormation) or Azure (App Services, Kubernetes Service, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB, Azure Functions).
* Proficiency in designing and deploying microservices architectures on cloud platforms.
* Microservices Architecture:
* Strong expertise in building and managing microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud Netflix (Eureka, Hystrix, Zuul, Ribbon), and REST/GraphQL APIs.
* Experience with inter-service communication using gRPC or Kafka.
* Performance Optimization:
* Proven experience in profiling, monitoring, and optimizing applications for performance using tools like JMeter, Java Flight Recorder..
* Expertise in JVM tuning, memory management, and SQL query optimization.
* DevOps Practices and CI/CD:
* Hands-on experience with DevOps tools and methodologies, including:
* CI/CD tools: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline.
* Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible.
* Monitoring tools: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk.
* Database and Data Storage:
* Expertise in relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and SQL Server.
* Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, DynamoDB, or Cosmos DB.
* Code Reviews and Best Practices:
* Expertise in conducting thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to SOLID principles, design patterns, and industry-standard best practices.
* Proficiency in writing clean, modular, and maintainable code using tools like SonarQube or PMD for static code analysis.
* API Management and Security:
* Experience in designing and managing APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, or API Gateway.
* Knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols like OAuth2, JWT, and SAML.
* System Architecture and Design:
* Strong experience in architecting scalable, distributed systems using microservices, event-driven architectures, and domain-driven design (DDD).
* Proficiency in creating technical design documents and architectural diagrams using tools like Visio, Lucidchart, or Archimate.
* Continuous Learning and Collaboration:
* Commitment to staying updated with the latest advancements in Java, J2EE, and cloud-native technologies.
* Excellent collaboration skills with cross-functional teams (Product, QA, DevOps) to ensure alignment and deliver high-quality solutions.

**The team:**

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Qualifications

* 10 - 17 years of industry experience, with at least 6+ years in a technical architect role designing applications and hosting solutions as public/private cloud SaaS PaaS platforms.

* Should have knowledge to understand and create the Target State Solutions.

* Maven build Tools

* Event Driven Implementation: Kafka connector library Integration with Java.
* Should have good knowledge of SOLID principles and Java Design Pattern
* Should define Interfaces and re-usable components to avoid duplicate effort - For Ex: Circuit breaker, Retry, Error Handling.
* Experience in application migration and modernization of legacy applications to AWS cloud platforms.
* Familiarity of principles summarized in the AWS Cloud Adoption and Well-Architected Frameworks
* Deep expertise of architecting and designing end-to-end AWS solutions architecture, recommending best cloud architecture patterns suiting the business problems, (Integrating services like: AWS API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Function, Amazon MQ, Lambda, AWS S3 and storage classes, etc.)

* Working knowledge of AWS CodePipeline, CodeCommit, CodeBuild, CodeArtifact, AWS X-Ray, IAM Policies, KMS, GuardDuty, etc.
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, design and implementation creating cloud architecture leveraging PaaS and IaaS.
* Strong understanding of the cloud native development practices and architectural patterns
* Experience in leading and managing teams within specialist areas from project planning to execution

* Understanding of backup, replication, disaster recovery and high availability technologies
* Understanding on network architectures including integration of software components such as web / application servers, middleware, RDBMS, development environments, operational components and data center operations
* Understanding of cloud security and regulatory policies and governance mechanisms
* Experience in marketplace tools for cloud discovery, migration and modernization or Cloud FinOps
* Experience in cloud infrastructure design of data, storage and networking infrastructure, addressing disaster recovery and business continuity planning requirements

**Education:**

**Job Description**

* Finance AI Strategy & Innovation | Brief Job Description

**Role Intent**

* A hands-on delivery leader who can shape a new squad, turn an undefined AI opportunity into an executable plan, and own delivery outcomes while continuing to lead core Scrum activities.

**Role purpose**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of a Finance AI Strategy squad operating in a complex and evolving environment.
* The role will establish the squad, delivery approach, governance and working rhythm, translating business problems into prioritised, measurable outcomes from discovery and experimentation through implementation and adoption.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own delivery from problem definition and discovery through planning, build, testing, release, adoption and outcome tracking.

* Translate ambiguous business and AI opportunities into a clear roadmap, prioritised backlog, milestones and achievable delivery plans.
* Manage scope, capacity, risks, assumptions, dependencies, blockers and trade-offs, escalating early with clear options and recommendations.
* Lead stakeholder alignment across Finance, Product, Data, Architecture, Engineering, Risk and third-party suppliers.
* Facilitate Scrum activities including refinement, sprint planning, daily coordination, reviews and retrospectives, applying Agile practices pragmatically rather than mechanically.
* Maintain delivery transparency through Jira, dashboards, milestone reporting, decisions, delivery confidence and measurable outcomes.
* Create a culture of ownership, experimentation, learning and continuous improvement in a setting where no established playbook may exist.

**Essential Experience And Capabilities**

* Proven ownership of complex technology, transformation, data or AI-enabled delivery, with clear evidence of personal contribution and business impact.
* Experience establishing a new squad, delivery model, product initiative or programme from an early or undefined starting point.
* Ability to operate confidently in ambiguity, structure complex problems and progress decisions with incomplete information.
* Strong delivery management across planning, governance, risk, dependencies, stakeholder communication and execution.
* Practical Scrum and Agile expertise, supported by delivery judgement rather than ceremony-only facilitation.
* Credibility with senior business and technology stakeholders, including the ability to challenge constructively and influence without formal authority.
* Working knowledge of AI, data, automation or emerging-technology delivery is strongly desirable; deep technical development expertise is not mandatory.
* Basic delivery-level understanding of the SAP Finance landscape is advantageous, including exposure to SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW and Finance processes such as Record to Report (R2R), together with awareness of other relevant SAP modules. This is desirable rather than mandatory; deep SAP functional or technical expertise is not required.

2c46492a.title: Service Delivery Manager - Metso IT Ops Network Services
2c46492a.description:
Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials – the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life.
  
  
Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources.
  
  
Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration.
  
  
This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible.
  
  
**Job posting end date:**  
Network Service Delivery Manager – APAC
  
  
Introduction
  
  
We are looking for a Network Service Delivery Manager – APAC to join our Network Service Delivery team in Information Technology. In this role, you will ensure reliable, secure, cost-effective and business-aligned network services across the Asia-Pacific region. You will be the regional link between business stakeholders, Country IT teams, Global Network, Architecture, Information Security, project teams and external service providers, and you will make sure regional needs – including offices, manufacturing plants and service locations – are well represented in our global network operating model.
  
  
This role is based in Gurugram, India, and includes regional travel as required.
  
  
Team you will belong to
  
  
You will join our Network Service Delivery community, working closely with the Network Service Delivery Team Lead and regional service delivery managers to keep ways of working and service delivery practices consistent across regions. We collaborate with Country IT teams, global network service owners, Information Security, Procurement, Finance and external service providers. Our work spans APAC time zones and includes participation in agreed major-incident escalation and planned maintenance arrangements.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
Oversee the delivery and performance of network services across APAC sites, including local and wireless networks, software-defined WAN (SD-WAN), internet connectivity and secure remote access, aligning resilience with global site criticality standards.
  
Manage service performance against agreed service-level and operational-level agreements, working with internal teams and service providers to maintain availability, capacity and readiness.
  
Act as the regional escalation point for critical network incidents, coordinating restoration, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and corrective actions, and govern network changes and resilience testing.
  
Serve as the regional focal point for network demand, ensuring business and site requirements are documented, prioritized and progressed with Country IT, Global Network, Architecture, Information Security, Operational Technology (OT) and project teams, in line with global standards and approved designs, including IT/OT network segmentation where applicable.
  
Represent APAC priorities in global network service, governance and roadmap discussions, and drive regional improvement opportunities.
  
Coordinate service provider relationships, monitor supplier performance and escalations, and partner with Procurement, Global Service Owners and Country IT Managers on service requirements, renewals, budgets, costs and cost optimization.
  
Coordinate network needs for new site setups, expansions, relocations, closures and integrations of acquired businesses, and communicate service performance, risks, outages and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  
Ensure new or changed network services move into operations with accurate service records, monitoring and documentation, and drive improvements in monitoring, reporting, automation and operational analytics.
  
  
What you’ll bring
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Network Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
Typically 8–10 years of experience in enterprise network services, infrastructure operations or IT service management, including service delivery, vendor management or regional coordination across multiple countries.
  
Solid understanding of enterprise networking, including local and wireless networks, SD-WAN, internet connectivity, routing, VPNs, IT/OT network segmentation, high-availability architectures and network security fundamentals.
  
Demonstrated experience managing service-level agreements, major incidents, problem resolution, service transitions and supplier performance.
  
Strong stakeholder management, analytical, communication and commercial skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  
ITIL Foundation certification or higher, or other relevant networking, infrastructure or IT service management certifications (nice to have).
  
Experience managing network services in a global, multi-vendor environment, ideally in manufacturing, industrial, mining or other operationally critical multi-site settings, and experience within APAC (nice to have).
  
Familiarity with enterprise SD-WAN, switching, wireless and network monitoring platforms such as Palo Alto Prisma SD-WAN, HPE Aruba or SolarWinds, or equivalent (nice to have).
  
  
What’s in it for you
  
  
At Metso, you will combine meaningful work with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact in a supportive and inclusive environment. You’ll be part of a global team where collaboration, wellbeing, and continuous learning are part of everyday work.
  
  
**We support your growth and wellbeing by offering:**  
**Purpose-led work:** Contribute to enabling sustainable modern life and transforming the industry.
  
**Wellbeing:** Access to wellbeing programs, occupational healthcare, and supportive services.
  
**Rewards:** Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
  
**Growth:** Learning pathways, mentoring, internal mobility, and global collaboration opportunities.
  
**Culture:** A caring, collaborative, and inclusive workplace committed to helping you thrive.
  
  
Get in touch
  
  
Want to rise above the possible with us? Click “Apply now” to submit your application.
  
  
We recognize that highly capable candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every listed requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification. You may be exactly the right candidate for the role.
  
  
**Hiring Manager:** Shiji Nambiar
  
  
Metso is committed to pay equity and transparent reward practices globally. Compensation information is shared in line with local legislation and applicable recruitment practices.
  
  
How to join - Working at Metso - About Metso - Diversity and Inclusion - Meet our people
  
  
Metso is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran or status as a qualified individual with a disability.
  
  
Metso is a frontrunner in sustainable technologies, end-to-end solutions and services for the aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining industries globally. We improve our customers’ energy and water efficiency, increase their productivity, and reduce environmental risks with our product and service expertise. We are the partner for positive change.
  
  
Metso is headquartered in Espoo, Finland. At the end of 2025 Metso had close to 18,000 employees in around 50 countries, and sales in 2025 were about EUR 5.3 billion. Metso is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki.

Amazon Health Services (AHS) is on a mission to make it dramatically easier for customers to find, choose, afford and engage with the services, products, and professionals they need to get and stay healthy. We use design, service and technology to provide the best possible customer experience and change the way people think about healthcare. Our team owns some of the Science charter of AHS and specifically the Evaluations of Health AI and Integrations team (integration of Health AI and Pharmacy) along with all of the data that powers our optimization and valuation services.
  
  
We are seeking a lead Technical Program Manager to partner with our Engineering, Product, Science and Marketing teams to deliver world class experiences for our customers. This position will require a broad set of skills that will range from deep-dive analytical problem solving, working with engineering, understanding science to executive reporting. You will be working directly with engineering and science tech teams, Product and business teams, and all of our partner teams, which include teams within and outside of AHS.
  
  
The right person will demonstrate proven track of software delivery and good management experience to manage numerous stakeholders and ambiguous processes; understand how to evaluate control effectiveness; understand potential risks and how to address them; provide in-depth consultation; be able to deliver high priority projects; and have the ability to prioritize mitigation efforts using risk management concepts. We are looking for a leader who excels at building and managing mechanisms, continuously evaluating how to improve these mechanisms, and then revising on an ongoing basis. AHS is in start-up mode, and we are seeking a leader that is flexible, dynamic, and can proactively make recommendations on how to improve our approach.

Identifying and problem-solving risks across the software development lifecycle and developing escalation paths where appropriate,
  
  
Owning key business processes and leadership mechanisms for flagship projects and coordinating task development and completion,
  
  
Supporting career development and growth within the team by sharing mechanism best practices and participating in the team’s recruiting efforts
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon’s mission is to make it dramatically easier for customers to access the healthcare products and services they need to get and stay healthy. Towards this mission, we (Health Store and Tech) are building the technology, products and services, that help customers find, buy, and engage with the healthcare solutions they need.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience

* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. We are looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead a high-visibility Data Insights Program for a large payments client. The ideal candidate will have 10+ years of program management experience, a strong background in data products, analytics platforms, data architecture, and data engineering, and the ability to establish program roadmaps and governance structures in a fast-moving environment.

  

This is a data-focused program leadership role requiring strong stakeholder management, enterprise delivery, regulatory compliance, and financial management capabilities.

**Working Hours:** Must overlap with US Eastern Time  
**Certification:** Active PMP certification is mandatory

* Lead complex, cross-functional data programs from initial scoping through implementation and go-live.
* Define program roadmaps, governance structures, priorities, and delivery plans.
* Coordinate data product, analytics and insights platform, data architecture, and engineering teams.
* Translate business requirements into actionable data and insights deliverables.

**Preferred Qualifications**

240af652.title: PDM Digital Supply Chain Solution Engineer
240af652.description:
**Purpose And Scope**
The PDM Digital Supply Chain Solution Engineer is responsible for shaping and assuring digital solutions across three core areas: SAP S/4HANA and ECC supply chain implementations, supply chain network design, and control tower and end-to-end supply chain visibility.
  
  
The role translates business, operational, data and regulatory requirements into scalable, secure and compliant solution designs for manufacturing-focused supply chain management. It works across demand and supply planning, procurement, production planning, manufacturing execution integration, materials management, inventory and quality-related processes, ensuring that SAP and connected platforms support an integrated global manufacturing supply chain operating model.
  
  
Working with Business Process Owners, System Owners, DigitalX, Enterprise Architecture, Quality, Validation, Data and Analytics teams, and delivery partners, the role leads solution design, technical assurance, integration, testing and implementation activities through stabilisation and transition to operations in a GxP-regulated environment.
  
  

* SAP S/4HANA and ECC Supply Chain Implementations
* Support solution design for SAP S/4HANA and ECC implementations, upgrades, rollouts and process harmonisation across supply chain capabilities.
* Translate business requirements into fit-to-standard process designs and functional requirements.
* Define solutions spanning relevant SAP manufacturing supply chain capabilities, including demand and supply planning, procurement, materials management, inventory management, production planning, manufacturing execution integration and quality-related processes.
* Ensure designs support global templates while addressing justified site, market, regulatory and operational requirements.
* Supply Chain Network Design
* Shape digital capabilities that support supply chain network design, including manufacturing footprint, plant, contract-manufacturing, sourcing and supply-network scenarios.
* Define data, modelling and integration requirements for scenario analysis covering capacity, demand, inventory, lead times, service levels, cost, risk and resilience.
* Partner with supply chain stakeholders to translate network strategy questions into repeatable analytical models, decision criteria and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure network-design solutions use governed master data, transparent assumptions and traceable scenario outputs that can be connected to planning and execution processes.
* Control Tower and Supply Chain Visibility
* Design control tower and visibility capabilities that provide timely, role-based insight across the end-to-end supply chain.
* Define event, milestone, alert, exception and workflow requirements across suppliers, contract manufacturers, production sites, inventory locations, markets, customers and enterprise systems.
* Establish requirements for dashboards, operational KPIs, drill-down analysis, predictive insights, exception prioritisation and coordinated response management.
* Define integration across SAP ECC or S/4HANA, planning and manufacturing platforms, external supply partners, data platforms and analytics tools using APIs, middleware, EDI and event-based patterns.
* Ensure visibility solutions have clear data ownership, business rules, thresholds, escalation paths and measurable decision-making value.
* Delivery, Testing and Validation
* Support assigned solution workstreams from discovery and design through build, integration, deployment, stabilisation and transition to support.
* Define the technical test strategy and support system integration testing and UAT support, including end-to-end processes, interfaces, data, roles, controls, regression and applicable non-functional testing.
* Ensure test scripts, test data, evidence, defects, retesting and approvals comply with applicable GxP validation and change-control requirements.
* Stakeholder and Partner Leadership
* Act as a principal digital interface for global supply chain stakeholders, business process owners, technology teams, quality functions and external partners.
* Facilitate requirements, design, testing and decision workshops, clearly communicating solution options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs.
* Challenge vendors and delivery partners on solution quality, fit-to-standard, estimates, delivery risks and long-term supportability.
* Maintain transparent design decisions, assumptions, dependencies, risks and acceptance criteria.

**Essential Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Supply Chain or a related discipline.
* Experience delivering SAP S/4HANA and/or ECC supply chain implementations, upgrades or global rollouts in a complex organisation.
* Strong end-to-end knowledge of manufacturing supply chain processes and their integration across demand and supply planning, procurement, materials management, production planning, manufacturing, quality and inventory.
* Experience translating business requirements into SAP solution designs
* Practical experience with supply chain network design concepts, scenario modelling and the data needed to assess cost, capacity, inventory, service and resilience trade-offs.
* Experience designing or implementing supply chain control tower, visibility, event management, alerting, exception management, workflow or operational analytics capabilities.
* Experience integrating SAP with planning, manufacturing, partner, data and analytics platforms using APIs, middleware, EDI or event-based integration.
* Hands-on experience leading or coordinating system integration testing and UAT support, including planning, test data, defect management, retesting and evidence.
* Experience delivering systems in a GxP or similarly regulated environment, with working knowledge of validation and change control.
* Strong communication, facilitation, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desirable Qualifications And Experience**

* Pharmaceutical or life-sciences experience, including GxP validation and audit readiness.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA and ECC Supply Chain Functionalities .
* Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI or comparable supply chain planning, network-design, visibility or analytics platforms.
* Experience defining operational KPIs, event models, alert thresholds, exception workflows and response governance for supply chain control towers.
* Experience with data products, master-data governance, cloud data platforms, advanced analytics, optimisation or AI-enabled supply chain use cases.
* Relevant SAP, supply chain, architecture, data, testing, validation, Agile or cloud certification.

**Working Environment**

**Job Description**
The Senior Solution Architect for US Targeting, Recommendation, Optimization & Measurement (TROM) provides technical leadership for data, analytics, and technology capabilities that enable more effective targeting, personalized recommendations, optimization, and measurement across the US organization.
  
  
As technical Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Description of the area**

* Scope: Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards.. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Work with Cross functional business stakeholders to understand requirements, propose solutions, and address technical concerns
* Lead complex architecture discussions — designing scalable, production-grade solutions spanning data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics
* Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded and published for multiple solutions or the product. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments
* Provide technical leadership across data pipelines, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and analytical/ML solutions to the Engineering team
* Guide engineering teams on architecture, coding standards, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, security, and operational readiness
* Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product
* Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
* Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
* Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring

**Qualifications**
**Education / Experience**

* Minimum 10+ years of professional experience in data management and Analytics
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Strong experience in Architecture best practise, software engineering, data engineering, or enterprise technology delivery
* Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context
* Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes
* Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with AWS cloud services like Lambda, EC2, EMR, Redshift, Glue, S3, Athena, IAM, RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB etc
* Experience in AWS GLUE ETL tool and having good knowledge on any of the ETL tools
* Strong technical expose to AWS data and Analytics services particularly Lambda, Step functions, EMR, Athena, Glue, Data-Pipelines
* Strong knowledge of CS fundamentals, system design, REST APIs, databases, data engineering, distributed systems, and cloud architecture
* Experience with SQL, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, APIs, and large-scale data processing
* Experience with modern engineering practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and production support
* Experience working with data science/ML solutions/Agentic AI and productionizing models is preferred
* Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for products
* Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions
* Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for multiple solutions, including conducting vendor assessments
* Stay current on industry trends, regulations, and emerging technologies in the healthcare and life sciences space
* Experience in Commercial Pharma lifescience domain -

+ Experience in Customer Engagement, Marketing, Forecasting
+ Payer/PBMs, DRG lives, MMIT Access positions, CareGaps, Campaign data
+ IQVIA Sales, 867 Sales, 340B ,and other discounts programs etc

6baae134.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – APIGEE Platform Architect Position**
Over the last decade, API-led connectivity, cloud-native modernization and digital transformation have become critical for ensuring scalability, security and resilience across enterprise ecosystems. To support this evolving digital landscape, EY leverages Google Apigee, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure and DevOps automation to deliver secure, high-performance and highly available API management platforms for mission-critical business applications.
  
  
As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work as a Manager APIGEE Platform Architect supporting large-scale API management environments across hybrid and multi-cloud deployments.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are offering you a demanding role. You will use your advanced expertise in Google Apigee, Kubernetes, Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps Automation, API Security and Enterprise Architecture to deliver secure, scalable and highly available solutions for mission-critical enterprise integrations and API ecosystems. This position provides opportunities to collaborate with global stakeholders and support API modernization, cloud transformation and operational excellence initiatives.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee Apigee platform architecture and implementation.
* Act as the primary escalation point for Apigee and platform issues.
* Design and support end-to-end platform migrations and modernization programs.
* Drive infrastructure automation, governance and security standards.
* Collaborate with networking, cloud, security and DevOps teams.
* Define HA, DR, scalability and resiliency requirements.
* Establish observability, monitoring and operational readiness standards.

**Strong Understanding Of:**

* Apigee X and Apigee Hybrid architecture
* Kubernetes platforms (GKE, EKS, AKS, and On-Prem Kubernetes)
* Cloud platforms including GCP, AWS, and Azure
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
* API Security concepts including OAuth2, JWT, TLS, and mTLS
* CI/CD pipelines and APIOps implementation
* Monitoring and Observability using Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, and Splunk
* Disaster Recovery (DR), High Availability (HA), and Resiliency design
* Networking, Load Balancing, DNS, and Traffic Management
* Platform Governance, Security Controls, and Compliance Frameworks

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Effective stakeholder and client management skills
* Strong architecture and technical documentation expertise
* Presentation and solution demonstration skills
* Team-player mindset with collaborative working style
* Self-motivated and proactive attitude
* Ability to lead architecture reviews and design workshops
* Experience driving Proof of Concepts (POCs) and innovation initiatives
* Strong decision-making and technical leadership capabilities
* Ability to work across global and cross-functional teams

**To Qualify for the Role, you must have**

* 8 to 14 years of relevant experience in API Management, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or Enterprise Architecture
* Extensive hands-on experience with Google Apigee (Apigee X and/or Apigee Hybrid)
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes operations and platform architecture
* Experience designing and implementing cloud-native solutions on GCP, AWS, or Azure
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, IAM, and infrastructure services
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or equivalent tools
* Hands-on experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and APIOps practices
* Expertise in enterprise security controls, API security, and compliance requirements
* Experience leading architecture design sessions, workshops, and technical governance reviews
* Proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale API platform implementations
* Ability to drive platform modernization, migration, and transformation initiatives
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, or Apigee certifications are preferred

**Additionally, Good To Have**

* IBM API Connect (APIC) and DataPower migration experience.
* Experience with GitOps tools such as ArgoCD, Flux CD, Helm, and Kustomize.
* Experience with security scanning and vulnerability management tools.
* API Developer Portal, API Monetization, and API Analytics expertise.
* Experience defining SLA/SLO, KPI dashboards, and operating models.
* Relevant certifications such as:

+ Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
+ Google Apigee API Engineer Certification
+ Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Possesses good communication skills to coordinate, resolve queries of both external and internal customers
* Self-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.
* Flexible to work either independently or work in tandem with Cloud Infrastructure team to identify and implement the most efficient cloud-based solutions for the company.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1000+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Oracle and Enterprise Applications practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

c44a4988.description:
Profile: Senior hands-on architect who can design solutions, explain architectural choices, build prototypes, and guide teams through implementation.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on Data Platform Architect to help establish and scale our Data & AI Practice. The role combines modern cloud data architecture, technical solutioning, client advisory, and engineering leadership to deliver enterprise data modernization and AI-ready platforms.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Obsession: Work backwards from customer and end-user needs to design solutions that deliver measurable business value. Build trusted advisory relationships with customers, guiding technology decisions and long-term architecture strategy.
* Platform Architecture: Design scalable, cloud-native data platforms covering ingestion, integration, lakehouse/warehouse, processing, governance, analytics, and AI enablement.
* AI-Ready Architecture: Design data integration patterns supporting enterprise AI, including RAG, LLM integration, agentic workflows, and MCP-based connectivity.
* Hands-on Solutioning: Lead technical discovery, architecture workshops, POCs/MVPs, and guide engineering teams through implementation.
* Modernization: Architect migration and integration of legacy enterprise data into modern cloud platforms, incorporating MDM, Data Quality, and Governance.
* Practice Development: Build reusable reference architectures, accelerators, and implementation patterns, and contribute to technology partnerships and client proposals.

**Required Expertise & Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience architecting and implementing enterprise data platforms on AWS, with a solid understanding of Azure and GCP architectures, comparative strengths, trade-offs, and evolving technology roadmaps.
* Deep expertise in Databricks and Snowflake, including lakehouse architecture, data engineering, pipelines, integration patterns, and native AI capabilities. Strong architectural familiarity with both platforms is expected.
* Working knowledge of GenAI architectures, including RAG, LLM integration, agentic AI, and MCP.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data management, including MDM, Data Quality, Governance, security, and production operations. Familiarity with leading platforms such as Reltio, Informatica, Collibra, and Alation, including their integration into enterprise data architectures.
* Ability to translate business requirements into architecture, develop working prototypes, and provide technical leadership during delivery.
* North American Customer Experience: Minimum 5 years of direct engagement with North American customers, including technical discovery, architecture discussions, solution advisory, and stakeholder management.
* Strong client-facing communication, solution architecture, and technical thought-leadership skills.

Preferred: Experience in enterprise modernization programs, AI-ready data platforms, and consulting or practice-building environments.

6701ad1e.title: Sr Tech Infra Program Manager, DCPD
6701ad1e.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
  
  
Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ? Have you managed complex infrastructure projects ?  
  
If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Hyderabad, Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.  
  
You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering managing a team with strong urge to learn will be essential.  
  
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Senior Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in Hyderabad, Telangana India. The Sr TIPM manages delivery of ~5 projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity. The Sr TIPM is able to guide and develop partner teams to accomplish the regions goal.  
  
The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
  
  
A successful TPM Manager must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* 4+ years of project management experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management
* Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds
* Knowledge of mission critical systems (data centers, hospitals, power plants, military facilities, etc.)

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

29db4431.title: Technical Product Owner, GSINC Contracting Solution
29db4431.description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Technology Product & Platform Management
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Technical Product Management
  
  
**Job Category**
People Leader
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Bangalore, Karnataka, India, Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, India
  
  
**Job Description**
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/
  
  
Johnson & Johnson is recruiting for a
**Technical Product Owner, GSINC Contracting Solution**
, based in India. We are searching for top talent to join the Global Simplification and Innovation in Contracting program, GSINC.
  
  
Do you seek big, complex, and ambiguous challenges? Are you passionate about transforming enterprise contracting through simplified processes, modern technology, intelligent data, and responsible AI? Do you want to help build a capability that improves how Johnson & Johnson works with its employees, suppliers, customers, healthcare professionals, and research partners?
  
  
GSINC is building an integrated, AI-enabled contracting capability designed to make contracting faster, simpler, more consistent, and more valuable to the enterprise! The program brings together process, policy, templates, technology, data, and intelligence to establish a scalable, modern contracting foundation across Johnson & Johnson.
  
  
The
**Technical Product Owner, GSINC Contracting Solution**
will be responsible for translating the product strategy into an executable technology roadmap and scalable delivery model. This role will be responsible for the product backlog, shape priorities, coordinate dependencies, and establish the Agile and release practices required to support
**multiple concurrent deployments and continuous product evolution across the enterprise**
.
  
  
This is not simply a backlog-management role. The Technical Product Owner will help define
**how GSINC technology is built, released, scaled, and continuously improved**
, working across business, product, engineering, architecture, implementation partners, and platform teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product Ownership and Roadmap
  
  

* Own and continuously refine the product roadmap and backlog for the GSINC Contracting Solution, aligned to business priorities and enterprise strategy.
* Translate business capabilities, process requirements, and user needs into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical priorities.
* Drive prioritization based on value, user impact, technical dependencies, risk, scalability, and delivery capacity.
* Maintain a clear view of product health, technical debt, platform enhancements, integrations, defects, and innovation opportunities.

Agile Delivery and Product Management
  
  

* Lead Agile product practices across backlog refinement, sprint planning, prioritization, release planning, demos, retrospectives, and improvement.
* Balance near-term deployment requirements with the long-term integrity and scalability of the enterprise product.
* Use product metrics, user feedback, adoption data, and operational performance to continually refine priorities.

Concurrent Release and Deployment Model
  
  

* Design and operationalize an innovative delivery model that enables multiple GSINC deployments, enhancements, and product releases to progress concurrently.
* Establish release trains, development pathways, environment strategies, dependency management, testing approaches, and governance needed to move from sequential implementation toward continuous, parallel delivery.
* Define how enterprise product capabilities and business-specific deployments can advance simultaneously without creating unnecessary customization, fragmentation, or release conflicts.
* Create repeatable delivery patterns that allow GSINC to increase deployment velocity as adoption expands across business units, functions, and geographies.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks and continually improve the operating model to increase throughput, predictability, quality, and speed.
* Lead solution architects and engineering teams to ensure product decisions align with enterprise architecture, security, data, and technology standards.
* Champion reusable enterprise capabilities and configuration over unnecessary customization.

Performance and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Define and monitor product and delivery measures including adoption, release velocity, cycle time, quality, defects, stability, user experience, and business value.
* Use data to identify bottlenecks, prioritize improvements, and increase delivery throughput.
* Provide concise leadership updates on roadmap progress, releases, risks, dependencies, product health, and outcomes.
* Continuously evolve the GSINC product and delivery model as the program scales globally.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, business, or a related field.
* At least 10 years of relevant experience in technical product ownership, product management, Agile delivery, enterprise technology, or digital transformation.
* Demonstrated experience serving as a Product Owner or Technical Product Owner for a complex enterprise platform or product.
* Strong experience with Agile product development, backlog management, release planning, dependency management, and cross-functional delivery.
* Experience designing or operating delivery models that support multiple parallel workstreams, release trains, or concurrent deployments.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical capabilities, epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience working across engineering, architecture, business, testing, integration, data, and implementation teams.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms, workflow technology, integrations, APIs, data, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Contract Lifecycle Management or enterprise contracting experience preferred.
* Experience with platforms such as Azure DevOps or Jira and modern Agile/product management practices preferred.
* Agile, Product Owner, Scrum, SAFe, or product management certification preferred.

Leadership Capabilities
  
  

* Product mindset: Owns outcomes and product health, not simply requirements, ceremonies, or delivery activity.
* Technical fluency: Connects business needs with architecture, engineering, data, integration, and platform capabilities.
* Enterprise thinking: Builds reusable capabilities that scale across businesses and geographies while managing legitimate local requirements.
* Delivery orchestration: Creates the structure, cadence, and discipline required for multiple teams and releases to move concurrently.
* Bias for action: Works through ambiguity, removes obstacles, and moves teams toward decisions and outcomes.
* Strong judgment: Understands when to standardize, when to sequence, when to escalate, and where technical debt or complexity could constrain scale.
* Influence: Builds alignment across business, technology, vendors, and leadership without relying on direct authority.
* Data-driven communication: Uses evidence to prioritize decisions and provides leadership with clear, decision-ready recommendations.

Johnson & Johnson is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.
  
  
**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Analytical Reasoning, Consulting, Cost Management, Creating Purpose, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Developing Others, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Inclusive Leadership, Leadership, Performance Measurement, Product Development, Product Strategies, Project Management Methodology (PMM), Research and Development, Software Development Management, Strategic Supply Chain Management, Team Management

c4075368.title: Bid & Pre-Sales Executive (IT Tenders & RFPs)
c4075368.description:
**Bid & Pre-Sales Executive (IT Tenders & RFPs)**

Sajal Tech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. | Bhopal (On-site) | Full-time | 1 to 4 years experience

**About Us**

Sajal Tech Solutions is an AI-first software development company based in Bhopal. We build SaaS products, AI/ML solutions, mobile apps and automation for clients in India, the US, the UK and the UAE. We hold ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001 and CMMI Level 3 certifications, and we are a DPIIT-recognised startup and MSME.

**Role Summary**

You will run our government and enterprise IT bidding from start to finish. That means finding opportunities, understanding the technical scope, writing the proposal and submitting a compliant bid on time. You will work closely with our Head of Business Development and the technical team, and you need to know software well enough to write about it convincingly.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Tenders & Bids*

* Track and shortlist IT and software tenders and RFPs every day on GeM, CPPP (eprocure.gov.in), MP e-Tender, other state and PSU portals, and private or international RFP platforms
* Analyse each RFP and prepare a bid/no-bid summary covering scope, eligibility, PQ/TQ criteria, EMD, evaluation method and key dates
* Prepare complete bid packs, including technical and commercial proposals, compliance matrices, forms, annexures, affidavits and undertakings
* Submit bids online using a DSC and handle EMD/bid security, tender fees, BOQs and PBGs
* Attend pre-bid meetings, raise pre-bid queries, and track corrigenda, clarifications, technical evaluation and results
* Manage our GeM seller account, including catalogue, bids, reverse auctions and order acceptance
* Maintain a current bid library: registrations, certificates, financials, work orders, completion certificates, CVs and case studies
* Keep a tender tracker/MIS covering pipeline, submissions, win/loss and the reasons behind each result

*Technical Proposals & Pre-Sales*

* Write the technical sections of proposals: understanding of requirements, solution approach, architecture overview, technology stack, implementation plan, timelines, team deployment, SLA and support model
* Map RFP functional and technical requirements (FRS/SRS) into point-by-point compliance sheets
* Work with developers and architects on solution design, effort estimates, manpower plans and cost components (resources, cloud, licences, AMC)
* Prepare technical presentations and coordinate demos for evaluation committees and enterprise clients
* Create capability statements and case studies from our project portfolio

*Business Development Support*

* Help the Head of BD with proposals, decks and pricing inputs
* Handle vendor registrations and empanelments with government departments, PSUs and enterprises
* Find new opportunities, including upcoming tenders, consortium or partner bids, startup-friendly procurement and relevant schemes
* Manage follow-ups, CRM updates and documentation for active opportunities

**Requirements**

* B.Tech, BCA, MCA or B.Sc (IT/CS) strongly preferred
* 1 to 4 years in bid management or pre-sales for IT or software services
* Has submitted bids on GeM and CPPP or a state e-procurement portal, and can use a DSC independently
* Working knowledge of MSE and Startup relaxations (EMD exemption, prior turnover and experience waivers), Make in India (Class I/II supplier) and GFR basics
* Strong written English, with the ability to write clear, structured technical content

**Technical Knowledge (Must Have)**

This GTM role shapes customer perception, influences deal outcomes, and showcases NDBS India’s SAP Cloud leadership. You play a central role in customer-facing conversations, differentiating our offering, and accelerating SAP Cloud adoption for strategic accounts.
