e014abd8.title: Solutions specialist - Pre sales and implementation
e014abd8.description:
**About the role**

You’ll be the technical voice behind our sales engagements and see each solution through to go-live: discovery, PoC/PoV, implementation and handover. You’ll configure the product, work with customer IT teams, troubleshoot what breaks and work directly with Sales, Product and Customer Success.

**What you’ll do**

·      
**Lead technical pre-sales and solutioning.**
Understand customer requirements and IT environments, conduct tailored discovery sessions and demos, explain Nanoheal’s capabilities and architecture, support proposals/RFPs/RFIs, and identify technical risks, dependencies and differentiators.

·      
**Plan and execute PoCs/PoVs.**
Define use cases, scope, timelines and success criteria; configure the product and integrations; coordinate customer testing, troubleshoot issues, document outcomes and limitations, and support the transition to production.

·      
**Design and document solutions.**
Develop solution architecture, integration designs, deployment prerequisites, implementation plans and SOWs; define milestones, responsibilities and acceptance criteria, and flag gaps against standard product capabilities.

·      
**Lead implementation and go-live.**
Conduct kickoff and readiness assessments, validate infrastructure and security prerequisites, configure the platform, onboard endpoints, integrate enterprise systems, coordinate technical dependencies, validate functionality against acceptance criteria, and drive implementation sign-off.

·      
**Troubleshoot and enable partners.**
Diagnose and resolve deployment, integration, automation and performance issues; analyze logs, coordinate and validate fixes with Product, and guide SIs and MSPs on implementation, configuration and troubleshooting to enable independent delivery.

·      
**Document, report and hand over.**
Maintain solution designs, configurations, test results, implementation records and known limitations; communicate project progress, risks and dependencies to internal stakeholders; hand over technical details and outstanding actions to Customer Success and contribute to reusable delivery best practices and product feedback.

**Who we’re looking for**

•    Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, IT, Electronics or a related discipline.

•    3–6 years in technical pre-sales, solution consulting or enterprise software implementation.

•    You’ve run demos, discovery sessions and PoCs, and hands-on configured, deployed and troubleshot a product.

•    You know Windows endpoints, endpoint management and enterprise IT environments well.

•    You can explain technical concepts to IT leads and business stakeholders in their own language, and juggle several engagements at once.

**Bonus points**

•    ITSM, UEM, identity management and security tools

•    DEX, DXA, endpoint management or self-healing IT experience

•    SQL, APIs and enterprise system integrations

c80d35e2.title: RFP & Solutions Manager
c80d35e2.description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a strategic thinker to own Payoneer's RFP and solutions delivery capability. You will build a modern, knowledge-driven RFP function that leverages AI and automation to scale response quality. You will also serve as a Solution & Implementation Manager on enterprise deals, building deep product and customer knowledge that directly informs RFP accuracy and responsiveness.
  
  
**This Role Balances Two Complementary Responsibilities**

* Designing and evolving a scalable RFP capability through knowledge management and automation
* Acting as a hands-on SIM when RFP volume is lower. The SIM expertise is what enables RFP excellence—knowing our solutions intimately allows you to ensure responses accurately reflect product capabilities and implementation realities

Location: Gurgaon, India
  
  
Work Arrangement: Hybrid (to be coordinated to overlap with EMEA/Global teams)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
What You'll Own
  
  
Knowledge Management & RFP Strategy (Primary)
  
  

* Design and maintain a centralized knowledge management system that serves as the foundation for RFP responses
* Build automation and AI-assisted workflows to cover automated intake parsing, response drafting, versioning, knowledge management and quality gating
* Define RFP policies; ensure organization-wide understanding and adoption
* Lead continuous improvement: analyze win/loss themes, refresh content quarterly, incorporate feedback from Sales and delivery teams
* Own the accuracy of RFP responses by leveraging hands-on SIM knowledge to ensure solution descriptions and commitments reflect delivery reality
* Partner with Sales, Product, Ops, and Compliance to maintain content quality and relevance as our solutions evolve

Solution & Implementation Management (Primary when RFP volume is lower)
  
  

* Act as Solution & Implementation Manager on assigned enterprise deals, owning scoping, design, delivery and client success
* Build and maintain deep product and customer knowledge through hands-on implementation work
* Apply standard PS methodologies and client experience standards
* Bring implementation insights back into RFP process and knowledge base, ensuring responses reflect what we can actually deliver

Who You Are
  
  

* 5-7 years in enterprise presales, solution architecture, or technical account management
* 3-4 years leading RFP/RFI strategy and operations; passionate about knowledge management and process automation
* Demonstrated experience redesigning significant operational processes and driving organization-wide adoption
* Track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise implementations
* Ability to think systemically about workflows, automation, and tradeoffs (where automation adds value vs. where human judgment is required)
* Strong cross-functional influence skills to drive alignment with Sales, Product, Ops, Compliance
* High fluency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.); demonstrated experience using or building AI agents for workflow automation
* High standards for quality and accuracy; ownership mindset; bias toward action
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to learn new technical domains quickly
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

What We Value
  
  
A builder's mindset. You see a broken system and ask: 'How would I redesign this from scratch?'
  
  
Ownership and accountability. You own outcomes: when things go wrong, you diagnose and improve
  
  
Learning agility. You're comfortable with new domains and approaches; you adapt and grow
  
  
Customer empathy. You care about impact—for internal stakeholders and external clients
  
  
Humble collaboration. You elevate others, build trust, and lead through influence
  
  
Bias toward action. You move forward with incomplete information and iterate based on feedback
  
  
**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
  
  
*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*

* Apply established architecture, standards, methods, and governance to deliver reliable outcomes.
* Clarify requirements, dependencies, risks, feasibility, and implementation needs for the workstream.

* Resolve non-routine technical issues across APIs, integrations, data flows, configuration, performance, security, and deployment.

**Essential Skills**

  

* Typically, 5-8 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability in industrial technology implementation and technical project delivery.
* Hands-on capability in AVEVA solution configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, validation, and handover.
* Working knowledge of AVEVA products, customer domain workflows, industrial data, customer systems, APIs, cloud/edge, security, performance, and deployment constraints.
* Practical domain awareness of the customer’s operating model, workflows, KPIs, and value drivers, so the solution solves the right industrial problem.
* Ability to work within agreed architecture, standards, methodologies, governance, and engagement priorities.
* Sound judgment in resolving non-routine technical issues and escalating risks early.
* Clear customer-facing and cross-team communication skills.

***Technical Presales | Discovery | Solution Architecture | Deployment | Managed Services***

**Experience-**
5–10 years of relevant experience

**Function-**
AI & Data Practice

**Role type**

Customer-facing, hands-on individual contributor

**Location- Noida**

**Reporting to-**
VP-AI & Data Practice

**Role overview**

AppSquadz is looking for a hands-on AI Solutions Architect who can own the technical customer journey—from first discovery and solution shaping through architecture, proof of concept, production deployment and managed-services recommendations. The role combines consultative technical presales with practical engineering judgment and accountability for secure, scalable, commercially viable AI solutions. The architect will collaborate with sales, alliances, delivery and customer stakeholders while remaining actively involved in implementation and handover.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Technical presales and solution shaping:**
  Partner with AI Services Business Development Manager in customer meetings; qualify AI opportunities, explain solution options, run technical demonstrations and contribute to proposals, effort estimates, bills of materials, statements of work and technical responses to RFPs.
* **Discovery workshops and use-case assessment:**
  Plan and facilitate business/IT workshops; map workflows, data sources, stakeholders, pain points, security constraints and success metrics. Assess AI readiness, prioritize use cases by value, feasibility and risk, and document requirements, assumptions and dependencies.
* **Architecture and solution design:**
  Design end-to-end generative AI, agentic AI, ML and data-enabled architectures covering models, prompts, RAG, vector search, orchestration, APIs, integrations, identity, guardrails, observability and cloud infrastructure. Produce diagrams, design decisions, cost estimates and deployment patterns.
* **PoCs, deployment and productionization:**
  Build or guide working PoCs and pilots; establish acceptance criteria; support integration, CI/CD, evaluation, performance testing, security reviews and production rollout. Troubleshoot issues and support operational readiness, documentation and knowledge transfer.
* **Managed-services advisory:**
  Assess post-go-live support needs and recommend appropriate managed-services packages: monitoring, incident response, model/prompt evaluation, cost optimization, data and knowledge-base refresh, security controls, SLA/SLO reporting and continuous improvement. Define scope, responsibilities, service levels and handover needs with delivery teams.
* **Collaboration and governance:**
  Work across OEM partners, engineering and customer teams; apply responsible-AI, privacy, data residency, governance and compliance considerations. Communicate trade-offs clearly to both business executives and technical teams.

**Required experience and skills**

* **Experience:**
  5–10 years in solution architecture, cloud/data engineering, AI/ML engineering or technical consulting, including meaningful customer-facing presales and hands-on implementation experience.
* **AI engineering:**
  Practical experience delivering at least one production AI/GenAI solution; knowledge of LLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, agent workflows, evaluation, hallucination mitigation and prompt engineering.
* **Cloud and platforms:**
  Working experience with AWS and its AI/data services; familiarity with Amazon Bedrock and at least one major model ecosystem such as Anthropic Claude or OpenAI. Equivalent Azure/GCP experience is useful.
* **Engineering and integration:**
  Strong understanding of Python, REST APIs, application integration, databases, vector stores, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and production monitoring.
* **Security and economics:**
  Ability to design IAM, encryption, secrets management, network controls, data protection and human oversight; estimate infrastructure/model usage costs and explain architectural trade-offs.
* **Communication:**
  Confidence facilitating workshops, whiteboarding solutions, writing technical proposals and presenting recommendations to CIO/CTO stakeholders and engineering teams.

**Preferred qualifications**

* **Additional experience:**
  AWS Solutions Architect or relevant cloud/AI certification; experience with agent orchestration frameworks, MLOps/LLMOps, regulated-industry architectures, enterprise knowledge assistants, coding assistants or intelligent process automation.
* **Commercial acumen:**
  Experience translating technical solutions into delivery plans, effort estimates, recurring support offerings and measurable customer outcomes.

**Expected deliverables**

* **Discovery:**
  Workshop agenda, current-state assessment, prioritized use-case backlog and measurable success criteria.
* **Solution design:**
  Reference/target architecture, integration and security design, sizing, cost estimate, risks and implementation roadmap.
* **Execution:**
  PoC/demo, deployment plan, test and evaluation results, production handover documents.
* **Operations:**
  Managed-services recommendation, operating model, monitoring plan, SLA/SLO inputs and improvement backlog.

**How success will be measured**

* Quality and conversion of technically qualified opportunities and discovery workshops.
* Clarity, feasibility and accuracy of proposed architectures, effort estimates and solution costs.
* PoC-to-production progression, deployment quality and customer acceptance.
* Security, reliability, operational readiness and customer satisfaction after go-live.
* Practical managed-services attach opportunities and smooth transition to support teams.

**Candidate profile**

We value an architect who can engage a business leader in the morning, whiteboard an enterprise AI design with the technology team, and work with engineers to make the solution run reliably in production. This is not a presentation-only presales role or a purely back-end development role.

Please share your CV at puja.bisht@appsquadz.com

9495d403.title: Solution Architect - AWS Integration & API Gateway
9495d403.description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a Solution Architect to design and lead a central email gateway. It will sit between the client's commerce platform, its middleware (enterprise service bus) and a new email service provider, and will carry all business-critical transactional email, such as order, shipping, refund and account notifications. The gateway offers two integration models:
  
  

* a pass-through API for systems that are ready to use the new provider directly
* a backward-compatible API that mimics the legacy provider, so existing systems only need to change an endpoint

The Architect will own the AWS target architecture, the versioned API contracts, a configuration-driven mapping model, and the resilience design needed to make sure no email is lost or sent twice. The role leads a small cross-functional team on a short build window, drives technical decisions with the client's architects, and owns cutover readiness and early-life support.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Design**

* Own the AWS target architecture across edge, API Gateway, private networking, load-balancing and ECS Fargate integration, containerized compute, eventing, audit and data flows
* Define versioned OpenAPI contracts for the pass-through and backward-compatible APIs
* Design a configuration-driven mapping engine for campaign, field and error-code translation
* Design resilience patterns: timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breaker, idempotency and dead-letter queue (DLQ) handling
* Design the Security & Observability Framework

**Technical Leadership**

* Lead discovery and capture existing integration contracts from live traffic
* Set engineering standards and review all code, including AI-generated code
* Guide developers, DevOps and QA on design, testability and performance
* Establish AI-assisted application-building workflows using AI approved

**Stakeholder & Delivery**

* Present options and recommendations to the client's architecture and platform teams
* Coordinate the ecommerce, middleware and email provider teams through integration and SIT
* Own cutover planning, go/no-go criteria and early-life support

**Security & Compliance**

* Ensure OAuth2 machine-to-machine authentication, encryption, least-privilege IAM and PII masking
* Align audit retention and the data purge approach with GDPR/CCPA requirements

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong solution architecture experience on AWS: API Gateway, ECS/Fargate, SQS, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, IAM and KMS
* Configuration management using AppConfig or DynamoDB; observability with CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry/ADOT or X-Ray; CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code design.
* Proven design of API gateways or enterprise integration layers for high-volume transactional systems
* Hands-on with Node.js/TypeScript or Java/Spring Boot microservices
* Strong grasp of resilience patterns, idempotency and event-driven design
* OpenAPI-first design and contract testing practices
* Excellent stakeholder communication and technical leadership

**Good-to-Have**

* Exposure to email service provider platforms; retail transactional email, ESB/middleware platforms
* Fastify; Akamai WAF; Terraform or AWS CDK; OpenSearch/ELK-based operational search.
* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional certification

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of relevant software engineering experience with solution architecture and hands-on technical leadership.
* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent
* AWS architecture certification is desirable.

**About Us**
At Zensar, we’re
*“experience-led everything”*
. We are committed to conceptualizing, designing, engineering, marketing, and managing digital solutions and experiences for over 130 leading enterprises. We are a company driven by a bold purpose:
*Together, we shape experiences for better futures*
. Whether for our clients, our people, or the world around us, this belief powers everything we do. At the heart of our culture is
*ONE with Client*
- a set of four core values that reflect who we are and how we work:
*One Zensar, Nurturing, Empowering, and Client Focus*
.
  
  
Part of the $4.8 billion RPG Group, we’re a community of 10,000+ innovators across 30+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. Explore Life at Zensar and join us to Grow. Own. Achieve. Learn. to be the best version of yourself.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when individuality is celebrated, growth is encouraged, and well-being is prioritized. We are an equal employment opportunity (EEO) and affirmative action employer, committed to creating an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, marital status, family medical leave status, or protected veteran status.

**Job Title:** Forward Deployed Solution Engineer - Advanced Analytics

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:** Full time, regular, hybrid work arrangement

**The job**

The Forward Deployed Solution Engineer owns a defined technical workstream within an FDE engagement. Working within agreed architecture and standards, the role applies customer domain context to configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, validate, document, and hand over AVEVA solutions using real customer data, systems, and constraints. The role is accountable for quality, timelines, reusable technical outputs, and timely risk escalation.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own a defined FDE technical workstream from implementation through validation and handover.

* Clarify requirements, dependencies, risks, feasibility, and implementation needs for the workstream.
* Implement creative and out of the box solutioning strategies against identified product feature gaps
* Resolve non-routine technical issues across APIs, integrations, data flows, configuration, performance, security, and deployment.
* Support demonstrations, acceptance testing, performance checks, validation, and production-readiness activities.
* Create reusable configurations, connectors, templates, AI patterns, implementation notes, and troubleshooting guidance.
* Coordinate with peers and adjacent teams, guide less-experienced contributors where appropriate, and escalate material risks early.

* Ability to work within agreed architecture, standards, methodologies, governance, and engagement priorities.
* Sound judgment in resolving non-routine technical issues and escalating risks early.
* Clear customer-facing and cross-team communication skills.
* Developing AI Agents, Skills, Tools, Plugins etc. using any one of the agentic framework preferably MAF

* Accountability for quality, schedule, documentation, testing evidence, reusable outputs, and reliable handover.

* Defined FDE technical workstreams are delivered reliably, on time, and in line with agreed architecture, standards, and customer success criteria.
* AVEVA solutions are configured, integrated, tested, validated, documented, and handed over with clear evidence of quality and operational readiness.
* Non-routine technical issues are resolved using sound judgment, with material risks, dependencies, and trade-offs escalated early.
* Reusable configurations, templates, troubleshooting notes, implementation guidance, and AI or integration patterns improve delivery quality for future FDE engagements.
* Peers, Architects, Leads, and customer-facing stakeholders view the role as a dependable technical contributor who builds confidence through practical execution, clear communication, and reliable handover.

c65663f5.title: Director, Technical Consulting (Salesforce Data Cloud)
c65663f5.description:
**Description**
Salesforce Professional Services - Global Delivery Centre (GDC) focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and execution of change programs. We are the trusted delivery partner for Salesforce Professional Services that ensures end to end multi-cloud delivery capabilities across all Salesforce technologies and scales with agility for successful customer outcomes! We at GDC strive to foster growth & innovation and enable for Salesforce Professional Services with focus on performance, productivity & impact.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Salesforce is currently seeking a Director, Technical Consulting (in the Architects’ Practice) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. The Director, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in enabling, deploying, and building the careers of our technical architects team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You’ll be responsible for planning capacity, hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Architects, as well as guide them on their CTA journey and their upskilling path across modern AI platforms.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects’ consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology within the practice.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI environments, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Industries Clouds, ensuring teams leverage developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery and enforce platform security.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to establish evaluation frameworks that measure AI performance and business value.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders.
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with SFI and Salesforce.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 18+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Expertise in leading Salesforce Field Service or Salesforce Data Cloud implementations.
* Expertise in one or multiple domains of → Financial Services, Health & Life Sciences, Manufacturing and Automotive, Retail and Consumer Goods, etc.
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Platform Security (Must have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
* Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others).
* Proficiency in English.

**Preferred Requirements**

* CTA
* Salesforce Certifications (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, System and Application Architect).
* OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation frameworks, and outcomes.

fc337e96.title: Senior Cloud Engineer (E3)
fc337e96.description:
**About Caylent**
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.
  
  
Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.
  
  
We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!
  
  
**********About the Role**********
We are seeking a
**Senior Cloud Engineer (E3)**
to join our growing
**Managed Service Provider (MSP)**
team. This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who can design, build, and operate complex cloud solutions while mentoring engineers and partnering closely with CloudOps, DevOps, security teams, and clients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and implementation of advanced cloud-native solutions for client workloads
* Evaluate and select tools, libraries, and AWS services aligned to scalability, security, and cost efficiency
* Apply structured frameworks to assess problems, risks, and architectural trade-offs
* Build and enhance cloud-native architectures including serverless, IoT backends, and highly automated delivery pipelines
* Enforce engineering standards, SDLC best practices, and architectural consistency
* Move fluidly between high-level architectural thinking and hands-on implementation
* Partner with CloudOps to design support models, response procedures, and operational handoffs
* Participate in cross-functional delivery teams to ensure successful client outcomes
* Mentor engineers, define stories and task-level work, and provide technical guidance
* Design and implement highly reliable, secure, and cost-optimized AWS architectures
* Build and maintain observability platforms using AWS-native tools (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Config) and partner solutions (Datadog, Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry)
* Collaborate with 24x7 operations teams to define actionable metrics, logs, and alerts Establish runbooks and automation aligned to monitoring thresholds and incident response
* Drive root cause analysis, noise reduction, and long-term reliability improvements
* Partner with DevOps and security teams to embed resilience, security, and cost optimization into all solutions
* Coach, mentor, and share knowledge with engineers across experience levels
* Perform code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and pair program when needed
* Contribute to internal IP, tooling, and open-source initiatives
* Participate in Agile delivery models and execution planning
* Engage with clients through presentations, architectural discussions, and technical decision-making
* Build relationships with vendors and AWS partners
* Stay current with AWS best practices and emerging cloud technologies

**Requirements**
**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field with strong 4+ years of IT experience
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS)
* 2+ years of programming experience in Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Go, Java, or C#
* 2+ years of strong experience in Kubernetes or Continuous Integration and Deliver (CI/CD) experience.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern delivery practices
* Experience working within Agile or similar delivery methodologies
* Willingness to work in graveyard shift.
* AWS Associate or Professional certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, SysOps, Developer)
* Experience designing scalable, automated cloud infrastructure
* Strong experience with AWS Lambda and serverless architectures
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or MSP environments
* Experience in client-facing or consulting roles
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to varied audiences
* Effective time and self-management with the ability to prioritize, adapt, and meet deadlines
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to analyze issues and deliver practical solutions
* Collaborative team player who builds productive relationships with clients and stakeholders

Signs you may be a great fit
  
  

* Impact: Play a pivotal role in shaping a rapidly growing venture studio.
* Culture: Thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment that values creativity and ownership.
* Growth: Access professional development opportunities and mentorship.
* Benefits: Competitive salary, health/wellness packages, and flexible work options.

You will combine deep technical expertise with strong relationship-building skills to influence architectural decisions, shape partners' technical strategies, and drive broad adoption of AWS services. You will bring visible and measurable impact to partner growth ambitions, helping them dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep technical skill in enterprise architecture, software development, cloud, data and AI, along with demonstrated customer-facing skills at all levels of a partner organization. You will think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges, and act as an influencer whom partners and customers are eager to engage with.

* Own the technical relationship with strategic partners in India as their trusted advisor on cloud/AI adoption, architecture, and strategy.
* Lead solution design and technical strategy, creating scalable architectures and helping partners grow their AWS offerings to accelerate go-to-market.
* Design and deliver enablement at scale — workshops, reference architectures, and best-practice guides that uplift partner technical capability.
* Evangelize AWS technology through whitepapers, blogs, presentations, bootcamps, meetups, and conferences to drive partner and customer innovation.
* Capture and share best practices with the broader SA community, contributing to mechanisms that scale technical excellence across the organization.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Account SAs, Sales, TAMs, BD, and service teams to accelerate customer adoption of partner solutions.
* Act as technical liaison between partners and AWS product teams, channeling feedback to shape the roadmap while championing partner value propositions internally and externally.
* Grow the SA organization by hiring, coaching, and mentoring talent, raising the bar across the team.

As a Strategic Member Of The AWS India Partner Solutions Architects Team, You Will Act As a Trusted Advisor To Our Managed Systems Integrators. This Includes
  
  

* Provide the architectural guidance and recommendations necessary to promote successful partner engagements in India.
* Build Partner capacity and capability by defining technical strategies that will enable partners to build deep, differentiated expertise and well defined GTMs.

* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

* 8+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

40bacc24.title: Devops Architect
40bacc24.description:
**Job Summary**  

**Location:** Bangalore, KA, IN

**Company:** Alstom

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your DevOps and CI/CD expertise in a new cutting-edge field. Youll work alongside collaborative and innovative teammates.

Youll play a key role in designing and optimizing scalable DevOps architectures and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring seamless integration and delivery of software applications. Day-to-day, youll work closely with teams across the business (development, QA, operations), evaluate and recommend tools and technologies, and lead the implementation of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices, and much more.

Youll specifically take care of fostering a culture of collaboration and efficiency across teams, but also ensuring the scalability, reliability, and security of cloud-based infrastructures.

Well look to you for:

* Contribute to the elaboration of product/system specification architecture, in collaboration with cross-functional teams
* Define the software requirements specifications
  + Define the functional requirements, operational requirements, interfaces requirements and the requirements linked to performance, safety, cybersecurity, RAM constraints
  + Ensure that all the requirements can be verified (testability, )
  + Ensure the traceability of the software requirements through the development cycle
* Define the software architecture
  + Elaborate the functional and structural breakdown into software components
  + Allocate the requirements to the software components
  + Define the interfaces between the software components
  + Define the dynamical behavior of the software
  + Validate the feasibility of the solution: model simulation, mock-up
* Take main technical choices for software development
  + Select development tools, methodology (ex: UML, ), programming languages, coding strategy and coding rules, strictly following internal process/methods tools recommendations
  + Contribute to the selection of the execution environment (processor, operating system, middleware, basic software), together with the product architect, system engineering manager and hardware architect
* Designing and implementing DevOps strategies: This includes creating scalable frameworks (GitLab CI/CD components), integrating tools (compilation, SCA, SATS, etc) and processes, and aligning DevOps practices with business objectives.

* Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines: Automating the build with powershell, python; automatic deployment processes to enable rapid and reliable software releases.   
     
  Managing cloud-based infrastructure: Overseeing the deployment and management of cloud infrastructure using tools like Terraform and Kubernetes.

* Collaborating with other teams: Working with development, operations, and security teams to ensure smooth and secure software delivery.   
     
  Monitoring and optimizing system performance: Ensuring the system is running efficiently, is scalable, and is secure.

* Guiding and mentoring junior engineers: Helping to foster a culture of continuous improvement.   
  Implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Defining and managing infrastructure using code to bring agility and consistency.

* Ensuring security: Implementing security measures, identity management, and compliance controls.

* Arbitrate and validate major software design choices
* Mentor developers and provide technical leadership within the team
* Perform software/software integration, together with the software designers
* Perform hardware/software integration, together with the hardware architect
* Specify, design, prepare and perform tests and verifications of his/her deliverables
* Sustain the software
* Keep informed of the evolution of technologies through techno watch
* Contribute to standardization by reusing existing solutions or by defining reusable solutions, including COTS\*
* Apply and ensure application of processes and standards
* Contribute to continuous improvement (RoE: Return of Experience, process)

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement **CI/CD pipelines** using **GitLab** for automated build, test, and deployment.
* Architect and manage **containerized environments** using **Docker** and **Kubernetes**.
* Implement **GitOps workflows** using **ArgoCD** for continuous delivery.
* Develop and maintain **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** using **Terraform** and **Ansible**.
* Set up **monitoring and observability** solutions using **Prometheus** and **Grafana**.
* Ensure high availability, scalability, and security of cloud-native applications.
* Collaborate with development, QA, and operations teams to streamline delivery processes.
* Drive best practices for DevOps, automation, and cloud infrastructure.

  
  
**All about you**  

We value passion and attitude over experience. Thats why we dont expect you to have every single skill. Instead, weve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Bachelor's or Masters degree in Engineering or computer Science, Software Engineering, ( Engineering Dgree)
* 10+ years of experience in software development and architecture, with a strong focus on DevOps and CI/CD practices

5b2acb4f.title: Client Architect Systems Integration Sr. Specialist Advisor
5b2acb4f.description:
**Req ID:**
392818
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Client Architect Systems Integration Sr. Specialist Advisor to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**Client Architect – Managed Services**
Senior client-facing architecture role | Global managed services environment
  
  
Role type: Full-time | Client engagement: Multi-year managed services | Reporting: Client CTO / account technology leadership
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
NTT DATA is a global technology services organisation delivering complex managed services for major enterprises. We are strengthening the architecture capability supporting a multi-hundred-million-euro global managed services agreement, with the role connected into our wider global architecture, engineering, operations and technology communities.
  
  
You will act as a senior technical advisor and Technical Design Authority for an assigned area, translating business requirements, commercial goals and cost-saving initiatives into practical technology solutions. The role combines technology roadmap ownership, architecture governance, design assurance and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on solutions that work sustainably in steady-state ("Day 2") operations.
  
  
This is a technical leadership role within a long-term client partnership. You will lead through influence, shape decisions in joint architecture forums and bring together the right specialists across the organisation. Business as Usual (BAU) support, implementation and project management remain with the appropriate delivery teams.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Act as the ongoing Technical Design Authority for your assigned area, maintaining architectural integrity as the managed environment evolves.
* Build trusted relationships with client technology and business stakeholders, understanding business requirements, commercial objectives and cost-saving priorities and translating them into viable technology solutions.
* Maintain current-state and target-state architecture, technology roadmaps, lifecycle plans and visibility of technical debt, dependencies and obsolescence risk.
* Review and assure High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and material changes for security, resilience, scalability, performance, operability, lifecycle and alignment with agreed standards.
* Drive simplification and standardisation through reusable patterns, reference architectures, approved technology choices and the reduction of variants and exceptions that increase support complexity and managed service cost.
* Use service data, monitoring, capacity, performance and incident trends to identify architecture-led improvements that increase resilience, improve service quality and reduce recurring operational workload.
* Set an ambitious automation agenda with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), engineering and operations teams, using Artificial Intelligence for IT Operations (AIOps) and advanced automation to dramatically reduce manual effort and remove avoidable manual triage, troubleshooting, event correlation and repeatable incident resolution.
* Shape new projects, demands and transformation initiatives with the client through architecture forums, ensuring dependencies, ownership, architectural decisions, supportability and the transition into Day 2 operations are designed from the outset.
* Consider the long-term economics of architecture decisions, including infrastructure rightsizing, licence utilisation, platform rationalisation, support complexity, automation potential and cost-to-serve.
* Represent your area in architecture and governance forums, document significant decisions and ensure cross-domain risks and dependencies are surfaced early and resolved through the appropriate technical leadership.
* Coach and guide technical teams while remaining distinct from routine third- and fourth-line operational support and hands-on implementation.

**What We're Looking For**

* Significant experience in enterprise architecture, infrastructure, cloud, network, platform or application operations within complex managed services, outsourcing or large enterprise environments.
* Proven experience as a Client Architect, Technical Design Authority, Enterprise Architect, Solution Architect or equivalent senior technical authority for a substantial service estate.
* Deep expertise in at least one relevant technology or service area, combined with sufficient breadth to understand dependencies across infrastructure, networks, security, applications, platforms and operations.
* Strong experience creating and assuring architecture documentation, roadmaps, HLDs, LLDs, standards, reference patterns and technical decision records.
* Strong understanding of Day 2 service concerns including monitoring and observability, capacity, availability, performance, resilience, disaster recovery, patching and lifecycle management.
* Demonstrable experience using automation, observability and AIOps to improve operational outcomes, reduce manual intervention and improve the speed and quality of detection, diagnosis and resolution.
* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how architecture decisions influence operational effort, licensing, technical debt, transformation priorities and long-term service cost.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to connect business objectives and commercial priorities with technical choices and explain trade-offs clearly to senior client leaders and technical teams.
* Relevant professional-level architecture and technology certifications aligned to your area of expertise are expected, but practical experience, sound judgement and the ability to build trust are more important than certification alone.

**Where you could fit**
We are recruiting several senior Client Architects across major technology domains, including infrastructure and cloud platforms, networks and connectivity, data platforms and middleware, enterprise applications and application platforms, SAP, resilience and data protection, and observability, automation and AIOps. Each role combines deep expertise in a primary domain with enough breadth to understand dependencies across the end-to-end managed service and collaborate effectively with specialists in other towers.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Build trusted relationships with client technology and business leaders, understand their business requirements, commercial goals and cost-saving priorities, and translate them into credible technology solutions and roadmaps.
* Drive technology refresh and transformation by maintaining clear roadmaps, identifying lifecycle risks and technical debt early, and proposing practical plans to address them.
* Lead simplification and standardisation across the technology estate, reducing unnecessary variants, exceptions, support complexity and the operational cost of the managed service.
* Improve service stability and operational performance through architecture-led change, with measurable reductions in recurring incidents and tickets, less manual intervention and faster diagnosis and resolution.
* Shape new projects and demands jointly with the client through architecture forums, ensuring architectural decisions, dependencies, ownership, supportability and transition into Business as Usual (BAU) service are designed in from the outset.

**Why this role**
You will combine the depth of a major client environment with the reach of a large global technology organisation. The role gives you space to build trusted relationships over time, shape significant technology decisions and connect across NTT DATA architecture, engineering, operations and partner communities. You will help make large managed services agreements work globally while building a network and experience that extends well beyond a single account.
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.
  
  
***NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.***
***This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. For our EEO Policy Statement, please click here. If you'd like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here. For Pay Transparency information, please click here.***

19db19be.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Be an integral part of an agile team that's constantly pushing the envelope to enhance, build, and deliver top-notch technology products.
  
  
As a Senior Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Asset and Wealth Management, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. Drive significant business impact through your capabilities and contributions, and apply deep technical expertise and problem-solving methodologies to tackle a diverse array of challenges that span multiple technologies and applications.
  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Works closely with software engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to define requirements and deliver robust solutions.
* Designs and Implement LLM-driven agent services for design, code generation, documentation, test creation and observability on AWS
* Develops orchestration and communication layers between agents using frameworks like A2A SDK, LangGraph, or Auto Gen
* Integrates AI agents with toolchains such as Jira, Bitbucket, Github, Terraform and monitoring platforms
* Collaborates on system design, SDK development and data pipelines supporting agent intelligence
* Provides technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers and team members.
* Drives adoption and governance of approved AI-assisted engineering practices across teams to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test acceleration, release readiness, incident/root-cause analysis), while establishing measurable validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of proven patterns and automation within the SDLC/TLM toolchain.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including approved AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation at scale.
* Drives decisions that influence the product design, application functionality, and technical operations and processes

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
* Experience in Software engineering using AI Technologies
* Strong hands-on skills in Python, Pydantic, FastAPI, LangGraph, and Vector Databases for building RAG based AI agent solutions integrating with multi-agent orchestration frameworks and deploying end-to-end pipelines on AWS (EKS, Lambda, S3, Terraform)
* Experience with LLMs integration, prompt/context engineering, AI Agent frameworks like Langchain/LangGraph, Autogen, MCPs, A2A.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker and APIs
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
* Demonstrated experience leading effective use of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching senior engineers/leads on compliant usage patterns and controls.
* Ability to tackle design and functionality problems independently with little to no oversight
* Practical cloud native experience

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Experience with Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Familiarity with MLOps practices, including CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, automated deployment, and ML pipelines.

**ABOUT US**

3740f1d9.description:
**About The Opportunity**

* It is an ERP-led business transformation and implementation organization, helping clients move from fragmented processes to integrated, standardized operations. With deep domain expertise across Manufacturing, Retail, Distribution, and Service industries, they integrate and automate business processes on global ERP, CRM, and HR platforms, and have built proprietary solutions to close process gaps.
* The Program Manager will lead large-scale enterprise transformation programs for clients across multinational companies, large Indian corporates, and fast-growing family-owned mid-sized businesses (₹200–800 crore range), with a strong focus on Compliance and Corporate Governance.

Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* Drive Executive Conversations: Lead, influence, and drive strategic conversations with C-suite executives, business heads, and partners to secure buy-in and align expectations.
* Lead Enterprise Transformations: Direct complex implementations across Software/ERP platforms (Microsoft, SAP), including surround technologies and other custom solutions.
* Facilitate Governance & Alignment: Own the project schedule, scope, and governance framework — chairing steering committee meetings and cross-functional workshops.
* Manage RAID & Risks: Proactively identify, articulate, and mitigate program risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies (RAID) during stakeholder reviews.
* Onshore Leadership: Operate effectively in an onsite/onshore model (80% presence), driving daily face-to-face collaboration with client teams.

**Skills & Qualifications**

1cb84409.title: Program Manager
1cb84409.description:
WHO WE ARE

We are an ERP-led business transformation and implementation organization focused on helping clients

move from fragmented processes and systems to integrated, standardized and best-practice-driven

operations.

Our approach to ERP implementation rests on two key tracks:

1. Industry Best Practices & ERP Transformation

We evaluate a client's existing processes against relevant industry and functional best practices and

enable these through leading ERP platforms such as SAP and Microsoft Dynamics. The objective is not

simply to implement software, but to establish standardized processes, controls and operating models

that reflect proven industry practice.

2. Sustained Organizational Change

ERP implementation also requires sustained organizational transformation and change management.

We work with clients to embed new processes, behaviours and practices into the day-to-day habits of

their workforce - ensuring the solution delivers lasting business value rather than becoming only a

technology deployment.

OUR CLIENT SEGMENT

The role will support clients across three broad segments:

▪ Multinational companies operating in India and other regions.

▪ Large Indian corporates with complex and diverse finance operations.

Page 2 of 2

▪ Fast-growing, family-owned and professionally managed mid-sized businesses, generally in the

₹200–800 crore range.

OUR FOCUS AREAS

We maintain a strong focus on Compliance and Corporate Governance, supported by a Centre of

Excellence comprising experienced functional and domain professionals.

Our clients typically come from non-ERP or fragmented-system environments, where business

processes are managed through standalone applications or disconnected modular systems across

departments. This calls for an articulate leader who can effectively drive high-level conversations across

diverse steering committees and technical groups — managing governance, schedule and scope with an

80% onsite/onshore presence.

ROLE, SCOPE & RESPONSIBILITIES

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Program Manager with 10+ years of experience to lead large-scale

enterprise transformation programs. The ideal candidate will bring a stable career history (a maximum

of 1–2 employers) and a proven track record of driving complex software, ERP and CRM

implementations.

As our projects and client relationships typically span 10–15 years, the most important hiring mandate is

stability: candidates should have at least 8–10 years of single, continuous tenure with a Top Tier

company.

▪ Drive Executive Conversations: Lead, influence and drive strategic conversations with C-suite

executives, business heads and partners to secure buy-in and align expectations.

▪ Lead Enterprise Transformations: Direct complex implementations across Software/ERP platforms

(Microsoft, SAP), including surround technologies and other custom solutions.

▪ Facilitate Governance & Alignment: Own the project schedule, scope and governance framework —

chairing steering committee meetings and cross-functional workshops.

▪ Manage RAID & Risks: Proactively identify, articulate and mitigate program risks, assumptions,

issues and dependencies (RAID) during stakeholder reviews.

▪ Onshore Leadership: Operate effectively in an onsite/onshore model (80% presence), driving daily

face-to-face collaboration with client teams.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

▪ Experience: 10+ years of core project and program management experience.

▪ Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills, with the ability to drive complex

conversations between business users and technical teams.

▪ Professional Stability: A stable, progressive career track record — preferably 1–3 organisations, with

at least 80% of total tenure spent at a single organisation.

▪ Target Background: Proven delivery experience within tier-1 tech integrators and consulting firms,

such as IBM, Wipro, TCS, CTS, Infosys, HCL, Capgemini, Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY, etc.

Page 3 of 2

▪ Methodologies: Expert knowledge of program governance, budgeting and structured deployment

frameworks.

OUT OF SCOPE — WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

Candidates whose primary experience lies in the following areas will not be considered:

▪ Service delivery management or support-operations projects.

▪ Ticket management, SLA tracking, or ITSM frameworks.

▪ Pure resourcing / team management.

▪ Core infrastructure, networking, or technical migration projects (DWH / Cloud / Infra).

▪ Candidates not comfortable with the travel required for client engagements.

Pay: ₹2,500,000.00 - ₹3,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

c001c8f4.title: Senior Technical Account Manager
c001c8f4.description:
**Job Summary**

As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a trusted customer advocate and technical advisor. You will understand customer business requirements, translate them into integrated technology and process solutions, and guide customers through cloud adoption and transformation.

You will provide leadership across the solution lifecycle, coordinate cross-functional teams, and help customers deploy and optimize Oracle Cloud workloads. This role combines technical depth, customer relationship management, and program delivery expertise to drive successful customer outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to understand business goals, technical requirements, challenges, and desired outcomes, then translate them into practical solution designs.
* Conduct fit-gap assessments and develop roadmaps for transitioning, implementing, and optimizing customer solutions.
* Define and align the functional and technical vision for program solutions with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Lead end-to-end delivery across requirements intake, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and go-live activities.
* Guide deployment of customer workloads to Oracle Cloud, support cloud-adoption models, and recommend actions to overcome delivery blockers.
* Align customer solutions with Oracle product roadmaps, release cycles, business enhancements, and production break-fix requirements.
* Collaborate with portfolio management and cross-functional teams, including business analysts, integration specialists, quality assurance, development, support, services, and third-party partners.
* Communicate technical concepts, solution options, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support strategic planning, program direction, customer satisfaction, and successful delivery of IT solutions within agreed timelines and budgets.

  

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Mandatory**

* 8 years of experience in a customer-facing, consultative, or technology-related role; or an equivalent combination of education and experience:
  + Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field plus 4 years of relevant experience.
  + Master’s degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field plus 2 years of relevant experience.
  + Doctorate in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field.
* 5–15 years of IT industry experience, including at least 3 years of demonstrated OCI experience.
* Strong understanding of Oracle products, including Fusion applications, OCI, and on-premises offerings.
* Ability to translate business requirements into system, application, process, and solution designs.
* Experience leading business analysis, business-process design, and software development lifecycle activities.
* Demonstrated ability to assess technology assumptions, identify systems, subsystems, and interfaces, and evaluate solution alternatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to consider broader cross-module impacts.
* Proven customer service and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to build effective working relationships across business and IT teams in a collaborative, remote environment.
* Ability to travel to customer locations and internal sessions up to 25%.

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Relevant cloud certifications.
* One full cloud implementation lifecycle.
* Experience with IT service management.
* Experience with account management.
* Experience working with operating budgets or project financials.
* Familiarity with the CSS service portfolio across cloud and on-premises services.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have experience working directly with customers to understand their business needs and translate them into technology solutions?
* Have I supported or led cloud adoption, implementation, or migration activities involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure?
* Can I guide stakeholders through requirements, design, build, testing, deployment, and go-live activities?
* Am I comfortable collaborating with technical and non-technical teams to resolve blockers and keep a program on track?
* Can I clearly explain technical options, risks, and recommendations to customer stakeholders at different levels?

Sam’s Club eCommerce is a team of engineers passionate about taking care of our members and associates. Belonging

74344879.title: Sr Tech Infra Program Manager, DCPD
74344879.description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
  
  
Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ? Have you managed complex infrastructure projects ?
  
  
If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Hyderabad, Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.
  
  
You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering managing a team with strong urge to learn will be essential.
  
  
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Senior Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in Hyderabad, Telangana India. The Sr TIPM manages delivery of ~5 projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity. The Sr TIPM is able to guide and develop partner teams to accomplish the regions goal.
  
  
The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
  
  
A successful TPM Manager must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* 4+ years of project management experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management
* Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds
* Knowledge of mission critical systems (data centers, hospitals, power plants, military facilities, etc.)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. **Job Description**

**Position: Pre-Sales Executive**

**Function: Sales**

**Company: Bambrew Plant Fiber Technology Private Limited**

**Location: Bengaluru/Delhi / Pune/ Mumbai**

**Experience Required: 0–5 Years**

**About the Company**

Bambrew Plant Fiber Technology Private Limited is a sustainable packaging and material innovation company focused on developing plant-based, eco-friendly alternatives to conventional plastic packaging.

We are building solutions that combine material science, technology, and sustainability to create packaging that is functional, scalable, and better for the environment. Our solutions cater to diverse industries and applications, helping businesses transition towards more sustainable packaging.

At Bambrew, we foster an entrepreneurial, collaborative, and ownership-driven culture. We encourage people to take initiative, learn continuously, solve real-world problems, and work closely with teams across the organisation. As we grow, we are looking for individuals who are curious, proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Pre-Sales Executive to support our Sales team in managing customer requirements, preparing proposals, coordinating product demonstrations, and ensuring a smooth transition from initial customer interaction to business closure.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication and coordination skills, an understanding of B2B sales processes, and the ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into appropriate product or solution recommendations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand customer requirements and work closely with the Sales team to identify suitable Bambrew products and solutions.
* Support the Sales team in preparing presentations, quotations, proposals, product information, and other sales collateral.
* Coordinate with internal teams such as Product, R&D, Operations, Quality, and Sales to address customer requirements.

* Respond to customer queries and coordinate internally to provide accurate and timely information.
* Support the Sales team in preparing technical and commercial responses to customer requirements.
* Track customer requirements, samples, trials, quotations, and follow-ups throughout the sales cycle.

* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, requirements, proposals, and opportunities.
* Support preparation of RFP/RFQ responses, presentations, technical documentation, and product comparisons.
* Work with Sales to identify customer pain points and recommend suitable sustainable packaging solutions.
* Follow up on open customer requirements and ensure timely closure of action items.
* Support the Sales team in converting qualified opportunities into business.
* Gather customer feedback and share relevant insights with Product, R&D, and Operations teams.
* Stay updated on Bambrew's product portfolio, industry developments, customer needs, and sustainable packaging trends.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 0–3 years of experience in Pre-Sales, Sales Support, Business Development, Customer Success, or a related role.
* B2B experience preferred.
* Experience in packaging, manufacturing, sustainability, FMCG, materials, or related industries will be an advantage.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good presentation and customer-facing skills.
* Ability to understand technical/product information and communicate it in a simple and effective manner.
* Strong coordination and follow-up skills.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple customer requirements simultaneously.

* Customer-focused and solution-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving startup environment.

**Key Competencies**

**Customer Understanding | Pre-Sales Support | Product Knowledge | Presentation Skills | Proposal & Documentation | Cross-functional Coordination | Communication | Follow-up & Execution | Problem Solving | Customer Orientation**
