At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Title: Senior Manager – Solution Architecture**

**Summary:**

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – Solution Architecture to lead the design and governance of end-to-end enterprise solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.

This role combines solution strategy, architecture leadership, and people management, translating complex business requirements into secure, scalable, and cost-effective solutions. The ideal candidate will connect business processes, applications, data, integration, and cloud technologies to enable transformation across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.

You will own solution architecture quality across engagements, lead a team of architects, and partner with enterprise architecture, product, engineering, security, and business leaders to guide solutions from discovery through implementation and business value realization.

  

**Responsibilities:**

**Solution Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture across complex transformation initiatives, aligning business capabilities, functional requirements, and technology choices with enterprise strategy.
* Lead discovery and architecture workshops to define solution scope, assess current-state landscapes, and develop target-state designs and phased transition roadmaps.
* Define architecture across application, data, integration, infrastructure, and security domains, with clear component responsibilities, interfaces, deployment models, and dependencies.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy options, cloud services, enterprise products, and emerging technologies through structured trade-off analysis and targeted proofs of concept.
* Establish reference architectures, design patterns, architecture decision records, and review standards; ensure alignment with enterprise principles and govern justified exceptions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve cross-domain design challenges, balancing business fit, scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, and total cost of ownership.

  

**Architecture Governance & Delivery Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across concurrent engagements, maintaining traceability from requirements to design decisions, implementation, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to translate designs into actionable work, validate feasibility, and manage technical dependencies, design changes, and architecture risks.
* Define measurable non-functional requirements for availability, performance, scalability, recovery, and supportability; guide validation through testing and operational readiness reviews.
* Develop migration and modernization approaches, including data migration, coexistence, cutover, and rollback; align sequencing, estimates, and cost assumptions with delivery teams.
* Embed security, privacy, data governance, and applicable compliance requirements in solution designs, working with control owners to assess risks and close design gaps.

  

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale a solution architecture team, coordinating application, data, integration, cloud, and security specialists across engagements.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance architecture practice focused on sound judgment, collaboration, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own hiring, resource allocation, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with business demand and technology priorities.
* Mentor architects and technical leads on design quality, business understanding, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen communities of practice and peer reviews.

  

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with business leaders, finance transformation stakeholders, product owners, and clients to clarify needs and translate them into feasible solution options.
* Present solution alternatives, investment needs, trade-offs, and risks to decision-makers; secure alignment on scope, target architecture, and expected business outcomes.
* Lead architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations, including solution narratives, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and implementation approaches.
* Communicate architecture decisions, delivery implications, technical risks, and business value clearly to executive and technical audiences.

**Reusable Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable solution blueprints, accelerators, and integration patterns that improve consistency, reduce delivery effort, and support repeatable client outcomes.
* Assess opportunities to simplify application portfolios and modernize legacy solutions, balancing reuse and standardization with business-specific requirements.
* Evaluate analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions through business cases and proofs of value, addressing data readiness, security, responsible use, and operational feasibility.

  

**Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, enterprise integration, or data platforms, including ownership of complex enterprise solution designs.
* 5+ years of architecture or engineering people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or technical leads across multiple programs or engagements.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including hybrid integration, deployment models, resilience, and cost considerations.
* Strong expertise in application architecture, APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, enterprise integration patterns, and the trade-offs between distributed and simpler architectures.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, including transactional systems, data warehouses or lakehouses, data pipelines, master data, and analytics integration.
* Experience producing architecture models, interface specifications, decision records, and non-functional requirements; familiarity with frameworks or methods such as TOGAF, C4, or ArchiMate.
* Expertise in secure solution design, identity and access management, data protection, and enterprise governance, with working knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and operational support.

**Architecture & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to guide enterprise solutions from discovery and option assessment through design governance, implementation oversight, and transition to operations.
* Experience leading architecture reviews, proofs of concept, vendor evaluations, and risk assessments while managing cross-team dependencies and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong skills in technical estimation, total cost of ownership analysis, modernization planning, and evaluating performance, resilience, and scalability trade-offs.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise business processes and data models; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) is preferred.
* Experience in finance transformation, ERP integration, analytics platforms, or data-led enterprise transformation is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong people leadership, practice development, and coaching skills, with the ability to lead architects and influence multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and client-facing solution presentations.
* Ability to balance strategic architecture with pragmatic delivery, challenge assumptions constructively, and make clear decisions under ambiguity.
* High ownership mindset focused on solution quality, implementation feasibility, sustainable technology choices, and measurable business outcomes.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The opportunity**

We are looking for a skilled Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer with deep expertise in the Azure cloud platform and experience applying AI to CloudOps. This role is responsible for end-to-end infrastructure and deployment automation, CI/CD engineering, reliability, and incident resolution, while using generative AI and AIOps capabilities to improve observability, triage, root cause analysis, runbook automation, and operational efficiency. The role will lead escalations, design secure and governed AI-enabled operations solutions, and collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, security, data, and AI teams to deliver highly available services.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* **Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)**
* + Design, deploy, and manage scalable AKS clusters for mission‑critical workloads.
  + Implement secure cluster networking, workload identities, and governance policies.
  + Optimize AKS performance, reliability, and cost as part of the platform architecture.
  + Integrate AKS with CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and monitoring solutions.
* **ARM Templates & Bicep**
* + Develop reusable ARM/Bicep infrastructure‑as‑code templates for automated deployments.
  + Standardize resource deployments through parameterized and modular Bicep templates.
  + Migrate legacy ARM templates to Bicep for improved maintainability.
  + Ensure consistency, compliance, and repeatability across environments using IaC best practices.
* **Azure DevOps**
* + Architect and implement end‑to‑end CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure.
  + Lead DevOps automation initiatives across build, release, testing, and deployment workflows.
  + Implement secure DevOps practices, including secrets management and pipeline governance.
  + Manage Azure Repos, Boards, Pipelines, Artifacts, and environment configurations.
* **Landing Zone Architecture**
* + Design and implement Azure Landing Zones aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).
  + Define foundational architecture for identity, networking, governance, policies, and management groups.
  + Build scalable enterprise-ready landing zones for multi‑subscription and multi‑environment setups.
  + Implement guardrails such as Azure Policies, RBAC structures, and blueprint‑style templates.
* **Terraform & Terraform Cloud**
* + Develop and manage Terraform modules for consistent provisioning across environments.
  + Implement Terraform Cloud/Enterprise for remote state management and secure pipelines.
  + Automate Azure infrastructure deployments using version-controlled IaC.
  + Enforce policies, workspaces, and governance using Terraform Cloud capabilities.
* **AI-enabled CloudOps & Agentic Automation**
* + Design and implement AI-assisted operational workflows for alert enrichment, incident triage, event correlation, root cause analysis, knowledge retrieval, and runbook execution.
  + Build and operate secure cloud operations agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Foundry Agent Service, Azure AI Search, and orchestration frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework or Semantic Kernel.
  + Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions grounded in approved runbooks, knowledge articles, telemetry, and configuration data; apply vector, hybrid, and semantic search patterns.
  + Integrate agents securely with operational tools and APIs using function calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP), with approval gates for production actions.
  + Engineer production controls for identity, private networking, secrets, prompt-injection defence, data protection, content safety, auditability, evaluation, and responsible AI.
  + Monitor AI services and agents for availability, latency, quality, token usage, model drift, cost, and operational risk using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, and enterprise observability platforms.
* **Documentation & Best Practices**
* + Create detailed architectural documents, design specs, deployment guides, and runbooks.
  + Maintain IaC repositories with clear documentation, versioning, and conventions.
  + Conduct knowledge transfer sessions, workshops, and technical enablement for teams.
  + Provide guidance on DevOps, cloud governance, scalability, cost optimization, and security best practices.

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines,
* Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform; good understanding of ARM Templates/ Biceps.
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash and Python.
* Deep understanding of Azure services(VMs, Blob Storage, AKS, AAD).
* Container orchestration and management using Kubernetes, Helm, and Docker.
* Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible.
* Strong understanding of cloud security best practices, IAM policies, and compliance standards.
* Experience with ITSM tools like ServiceNow for incident and change management.
* Practical understanding of generative AI, large language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, vector search, RAG, agentic workflows, tool/function calling, and MCP in an enterprise operations context.
* Hands-on Python experience for API integration, telemetry processing, automation, evaluation, and AI-enabled operational tooling.
* Ability to design human-in-the-loop automation with least-privilege access, measurable quality thresholds, rollback controls, audit trails, and safe failure handling for production environments.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 5 - 8 years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure operations, and automation.
* Hands-on expertise in Building and deploying Azure cloud environments for high availability systems.
* Proficiency in Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD tooling, and automation scripting.
* Demonstrated experience delivering at least one AI-enabled CloudOps, DevOps, SRE, observability, service-management, or knowledge-assistant use case from design through production support.
* Experience in a 24x7 rotational support model.
* Relevant certifications in Azure (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, DevOps Engineer Expert).

  

**Technologies and Tools**

**Must have**

* Cloud Platforms: Azure
* CI/CD & Deployment: Azure DevOps Pipelines
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
* Containerization: Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, Helm
* Logging & Monitoring: Azure Monitor
* Configuration & Automation: Ansible, Bash
* AI-enabled CloudOps: Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Foundry Agent Service, Azure AI Search, vector databases, RAG, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and responsible AI controls
* Programming & Integration: Python, REST APIs, JSON, SDK-based integrations, managed identities, and secure secrets handling
* AI Observability & AIOps: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, OpenTelemetry, anomaly detection, event correlation, and AI-assisted incident response
* Incident & ITSM: ServiceNow or equivalent
* Certification: Azure relevant certifications

  

**Good to have**

* Cloud Infrastructure: CloudFormation, ARM Templates
* CI/CD & Deployment: GitHub Actions,
* Security: IAM Policies, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Security Hub
* Networking: VPC, Subnets, Load Balancers, Security Groups (AWS/Azure)
* Scripting: Python/Bash
* Observability: OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk
* Agent Frameworks & Standards: Microsoft Agent Framework or Semantic Kernel, Model Context Protocol (MCP), multi-agent orchestration, and agent evaluation
* AI Operations Ecosystem: GitHub Copilot, ServiceNow AI capabilities, Datadog AI features, Splunk AI capabilities, or equivalent enterprise AIOps tooling

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

**How to Apply:** If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

The engineer will leverage AI/ML and AIOps capabilities to predict and prevent incidents, accelerate diagnostics, automate operational processes, and reduce response times while collaborating with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to deliver highly available services.

* Develop systems that learn from historical incidents, continuously improving diagnostic accuracy and accelerate incident response time

* Proactively trigger incident management when early signals indicate potential disruption
* Review and act on maintenance notifications, service advisories, and platform updates to mitigate operational risks.
* Maintain a centralized incident response playbook, ensuring steps, processes, and escalation paths are clearly documented.

* Proficiency in reading and interpreting logs to generate operational intelligence and accelerate incident resolution.
* Experience with observability, SRE principles, and automation to reduce manual effort and improve system reliability.
* Sound knowledge of AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, and IAM.
* Experience with REST APIs, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems
* Strong tooling and automation skills using Python, Java, Selenium etc.
* Prior experience in incident management and stakeholder communication.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively across teams

ec436352.title: Tech Principal, AI Solutions
ec436352.description:
**Tech Principal, AI Solutions**

  

Location: Hybrid | Type: Full-time

  

**About Newpage Solutions**

Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organizations, including pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data- driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.

From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified for three consecutive years, hold a top Glassdoor rating, and were named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview.

We foster creativity, continuous learning, and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in peoples lives.

  

**Your Mission**

We are hiring a Tech Principal to work directly with our VP of Technology and the AI Center of Excellence. This is the role that shapes what we build, sets the bar for how we build it, and makes sure every AI engagement we take on lands well. The role carries three mandates. First, solution shaping: when a client brings a problem, an opportunity, or a half-formed requirement, you turn it into a crisp problem statement,

a "what we heard" narrative, a solution architecture, a working prototype, and a user journey, and you present it back and shape the engagement plan. Second, engineering excellence: you work with capability leads to define and raise the AI-native standard across fullstack development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data

engineering. Third, delivery governance: you steer, review, and unblock every AI application and platform project we run so teams ship high-quality software predictably. You treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built: not a tool to be cautious of, not something you are "exploring," but the medium you work in. You live at the current edge

of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.

  

**What Youll Do**

**Shape Solutions in Discovery**

* Sit with client business, product, and clinical leaders when a problem or opportunity is still forming, and reframe it into a concrete, scoped problem statement in the room.
* Build the "what we understood" narrative that plays the clients problem back to them sharper than they framed it, and earns the right to propose the solution.
* Design the solution end-to-end: target architecture, user flows and journeys, data and integration boundaries, and the riskiest assumptions to validate first.
* Architect cloud-native, enterprise-grade solutions against explicit targets for performance, accuracy, latency, cost, security, and reliability, with infrastructure chosen for fit, not preference.
* Communicate architecture visually: layered architecture diagrams, sequence and data-flow diagrams, and user journeys that client executives and engineers can both read.
* Build working prototypes in days, not weeks, and demo them live without a slide deck.
* Shape the engagement plan with delivery leadership: team shape, phasing,milestones, and the commercial narrative that supports it.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques before they get baked into proposals or platform decisions.

**Set the Engineering Standards**

* Work with capability leads to define, document, and continuously raise AI-native standards across fullstack application development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering.
* Codify how we build: reference architectures, Claude Code skills and sub-agents, templates, eval harnesses, and structured AI-assisted development workflows that every pod can adopt.
* Author ADRs, standards documents, and scope memos that hold up under review, covering LLM abstractions, retrieval design, vendor selection, integration boundaries, and infrastructure paths.
* Run architecture and design reviews across engagements, and make sure decisions are consistent, deliberate, and written down.
* Mentor senior engineers and capability leads on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering practice, and grow the next set of solution shapers.

**Govern and Steer Delivery**

* Own technical governance across all AI application and platform projects: regular architecture and quality reviews, risk surfacing, and early intervention when a project drifts.
* Define the quality gates that matter, including evals, test coverage, security posture (RBAC, audit trails), reliability, observability, and cost, and hold teams to them without slowing them down.
* Engage client enterprise architecture and security review paths early when they apply, and move with them, not around them.
* Unblock teams directly: get into the codebase, pair on the hard problem, and make the call when a team is stuck between options.
* Keep delivery, client, and leadership views aligned on where each project genuinely stands.
* Feed lessons from delivery back into standards, so every project makes the next one better.

  

**What You Bring**

* 12+ years of engineering experience, with architecture-level ownership on multiple production systems and at least 3 years building LLM-powered and agentic applications end-to-end.
* A consulting or client-facing solutioning background: you have shaped
* engagements from ambiguous conversations, won technical confidence in the room, and carried trade-off discussions with business leadership without locking them in.
* Direct hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered products: RAG pipelines, prompt and context engineering, eval harnesses, and vendor-agnostic LLM abstractions.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models: you have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, Auto Gen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You have built Next.js applications, Fast API services, and similar.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and templates.
* Working fluency across the capabilities you will set standards for: QA and test automation, DevSecOps, and data engineering. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in each, but you must speak each language credibly and know what good looks like.
* Experience designing and deploying cloud-native architectures on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions. Cloudflare experience a plus.
* Experience governing or assuring delivery across multiple concurrent teams: technical oversight, quality gates, and steering without micromanaging.
* Strong written communication: you author ADRs, standards, scope memos, and decision documents that hold up under review.
* Storytelling craft: you turn discovery conversations into narratives that make clients see their own problem more clearly, and you present architectures and live demos to executive audiences with confidence.
* A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, reliability, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A founders mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.

  

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Prior Tech Principal, Principal Consultant, Solution Architect, or Field CTO experience at a consultancy.
* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI. LLMOps and observability experience (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix), and
* model serving where the problem calls for it (Bedrock, SageMaker, vLLM).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Experience with enterprise AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act readiness, internal AI policy and risk frameworks).
* Pharma, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Relevant cloud architecture certifications.

  

**What We Offer**

At Newpage, were building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters.

  

**We offer:**

* A people-first culture: supportive peers, open communication, and a strong sense of belonging.
* Smart, purposeful collaboration: work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges.
* Balance that lasts: we respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life.
* Room to grow: opportunities for learning, leadership, and career development, shaped around you.
* Meaningful rewards: competitive compensation that recognizes both contribution and potential.

  

**Ready to Apply?**

Lets build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to

ramadevi.bhumireddy@newpage.io with any questions.

35a51e28.title: Senior Program Manager, Seller Fees Science & Tech
35a51e28.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Fee Strategy Operations team is seeking an experienced, enthusiastic, and diligent Program Manager to drive cross-functional go-to-market (GTM) execution for fee and incentive launches across Amazon's worldwide marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution—partnering with Fee Strategy, Product, Operations, Legal, Seller Communications, and regional stakeholders to ensure seamless delivery of fee/incentive changes to Sellers globally. This role provides the unique opportunity of managing billion dollar incentive programs across stores and drive seller success.
  
  
Our environment is fast-paced and demands a self-starter who is detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable navigating ambiguity across multiple teams, partners, and levels of management. You will own end-to-end program delivery, understand business problems at a strategic level, and have the ability to prevent or mitigate the consequences of poor business decisions. As the program owner, you will look at the bigger business picture, drive outcomes by understanding relevant business requirements, and deliver results with minimal oversight.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Cross-Functional Partnership & Stakeholder Management  
  
Partner with worldwide cross-functional teams to align GTM strategy, timelines, and deliverables for fee and incentive launches and changes. Collaborate closely with Fee Strategy Product Managers to understand GTM requirements, translate them into actionable work-backwards plans, and drive execution of GTM activities across all fee/incentive types. Act as the primary liaison between Fee Strategy and WW partner teams—Country Fees POCs, GPO, Legal, Science, Seller Communications, Reporting, and Operations—to track, report, and monitor launch readiness, central content readiness, country teams' readiness, announcement plans, and cross-team alignment. Develop working-backwards plans and establish mechanisms to track, monitor, and report on GTM execution and launch readiness.  
  
GTM Execution & Content Management  
  
Identify and deliver updates to Seller-facing communications (SeCe), partnering with Country Fees POCs and partner teams to prepare and align on internal content and readiness for launches and changes. Manage end-to-end delivery of content updates for BRDs, TRDs, ARDs, Help Pages, Paragon SOPs, and country/partner teams' internal readiness for all fee/incentive types, following the GTM Launch Playbook. Maintain a centralized repository of Seller-facing content resources and internal launch documentation, managing ongoing content updates throughout the year while ensuring accuracy and version control.  
  
Process Development & Operational Excellence  
  
Build and implement program mechanisms to drive GTM execution, collect Seller Voice of Seller (VOS) feedback, define program performance metrics, synthesize insights, and share actionable summaries with product teams. Perform fee/incentive change validation activities, report observations and discrepancies to Product and Tech teams, and drive resolution to closure.  
  
Program Leadership  
  
Execute high-priority, cross-functional, high-impact projects self-sufficiently with minimal oversight. Solve complex, ambiguous problems independently by applying sound judgment, data-driven analysis, and structured thinking. Identify process gaps and proactively propose scalable solutions that improve efficiency and reduce operational risk. Analyze the overall program performance and drive program roadmap with product.  
  
A day in the life  
As a Senior Program Manager in Fee Strategy Operations, you operate at the intersection of strategy and execution. Your day involves leading cross-functional syncs with Fee Strategy PMs, Country Fees POCs, GPO, Legal, Seller Communications, and Operations to align on launch readiness, resolve blockers, and confirm content and announcement timelines across regions. You manage hands-on deliverables—reviewing and updating Help Pages and Paragon SOPs in the centralized content repository, tracking program documentation completion and updates, performing fee change validations against Seller-facing surfaces, and escalating discrepancies to Tech/Product teams for resolution. Equally, you invest time in building scalable mechanisms—developing work-backwards plans for newly approved fee/incentive changes, synthesizing Seller VOS feedback into actionable insights for product teams, and refining the GTM playbook based on lessons learned from prior cycles. You independently manage ambiguity across 6+ partner teams spanning multiple geographies, drive cross-functional alignment without authority, and deliver results with minimal oversight—balancing strategic coordination with operational rigor every single day. You monitor the performance of the program, identify gaps, and work with country team to improve key conversion and selection metric.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* 4+ years of developing program strategies and plans, diving execution, and influencing senior stakeholders experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
* Experience managing competing priorities across a wide range of stakeholders
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Experience with go-to-market planning, launch execution, or operational readiness programs

Successful candidates will have experience with Program Management in a broad, global organization, have experience working with a variety of cross-organizational stakeholders, and be able to juggle competing priorities. This candidate must have crisp communication skills, and have experience communicating project status and updates across a global audience. Ability to navigate ambiguous programs, influence without authority, and a high bias for action are critical for success in this role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering large end to end programs. You will have the opportunity to engage with experienced cross-disciplinary teams to conceive of and design innovative customer facing initiatives. You thrive through creating a vision, building consensus and driving teams towards results. You will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, significantly complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, and then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. This role will require the candidate be self-sufficient to analyze large amounts of data. So, working knowledge of SQL is critical for success. You will not be required to build data infrastructure but you will need to be comfortable querying (good foundational knowledge), be nifty with excel (power pivot), and use data to drive / influence discussions. Many a times you will have to leverage existing data generated by other BIEs to drive your programs. Other times, the exact data may not be available and you will need to be self-sufficient to not be blocked by this.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Your week will typically start with looking at key input/output metrics and identifying trends/concerns/opportunities. You will engage with stakeholders ad partners to track progress on goals, as well as identify opportunities to further enhance customer experience. You will crisply communicate to senior leadership on status, progress, concerns and help required to unblock key opportunities. The bottom line is to drive improvements which requires strong communication, a flair for identifying data patterns, comfort with analyzing large varied datasets, and a knack of influencing diverse set of stakeholders.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are building products that help customers to easily identify offers which are closest to them. True to Amazon’s tenets, customer and seller obsession are always at the forefront of our decisions. We innovate and design our services and tools with a focus on customer experience, followed by our focus on technology and worldwide scaling. You will work on the customer’s search experience, build new widgets that drive better discovery of products, improve personalization for the entire customer’s journey, improve our perception of speed, and scale all these products globally.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Proficiency with AI tools for rapid data analysis, and insight generation.
* Proven ability to drive product adoption across large, distributed organizations with diverse stakeholder groups.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. b79d1364.description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Serves as the connective tissue for our most strategic product launches. In this newly created role, you will be the central orchestrator responsible for managing the end-to-end lifecycle of bringing new Gracenote products and features to market.
  
  
You will not just manage a schedule; you will bridge the gap between technical execution and commercial readiness in partnership with Product, Engineering, Legal, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the comprehensive New Product Introduction (NPI) / Go-To-Market (GTM) process from ideation and development through to launch and post-launch evaluation.
* Serve as the primary liaison connecting diverse teams. Ensure alignment across:

+ Product & Design: Tracking feature readiness, user experience milestones, and beta testing.
+ Engineering: Monitoring development sprints, QA, and technical deployment schedules.
+ Legal & Privacy: Ensuring new products meet all regulatory compliance, data privacy standards, and that necessary vendor/client contracts are updated.
+ Marketing: Aligning product delivery with messaging, positioning, and promotional launch campaigns.
+ Sales & Enablement: Ensuring sales teams are trained, equipped with collateral, and ready to monetize the product on day one.
+ Customer Support/Operations: Ensuring support teams have the documentation and tools needed to assist clients post-launch.

* Build and scale a standardized NPI playbook for Gracenote, defining clear phases, gates, deliverables, and ownership for all future launches.
* Proactively identify bottlenecks, dependencies, and risks across all workstreams. Develop mitigation plans and escalate critical issues to executive stakeholders with proposed solutions.
* Host regular cross-functional syncs. Provide clear, concise executive reporting on program health, launch readiness, and post-launch metrics.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of program management, product operations, or GTM management experience, preferably within the B2B tech, SaaS, or data/entertainment industries.
* Proven ability to "speak the language" of diverse departments—from deeply technical engineering constraints to complex legal compliance and nuanced marketing strategies.
* Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to drive alignment, accountability, and momentum among stakeholders who do not report to you.
* Deep understanding of software development lifecycles (Agile/Scrum) and traditional project management frameworks. PMP, PgMP, or Agile certifications are a plus.
* Hyper-organized with a keen eye for detail. Capable of managing multiple, complex product launches simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, capable of distilling complex program statuses into clear executive summaries.

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.
